# DESCRIPTION OF THE FINANCING DOCUMENTS

In order to secure the full and punctual payment and performance of our obligations under the Indenture and the Notes and establish the intercreditor arrangements with respect to the Collateral, the Issuer will enter into, among others, the following financing agreements governed by New York and Panamanian law. The following are summaries of the principal terms of our principal finance agreements. These summaries should not be considered full statements of the terms and provisions of such contracts. Accordingly, the following summaries are qualified in their entirety by reference to each contract. Copies of the contracts described below will be on file at the office of the Issuer and may be inspected upon request. Unless otherwise stated, any reference in this offering memorandum to any contract means such contract and all schedules, exhibits and attachments thereto as amended, supplemented or otherwise modified and in effect as of the date thereof. Spanish language versions of any of the agreements described in this summary and governed by Panamanian law are determinative.

## Description of the Letter of Credit Facility Agreement

In connection with the offering, the Issuer, the LC Facility Administrative Agent, and the Lender Parties party thereto from time to time will enter into the LC Facility Agreement, governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Pursuant to the LC Facility Agreement, the LC Issuing Banks will make available to the Issuer, on a pro rata basis, the Letters of Credit which may be used by the Issuer to (i) fund the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account, (ii) fund the O&amp;M Reserve Account, (iii) backstop certain payment obligations of the Issuer under the LNG Share Purchase Agreement and (iv) backstop certain payment obligations of the Issuer under the TUA. The aggregate principal amount of the LC Facility shall not exceed U.S.$134 million.

The LC Facility is expected to be available from the Issue Date until five business days prior to the date that is five years after the Issue Date (the "LC Availability Period"). Each Letter of Credit will initially expire on the date that is the earlier of (i) 12 months after issuance of that Letter of Credit or the then current extension or (ii) the last day of the LC Availability Period. If requested by the Issuer prior to the expiration date, a Letter of Credit may provide for an automatic extension upon the expiration date during the LC Availability Period unless, at least 60 days prior to that expiration date, the relevant LC Issuing Banks provide a notice of non-extension to the LC Facility Administrative Agent and the Issuer. The available amount of the Letters of Credit to be issued by the LC Issuing Banks may not exceed the commitment amounts for each LC Issuing Bank and type of Letter of Credit set forth in the LC Facility Agreement, and after giving effect to an issuance, the Letter of Credit Facility exposure of all Lender Parties may not exceed the sum of all LC Facility commitments.

## LC Loans

Letters of Credit issued under the LC Facility can be drawn by their respective beneficiaries upon the satisfaction of certain drawing conditions, and the resulting disbursements, if not repaid by the Issuer no later than 12:00 noon, New York City time, on the business day following the day that the disbursement is made, will automatically and without further action by the Issuer or any other person, convert into LC Loans in the amount of the disbursements under the LC Facility Agreement. Interest accrued as described in this paragraph will be for the account of the applicable LC Lenders. LC Loans will have a maturity of 12 months from the date of the applicable Letter of Credit disbursement.

Each LC Loan will bear interest at a rate per annum equal to six-month Term SOFR plus the applicable margin set forth in the LC Facility Agreement.

If any principal of or interest on any LC Loan or any Letter of Credit Disbursement or any fee or other amount payable by the Issuer under the LC Facility is not paid when due, whether at stated maturity, upon acceleration or otherwise, such overdue amount will bear interest, before, on, and after judgment, at a rate per annum equal to 2.00% plus the rate that would otherwise be applicable to such amount pursuant to the LC Facility, for the period from the date that amount became due until that amount is paid in full.

122

# Covenants

Pursuant to the LC Facility Agreement, the Issuer covenants to the Administrative Agent and Lender Parties to perform certain obligations of the Issuer pursuant to the Indenture, which are incorporated into the LC Facility Agreement by reference to the Indenture. Any reports, notices or other documents to be delivered to the Indenture Trustee or the Noteholders shall be delivered to the Administrative Agent as well.

The Issuer is also subject to (i) an affirmative covenant to use each Letter of Credit and the proceeds of each disbursement or LC Loan thereunder solely for the corresponding purpose set forth in the LC Facility Agreement, (ii) a negative covenant to not use the proceeds of any Letter of Credit or LC Loan in a manner that would violate any anti-corruption or sanctions laws, (iii) an affirmative covenant to maintain compliance with the insurance policy requirements set forth in a schedule to the LC Facility Agreement, (iv) a negative covenant to not maintain or contribute to any employee benefit plan subject to Title I or Title IV of ERISA or Section 4975 of the Code and (v) an affirmative covenant to deliver a Beneficial Ownership Certificate to the Administrative Agent.

# Events of Default

Under the LC Facility Agreement, each of the following events that occur and are continuing will constitute an event of default, unless waived or cured within the cure period and in the manner set forth in the LC Facility Agreement:

(a) failure to pay principal, interest or any other amount payable under the LC Facility Agreement or any Letter of Credit, security document or fee letter;

(b) failure to comply with the Issuer’s covenants to use the proceeds of any disbursements under the LC Facility Agreement or to maintain insurance in the manner contemplated by the LC Facility Agreement;

(c) failure to comply with each of the covenants incorporated into the LC Facility Agreement by reference to the Indenture, or each of the covenants in any Letter of Credit, the LC Facility Agreement, security documents, fee letters or any Financing Document the Issuer is a party to;

(d) a Change of Control under, and as defined in the Indenture, has occurred;

(e) misrepresentation by any of the Issuer and the Holding Company, as applicable, under the LC Facility Agreement, any Letter of Credit, any other document executed pursuant to the LC Facility Agreement, any Financing Document or any certificate or other document delivered to the Administrative Agent;

(f) any “Event of Default” under, and as defined in the Indenture, in respect of which all obligations under the Indenture have been declared due and payable, has occurred and is continuing;

(g) invalidity of or challenge by a third party to the validity of any material term of any of the LC Facility Agreement, the Letters of Credit, the Intercreditor Agreement, the Security Documents or the LC Facility Agreement fee letters; and

(h) either (i) governmental action to place a general moratorium upon, cancel, suspend, or otherwise hinder fulfilment of the Issuer’s payment obligations under the LC Facility Agreement, the Letters of Credit, the Intercreditor Agreement, the Security Documents or the LC Facility Agreement fee letters, including any action affecting the currency of the Issuer’s payments, or (ii) Issuer action resulting in the rescheduling of the Issuer’s debts or the restructuring of the currency in which the Issuers may pay its obligations.

# Description of the Intercreditor Agreement

The security over the Collateral and the rights of holders of the Issuer’s indebtedness, including the Notes, the LC Facility Agreement and each other Senior Debt Instrument and are subject to the provisions of the Intercreditor Agreement, dated on or about the Issue Date, by and between the Issuer, the Panamanian Trustee, the Collateral Agent, the Intercreditor Agent, the Indenture Trustee, the LC Facility Administrative Agent, and the other Senior Creditor Group Representatives party thereto from time to time. If any Additional Indebtedness Document or Permitted

Hedging Instrument is entered into, the applicable Senior Creditor Group Representative will accede to the Intercreditor Agreement.

The Intercreditor Agreement establishes, among other things: (a) the intercreditor arrangements between the Secured Parties with respect to security, payments, recoveries and certain decisions and (b) the appointment of the Intercreditor Agent. The Intercreditor Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

For a discussion of the material terms of the Intercreditor Agreement in relation to:

(a) the disposition of proceeds of the Notes and the priority of payments from the Project Accounts, see “Description of the Notes—Security—Cash Waterfall;”

(b) voting and decision-making, see “Description of the Notes—Voting and Decision-Making;”

(c) modifications to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement, see “Description of the Notes—Modification Approval Levels;”

(d) waivers and amendments to the terms of any Senior Debt Instrument, see “Description of the Notes—Amendment, Supplement and Waiver;” and

(e) enforcement of security interests by the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent, and the Panamanian Trustee, see “Description of the Notes—Enforcement of Security Interests.”

## Collateral Structure

The obligations of the Issuer with respect to the Notes and the performance of all other obligations of the Issuer relating to the Indenture and the other Senior Debt Instruments will be secured on a first-priority and pari passu basis by the Collateral after the repayment of the Existing Facilities, pursuant to the following:

(a) the New York law-governed Security and Depositary Agreement, as described below;

(b) the Panamanian law-governed A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, as described below;

(c) the Panamanian law-governed Mortgage over Movable Assets, as described below;

(d) the Panamanian law-governed A&amp;R Mortgage over Immovable Assets, as described below;

(e) the Panamanian law-governed A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, as described below;

(f) the Panamanian law-governed A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement, as described below;

(g) any New Share Pledge Agreement, as described below; and

(h) the Third Party Consents, as described below.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Collateral does not include the Notes Excluded Assets. See “Description of the Notes—Enforcement of Security Interests—Order of Application – Notes Excluded Collateral.”

All Collateral secured under New York law-governed documents will be secured on or about the Issue Date, while all Collateral secured under Panamanian law-governed documents will be secured following the repayment of the Existing Facilities but no later than the Panamanian Collateral Outside Date.

## Description of the Security and Depositary Agreement

The Issuer, the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent, the Offshore Depositary Bank, and the Panamanian Trustee will enter into the Security and Depositary Agreement, dated on or about the Issue Date, whereby the Issuer will grant liens in favor of the Collateral Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties, on all of the Issuer’s right, title and interest in, to and under the Collateral, including the Offshore Project Accounts and all of the funds deposited therein or credited thereto as security for the payment and performance in full of the Senior Debt Obligations, but excluding that Collateral for which liens will be granted in favor of the Panamanian Trustee for the benefit of the

123

beneficiaries of the Guaranty Trust, including the Collateral Agent, as described below. The Security and Depositary Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Pursuant to the Security and Depositary Agreement, the Issuer will agree to establish and maintain in New York the Dollar-denominated Note Debt Service Reserve Account, Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Accounts(s), and the O&amp;M Reserve Account. For a description of these accounts, see “Description of Notes—Accounts—Offshore Accounts.”

## Description of the Third Party Consents

The “Third Party Consents” include the consents to collateral assignment governed by the laws of the State of New York to be entered into by the Collateral Agent, with each of:

(a) the LNG Supplier, with respect to the SPA;
(b) the Operator, with respect to the TUA and the OCA;
(c) the Services Provider, with respect to the ASA;
(d) LTSA Contractor with respect to the LTSA;
(e) the O&amp;M Manager, with respect to the O&amp;M Management Agreement; and
(f) each other Replacement Counterparty or Material Project Party required under the Financing Documents to be delivered, in each case, in the form attached to the Indenture.

The Third Party Consents listed in items (a) through (e) above will be entered into on or around the Issue Date, and any Third Party Consent listed in item (f) will be entered into as described under the caption “Description of the Notes—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Entry into Material Project Documents, etc.”

Consents related to any Additional Material Project Document or Replacement Material Project Document governed by Panamanian law will be obtained and delivered, as applicable, according to the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement.

## Description of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement

The Guaranty Trust Agreement was established in Panama pursuant to the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement entered into between and among the Issuer, as settlor, Global Financial Funds Corp., as trustee, and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, as collateral agent, dated December 6, 2021 and registered in the Panamanian Public Registry Office on December 15, 2021. The Original Guaranty Trust Agreement establishes provisions for Generadora de Gatún, S.A., as settlor, to include conditionally obligations as part of the secured obligations under said trust subject to the repayment in full of the Existing Facilities.

Prior to the repayment of the Existing Facilities, Generadora de Gatún, S.A., as settlor, will take the necessary steps under the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement to include the Notes as part of the secured obligations and include the Secured Parties as secured parties of the Guaranty Trust subordinated and subject to the repayment in full of the Existing Facilities through a sworn statement of new debt (“New Debt Sworn Statement”) and furthermore, on the Issue Date, the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement will be amended and restated pursuant to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, in order to secure, pursuant to the terms described therein, and guarantee: (i) compliance with all terms, conditions, obligations and agreements entered into or which may be entered into in the future by the Issuer with the Secured Parties under the Notes, the Indenture, the LC Facility, and the other Financing Documents; (ii) payment by the Issuer of all reasonable and documented expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any Primary Beneficiary to preserve, protect, manage, hold in custody, replace, substitute and supplement the Panamanian Collateral; (iii) payment by the Issuer of all expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any Secured Party to collect debts or enforce the obligations and commitments set forth in (i) and (ii) of this paragraph and to defend the rights of the Secured Parties and the Panamanian Trustee conferred in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and in the other

124

Financing Documents; (iv) payment of any other sums the Issuer must pay to the Secured Parties pursuant to the Financing Documents; and (v) subject to the occurrence of the Secured Obligations Termination Date and compliance with the applicable sections of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the future obligations with respect to future creditors and future agents designated in a sworn statement to be provided by the Issuer (the "Future Obligations").

The A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement will be governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Panama as described in “—Secured Obligations.” Trusts are regulated in Panama by Law No. 1 of January 5, 1984 and Law No. 21 of May 10, 2017. These laws grant great flexibility to trusts per se and facilitate their creation and management. The Superintendency of Banks is the official entity responsible for supervising and safeguarding the adequate functioning of the trust business in the Republic of Panama.

## Secured Obligations

Under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Panamanian Trustee will be granted a security interest for the benefit of the beneficiaries of the Guaranty Trust, including the Collateral Agent, in certain obligations, including, among others:

- The timely and complete compliance with all terms, conditions, obligations and agreements entered into or which may be entered into in the future by the Issuer with the Secured Parties under the Notes, the Indenture, the LC Facility, and the other Financing Documents, as well as those arising from all modifications, amendments, supplements, extensions, renewals, or replacements thereof, including timely and complete payment at maturity (on the agreed maturity date or before if accelerated, including, without limitation, due to any breach or non-performance of any term, condition, and agreement provided in any of the Financing Documents, or for any other reason) of any and all amounts due, including, without limitation, payment of principal, current interest, late interest, repayment obligations, indemnities, fees, expenses, and other amounts; and any financial liabilities of any nature, however evidenced, owed by the Issuer to the Secured Parties;
- The timely and complete payment by the Issuer of all reasonable and documented expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any Primary Beneficiary to preserve, protect, manage, hold in custody, replace, substitute and supplement the Panamanian Collateral;
- The timely and complete payment by the Issuer of all expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any other Secured Party to collect, either judicially or extrajudicially, debts or enforce the obligations and commitments set forth in the two immediately precedent paragraphs and to defend the rights of the Secured Parties and the Panamanian Trustee conferred in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and in the other Financing Documents;
- The timely and complete payment of any other sums the Issuer must pay to the Secured Parties pursuant to the Financing Documents; and
- subject to the occurrence of the Secured Obligations Termination Date and compliance with the terms of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the future obligations with respect to future creditors and future agents designated by means of a future sworn statement by the Issuer.

## Panamanian Collateral

The Collateral under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement will consist of a security interest in and to the below collateral (collectively, the "Panamanian Collateral"):

- All Onshore Accounts (in Spanish, "Cuentas Fiduciarias Locales") and all funds deposited from time to time in these accounts, in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement, the Intercreditor Agreement, and other Financing Documents (including, without limitation, project revenues).

125

- Property rights relating to the A&amp;R Mortgage over Immovable Assets over certain real estate, constituted by the Issuer in favor of the Panamanian Trustee, and any subsequent additions, as well as any monies or other rights resulting from the enforcement of such rights.

- Property rights relating to the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets constituted by the Issuer in favor of the Panamanian Trustee, and any monies or other rights resulting from the enforcement of such rights.

- All assigned rights (in Spanish “Derechos Cedidos”) unconditionally assigned under the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement (the “Assigned Rights”), including: (i) all economic rights of the Issuer to receive amounts due under the Assigned PPAs, (ii) all receivables from the sale of energy and/or power through the spot market or the regional market and other auxiliary services or energy or capacity reserve agreements (iii) all insurance proceeds paid and/or received in connection with an Event of Loss related to the Required Insurance Policies, (iv) all payments received in connection with a Condemnation Event; (v) all receivables corresponding to Panama law governed agreements that the Issuer is entitled to receive pursuant to the Security and Depositary Agreement that must be transferred to the Onshore Accounts, including, without limitation, the proceeds of Material Project Document Claims, the proceeds for termination of Material Project Documents, the proceeds of Dispositions; the proceeds of any Permitted Investment (except for investments of the Issuer in the equity interest of any permitted expansion subsidiary); as well as any other Project revenues or other revenues of the Issuer related to the Project (except for any ETESA Transfer Payment), provided that and subject to the requirement that under the Security and Depositary Agreement such amounts must be deposited into the Onshore Accounts and (vi) indemnities of insurance, bonds and guarantees that the Issuer is entitled to receive under the Assigned PPAs.

- The Assigned Contracts conditionally assigned under the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement.

- Rights under the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, as well as any assets, rights, or monies resulting from the enforcement of such pledge, until such time as the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement is replaced by the New Share Pledge Agreement.

- After the Corporate Reorganization, rights under the New Share Pledge Agreement, as well as any assets, rights, or monies resulting from the enforcement of such pledge.

- Any other assets, securities, monies, and rights generated by the above-mentioned Collateral, as well as any assets that, from time to time, are or must be transferred to the Panamanian Trustee by the Issuer or third parties, in accordance with the Financing Documents, and accepted by the Panamanian Trustee.

## Duties and Responsibilities of the Panamanian Trustee

Under the terms of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, which is governed by Panamanian law, the Panamanian Trustee will have the following duties and responsibilities:

- Accept, in a fiduciary capacity, the delivery of monies and other assets and rights that are the subject of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Administer and/or dispose, in whole or in part, of the Panamanian Collateral, in accordance with the terms and conditions established in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Open all local trust accounts (in Spanish “Cuentas Fiduciarias Locales”) as established in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and any others deemed necessary for the proper administration of the Collateral and to fulfill the purposes and objectives of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Proceed with withdrawals and transfers of funds from the local trust accounts, subject to the provisions of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

126

- Proceed with the disposition of the Panamanian Collateral in payment or reduction of the secured obligations under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, upon receipt of a Default Notice or a Notice of Security Enforcement Action.

- Deliver any surplus in cash or other assets or rights to the Issuer, after payment of fiduciary fees and expenses generated under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, as permitted under the Financing Documents and the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Deliver the Panamanian Collateral to a Successor Panamanian Trustee, designated in accordance with the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement or applicable Panamanian law.

- Keep, directly or through third parties, the accounting of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement strictly separate from the rest of the Panamanian Trustee’s assets and render accounts of its administrative management.

- Prepare quarterly management reports and present them to the Intercreditor Agent, and the Issuer within sixty (60) calendar days following the end of each quarter.

- Deliver to the Issuer, the Intercreditor Agent and the Offshore Collateral Agent (as and when required by the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement) the information, data, and reports reasonably requested, without prejudice to other information obligations provided in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and applicable Panamanian law.

- Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default Date and during the entire default period, at the written request of the Intercreditor Agent or the Offshore Collateral Agent, provide information on the balance as of the date of the request for each local trust account, including investment accounts, if any.

- Submit to the competent authorities, at any time, the information required regarding its management as trustee or any other information that must be provided under applicable Panamanian law.

- Retain documents evidencing compliance with its management as Panamanian Trustee during the term of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, until the final account has been approved as required by law.

- Act through agents or attorneys-in-fact as necessary or convenient, at its sole judgment and discretion, to execute the powers and responsibilities of the Panamanian Trustee, including appointing legal representatives to initiate and pursue any judicial or extrajudicial action or measure that may correspond, or otherwise initiate and pursue any action that may correspond to the owner or holder of any of the Panamanian Collateral.

- Execute all acts inherent to its role as Panamanian Trustee.

- Enter into all types of contracts, agreements, and grant public deeds for the purposes and objectives of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Receive and apply transfers of funds and payments, in accordance with the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Notify the Issuer and the Intercreditor Agent of any claims, lawsuits, complaints, reports, or administrative proceedings brought against the Panamanian Collateral or the Trust, as soon as it becomes legally aware of them.

- Notify the Intercreditor Agent and the Offshore Collateral Agent of any breach by the Issuer of its obligations and duties under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

- Maintain fiduciary secrecy, except for information about its fiduciary administration or any other information required at any time by governmental authorities (including, without limitation, the Superintendency of Banks of Panama), or any other information that must be disclosed or delivered

127

under applicable law, or as required by the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Panamanian Security Documents, and any other Financing Document to which it is a party.

- The Panamanian Trustee may, but is not obligated to, in the event the Issuer fails to comply with its obligations under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, pay from the Panamanian Collateral all taxes, insurance premiums, legal expenses, advisory fees, debts, claims, or charges that may be owed or that may exist against or in relation to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.
- The Panamanian Trustee, on its own or at the request of the Intercreditor Agent, reserves the right to inspect and/or carry out or request the appraisals it deems reasonably appropriate or necessary for the assets that directly or indirectly form part of the Trust Assets. These appraisals must be performed by an independent appraiser acceptable to the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, and the Offshore Collateral Agent or, in the event some future obligations exist, to the future agent. If the Panamanian Trustee requires or requests an appraisal and it is not provided by the Issuer, the Panamanian Trustee may order its preparation, in which case the amount or amounts invested by the Panamanian Trustee shall be reimbursed by the Issuer or charged against the Panamanian Collateral.
- Urge the Issuer to exercise the corresponding legal actions to enforce the rights of the Assigned Contracts and/or those that are the subject to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

## Instructions

The Panamanian Trustee will not be required to follow instructions from the Issuer or the Intercreditor Agent if, in its reasonable opinion: (i) compliance with such instructions would result in a violation of any law, regulation, or judicial or governmental order; (ii) compliance with such instructions would result in a violation of any terms and conditions of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement; (iii) compliance with such instructions would expose the Panamanian Trustee to personal liability, obligation, or any form of prejudice; (iv) compliance with such instructions would require the Panamanian Trustee to incur expenses or make payments if there are not sufficient funds available in the local trust accounts to cover such expenses; or (v) such instructions are not contemplated or stipulated in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

## Resignation and Removal of the Panamanian Trustee

The Panamanian Trustee may resign at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice of not less than ninety (90) days to the Issuer, the Intercreditor Agent and the Offshore Collateral Agent. The Panamanian Trustee may be removed at any time, with or without cause, (i) prior to a Default Notice, by the Intercreditor Agent in agreement with the Issuer, and (ii) after a Default Notice, by the Intercreditor Agent, in each case by written notice given at least thirty (30) days in advance.

## Supplement and Modification

The A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement will only be modified by way of a written document signed between the Issuer and the Panamanian Trustee acting with the consent of the Intercreditor Agent. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Issuer and the Panamanian Trustee, may from time to time mutually establish procedures and rules for the implementation and administration of the Guaranty Trust, which, provided that they do not restrict, contradict, or undermine the terms of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, shall not constitute an amendment thereto.

## Governing Law and Jurisdiction

The A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement is governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Panama.

## Timing

Prior to the repayment of the Existing Facilities, Generadora de Gatún, S.A., as settlor, will take the necessary steps under the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement to include the Notes as part of the secured obligations and include the Secured Parties as secured parties of the Guaranty Trust subordinated and subject to the repayment in full of the Existing Facilities. On the Issue Date, the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement will be amended and restated pursuant to the terms of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, in order to secure, pursuant to the terms described therein, and guarantee: (i) compliance with all terms, conditions, obligations and agreements entered into or which may be entered into in the future by the Issuer with the Secured Parties under the Notes, the Indenture, the LC Facility, and the other Financing Documents; (ii) payment by the Issuer of all reasonable and documented expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any Primary Beneficiary to preserve, protect, manage, hold in custody, replace, substitute and supplement the Panamanian Collateral; (iii) payment by the Issuer of all expenses and obligations incurred or which may be incurred in the future by the Panamanian Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Offshore Collateral Agent or any Secured Party to collect debts or enforce the obligations and commitments set forth in (i) and (ii) of this paragraph and to defend the rights of the Secured Parties and the Panamanian Trustee conferred in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and in the other Financing Documents; (iv) payment of any other sums the Issuer must pay to the Secured Parties pursuant to the Financing Documents; and (v) subject to the occurrence of the Secured Obligations Termination Date and compliance with the applicable sections of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the future obligations with respect to future creditors and future agents designated in a sworn statement to be provided by the Issuer.

## Beneficiaries of A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement

(1) The following shall be the primary beneficiaries of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement (the "Primary Beneficiaries"), in the strict order of priority set forth below:

(i) in first order of priority, the Secured Parties, as well as their respective successors and assignees, with respect to the secured obligations under the Guaranty Trust; and

(ii) only as of the Secured Obligations Termination Date, the future agents and future creditors designated in a sworn statement to be provided by the Issuer, it being understood that such future agents and future creditors shall be considered Primary Beneficiaries only if the conditions set forth in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust have also been satisfied; in both cases, only to the extent of the Panamanian Collateral.

a) For these purposes, any assignees, participants, or sub-participants of the Secured Parties shall be deemed Secured Parties under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust. Such assignees, participants, or sub-participants shall not be in a different position than the original or prior Secured Parties.

b) In order for any successor or assignee of the Offshore Collateral Agent or the Intercreditor Agent to be recognized as a Primary Beneficiary of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust, such new foreign collateral

129

agent or intercreditor agent must immediately notify the Panamanian Trustee in writing, whereupon the Panamanian Trustee shall indicate what documentation must be provided to comply with applicable anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing regulations. Once the Panamanian Trustee has been notified and the required due diligence process has been completed, the incorporation of such successor or assignee as a Primary Beneficiary of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust shall become effective.

(2) Residual Beneficiaries

The Issuer, or any assignee thereof, or any person designated by the Issuer as of the Secured Obligations Termination Date, shall be the Residual Beneficiary upon termination of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust and the Panamanian Security Documents, in accordance with the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Intercreditor Agreement, the Depositary Agreement, and the Panamanian Security Documents.

In the event that a Default Notice or a Notice of Security Enforcement Action has been issued and has resulted in an enforcement action pursuant to the Panamanian Security Documents, the Intercreditor Agreement, the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, and the Security and Depositary Agreement, any remaining balance, if any, of the Panamanian Collateral shall be delivered to the Issuer, except for the pledged shares or equity interests under the A&amp;R Share Pledge Agreement or the New Share Pledge Agreement, which shall be delivered to the respective shareholders.

**Onshore Accounts (in Spanish, "Cuentas Fiduciarias Locales")**

The A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement will provide for the establishment and maintenance by the Panamanian Trustee of the market clearing account, the revenue account, the O&amp;M account, the loss proceeds account, the notes debt service payment account, the LC debt service payment account, the prepayment account, the distribution suspense account, the LC collateral account, the LNG account and such other additional payment accounts as the Panamanian Trustee will from time to time require and establish and maintain for the according to the A&amp;R Panamanian Trust Agreement. Under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Panamanian Trustee is authorized to open and maintain each Onshore Account with an acceptable account bank.

The Panamanian Trustee will transfer available funds on deposit in the Onshore Accounts in accordance with accounts waterfall set forth in the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and the Security and Depositary Agreement.

The Panamanian Trustee shall comply with instructions issued by the Issuer regarding withdrawals and transfers of funds deposited in the Onshore Accounts (except for the market clearing account, the O&amp;M account and the LNG account), as set forth in the distribution certificates and the transfer certificates issued by the Issuer or, with respect to transfer certificates for withdrawals from the LC collateral account, the Offshore Collateral Agent, in each case in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Security and Depositary Agreement, provided that withdrawals and transfers of funds deposited in the market clearing account shall not be subject to the delivery of a transfer certificate and may be carried out automatically in accordance with the commercial rules governing the electricity wholesale market and the applicable provisions of the Security and Depositary Agreement and withdrawals from the LNG account and the O&amp;M account will be made in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Security and Depositary Agreement and will not be subject to a transfer certificate and will require only a delivery of a written instruction from the Issuer to the Panamanian Trustee, which may be in the form of standing instruction. The Panamanian Trustee shall not be required to review, examine or analyze whether the distribution certificates or transfer certificates issued from time to time by the Issuer comply with the provisions of the Security and Depositary Agreement or any other Financing Document (as applicable).

In the event that the Collateral Agent or the Intercreditor Agent sends the Panamanian Trustee a Default Notice or the Intercreditor Agent sends the Panamanian Trustee a Notice of Security Enforcement Action, the Panamanian Trustee shall proceed in accordance with the instructions it receives as provided in the Depositary Agreement, the Intercreditor Agreement, the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, and the other Panamanian Security Documents.

# A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement Fees

The Issuer shall pay the Panamanian Trustee annual fees set forth in the letter agreement dated October 7, 2021 executed between the Issuer and the Panamanian Trustee.

In the event of the Panamanian Trustee’s resignation or removal, any fees paid in advance shall be prorated based on the period during which the trustee services were effectively rendered, and the remaining balance shall be refunded to the Issuer.

The Issuer shall pay the Panamanian Trustee, upon the Panamanian Trustee’s request, all reasonable costs and expenses incurred by the Panamanian Trustee in connection with the establishment of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and the performance of its obligations thereunder, including, without limitation, attorneys’ fees and the fees of advisors, agents, attorneys-in-fact, representatives, contractors, consultants, and advisors reasonably engaged by the Panamanian Trustee; all expenses related to the replacement of the Panamanian Trustee; the preservation of the Panamanian Collateral; the sale, disposal, transfer, or liquidation of the Panamanian Collateral; and the establishment, amendment, and termination of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement. The Issuer shall also pay all taxes, including stamp taxes, fees, contributions, registration duties, and notarial expenses arising from the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement and the Panamanian Collateral.

# Termination of A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement

The A&amp;R Guaranty Trust shall terminate automatically, without the need for judicial declaration and without any liability for the Panamanian Trustee, in the following events:

(i) when the Secured Obligations Termination Date has occurred, all amounts owed in connection with the secured obligations guaranteed by the Guaranty Trust have been fully paid, and the process established in the corresponding sections of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement has been completed;

(ii) when all of the Panamanian Collateral, or the proceeds from the sale or liquidation thereof, have been delivered to the Primary Beneficiaries for the payment of the obligations arising from the secured obligations guaranteed by the Guaranty Trust;

(iii) upon mutual agreement between the Panamanian Trustee, the Issuer, and the Primary Beneficiaries; and

(iv) upon the occurrence of any of the events set forth in Article 33 of Panama’s trust law (Law 1 of January 5, 1984).

Upon termination of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, all Panamanian Collateral or any remaining balance thereof, as applicable, shall be transferred and assigned by the Panamanian Trustee to the Residual Beneficiary. In cases where the Panamanian Trustee has lost contact with the Residual Beneficiary or the Primary Beneficiary for a period greater than five (5) years, and the Superintendency of Banks of Panama verifies this fact, the liquid value of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust shall be transferred to the National Bank of Panama in accordance with Article 33 Panama’s trust law (Law 1 of January 5, 1984).

# Description of the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets

The Original Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets was established pursuant to the Public Deed No. 11,621 of the Ninth Notary Public of the Circuit of Panama, registered in the Panamanian Public Registry at Folio No. 27150696 of the Movable Properties Section, among other Folios and on the Issue Date, Generadora de Gatún, S.A., as mortgagor, and the Panamanian Trustee (acting as trustee of the Guaranty Trust), as mortgagee, will enter into the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets, pursuant to which the Issuer will ratify the first-priority chattel mortgage over certain movable assets, including, among others, moveable property described therein. The A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets will also extend to improvements, spare parts, accessories, replacements that are incorporated to or substitute such movables assets and all proceeds, products, and income derived from the mortgaged assets, as well as any insurance proceeds or indemnities related thereto. Under the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets, the Issuer will be obligated to constitute a first-priority chattel mortgage over certain project improvements that exceed U.S.$10 million in book value.

The A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets will secure the timely and complete fulfilment of all obligations guaranteed under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, up to the maximum secured amount specified in the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets (an amount which is less than the full value of the Notes), together with all interest, fees, costs, and other related amounts to the obligations guaranteed under the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement. The A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets will be governed by Panamanian law and shall remain in full force and effect until the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement is terminated and, subject to the existence of Future Obligations, the Panamanian Collateral has been distributed according to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement.

## Description of the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement and the New Share Pledge Agreement

On December 7, 2021, the Holding Company, as pledger, the Issuer, as the company and the Panamanian Trustee (acting as trustee of the Guaranty Trust), as pledgee, entered into the Original Issuer Share Pledge Agreement whereby all of the issued and outstanding shares of the Issuer were pledged to guaranty the obligations guaranteed by the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement in favor of the beneficiaries of the Guaranty Trust. The pledge extends to all current and future shares, all rights attached thereto (including voting rights and rights to dividends or distributions), and any proceeds or products derived from such shares.

Following the repayment of the Existing Facilities and no later than the Issue Date, the Original Issuer Share Pledge Agreement will be amended and restated pursuant to the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement in order to ratify the pledge granted under the Original Issuer Share Pledge Agreement and amend the terms of the Original Issuer Share Pledge Agreement.

The A&amp;R Share Pledge Agreement will terminate if the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement is terminated or upon the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization.

## Description of the New Share Pledge Agreement

After the Corporate Reorganization, the new shareholders of the Issuer, as pledgers, the Panamanian Trustee, as pledgee, and the Issuer will enter into the New Share Pledge Agreement, pursuant to which the Issuer's shareholders will grant the Panamanian Trustee, in its capacity as trustee of the Guaranty Trust, a pledge over 100% of the issued and outstanding common shares (or, in the event of a transformation, participation quotas) of the paid-in capital of the Issuer after the Corporate Reorganization. The pledge will secure all obligations guaranteed by the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement in favor of the beneficiaries of the Guaranty Trust. Any New Share Pledge Agreement will extend to all current and future shares, all rights attached thereto (including voting rights and rights to dividends or distributions), and any proceeds or products derived from such shares.

Except as permitted under the Financing Documents and provided that it does not result in a Change of Control, the pledger under the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement and the New Share Pledge Agreement shall not sell, assign, grant in usufruct, place in trust, donate, dispose of, or otherwise transfer any of the pledged assets (100% of the issued and outstanding common shares of the paid-in capital of the Issuer), nor grant any purchase option or promise to sell in respect of any of such pledged assets, nor create any pledge or other lien or encumbrance over such pledge assets (other than the pledge created pursuant to the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement and the New Share Pledge Agreement, respectively), nor impose or create any limitations or restrictions on the ownership or transferability of any of such pledged assets.

In addition, such pledger may, or following the Corporate Reorganization, such pledgers may, directly or indirectly transfer (and permit any affiliate to transfer) the shares of the Issuer, provided that such transfer satisfies certain conditions including without limitation that it does not result in a Change of Control, is consistent with the Indenture and, except in case of a Corporate Reorganization, on the date of such transfer, if it is a direct transfer, the new pledger(s) shall pledge their shares in the Issuer by acceding to the then-current pledge agreement and shall deliver the documents necessary to perfect the new commercial pledge, in accordance with such pledge agreement. In case of a transfer the Panamanian Trustee will have the right to request, together with other customary deliverables, a legal opinion on the validity of the transfer with respect to the Indenture.

The collateral assignment was established in Panama pursuant to the Original Assignment Agreement and Generadora de Gatún, S.A., as assignor, and the Panamanian Trustee (acting as trustee of the Panamanian Trust), as assignee, will enter on the Issue Date into the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement in public deed form. Pursuant to the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement, the Issuer will:

- ratify the unconditional assignment of the Assigned Rights and the conditional assignment of the Assigned Contracts;

# DESCRIPTION OF THE NOTES

The following summary of certain provisions of the Indenture, the Notes and the Collateral is not complete and is subject to, and qualified in its entirety by reference to, all of the provisions of the Indenture, the Notes and the other Financing Documents, as applicable. The holders of the Notes will be entitled to the benefits of, be bound by, and be deemed to have notice of, all of the provisions of the Indenture, the Notes and the other Notes Documents, including, without limitation, the immunities and rights of the Indenture Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee. Copies of the Indenture and the other Notes Documents will be on file at the office of the Issuer and may be inspected upon request.

## General

You can find the definitions of certain terms used in this description under the subheading “—Certain Definitions.” In this “Description of the Notes,” the term “Issuer” refers only to Generadora de Gatún S.A., a corporation (sociedad anónima) organized under the laws of Panama on the date of issuance of the Notes, and thereafter any of its successors or permitted assigns, and not to any of its Subsidiaries. As of the Issue Date, the Issuer has no Subsidiaries.

The Issuer will issue U.S.$ in aggregate principal amount of % senior secured notes due (the “Notes”). The Notes will be issued under an indenture (the “Indenture”) among the Issuer, the Holding Company, Citibank, N.A., as trustee (the “Indenture Trustee”), registrar, transfer agent and paying agent. Following the issuance of the Notes, in connection with the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company will merge with and into the Issuer, with the Issuer remaining as the surviving entity.

The Indenture will not be governed by the provisions of the Trust Indenture Act of 1939, as amended, including any requirements to deliver annual opinions with respect to perfection of security interests or opinions with respect to release of the Collateral in accordance with the Indenture, the Intercreditor Agreement or the other Security Documents. The Notes will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and will be subject to certain transfer restrictions, as further described in “Transfer Restrictions.” The registered holder of a Note will be treated as the owner of it for all purposes. Only registered holders will have rights under the Indenture.

The Notes will have the benefit of, and will be secured pursuant to the terms of the Security Documents. The Security Documents set forth the terms of the agreements in respect of the Collateral that will secure the Notes. Concurrently with the issuance of the Notes, the Indenture Trustee, as a representative of the Noteholders, will enter into the Intercreditor Agreement with, among others, the LC Facility Administrative Agent, acting on behalf of the Lender Parties, as Secured Parties. If any Additional Indebtedness Document is entered into, the applicable agent will accede to the Intercreditor Agreement.

The following description is a summary of the material provisions of the Indenture, the Notes, the Intercreditor Agreement and the Security Documents. It does not restate those agreements in their entirety. We urge you to read the Indenture and the other Notes Documents because they, and not their description, define your rights as a Noteholder and the rights and obligations of the Indenture Trustee. For a further description of the Intercreditor Agreement, the other Security Documents and the other Financing Documents, see “Description of Principal Finance Documents.”

## Brief Description of the Notes; No Recourse

### The Notes

The Notes will:

- be general obligations of the Issuer;
- together with all other Senior Debt, rank (i) pari passu in right of payment with all other existing and future unsubordinated obligations of the Issuer (subject to any priority rights of such unsubordinated Indebtedness pursuant to Applicable Law) and (ii) effectively senior in right of

payment to any unsecured obligations of the Issuer to the extent of the value of the Collateral (subject to any priority rights of such unsecured obligations pursuant to Applicable Law); and

- be secured by a first-priority Security Interest (subject to Permitted Liens, the Intercreditor Agreement and the other Security Documents), which Security Interest will be shared on a pari passu basis with the Senior Creditors.

Until the occurrence of the Existing Facilities Repayment Date, the secured parties under the Existing Facilities will have a prior claim on assets secured by the Liens on the Existing Facilities Collateral. The Existing Facilities Repayment Date is expected to occur on or immediately following the Issue Date, upon the application of the proceeds of this offering as set forth in "Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds" below. Upon the occurrence of the Existing Facilities Repayment Date, the Issuer and the Holding Company will have no Indebtedness for borrowed money other than the Senior Debt and any Permitted Indebtedness or HoldCo Permitted Indebtedness. See "Security" further below.

## No Recourse

All obligations in connection with the Notes are solely obligations of the Issuer, secured by first-priority liens over the Collateral (subject to Permitted Liens) under the Security Documents, with no recourse to any other Person or entity. No Person and none of the Holding Company, the AES Sponsor, or the InterEnergy Sponsor or any other Affiliate of the Issuer, or any of their respective incorporators, stockholders, members, managers, representatives, partners, directors, officers or employees, has guaranteed or will guarantee the payment of the Notes or have any obligation or liability with respect to payment of the Notes or in respect of the Issuer's obligations under the Notes and/or any of the other Financing Documents. Each holder of Notes by accepting a Note waives and releases all such liability. The waiver and release are part of the consideration for issuance of the Notes. This waiver may not be effective to waive liabilities under United States federal securities laws.

## Interest, Amortization and Payment upon Maturity

### Interest

Interest on the Notes will accrue at the rate of % per annum and will be payable in cash semi-annually in arrears on and of each year, beginning on (each such date, a "Scheduled Payment Date"). The Issuer will make each interest payment on each Scheduled Payment Date to registered Noteholders of record on the fifth calendar day immediately preceding such Scheduled Payment Date (each such date, a "Record Date").

Interest on the Notes (including Additional Notes, as described herein) will accrue from the date of original issuance or, if interest has already been paid, from the most recent Scheduled Payment Date for which an interest payment was last made. Interest will be computed on the basis of a 360-day year comprised of twelve 30-day months. Interest on overdue principal, premium and Additional Amounts, if any, and interest on the Notes will accrue at a rate that is 2.00% higher than the then-applicable interest rate on such Notes.

# Form of Notes; Denomination and Registration

The Notes are being offered and sold in the United States or to, or for the account or benefit of, U.S. persons (within the meaning of Regulation S) (“U.S. persons”) solely to investors that are “qualified institutional buyers” within the meaning of Rule 144A under the Securities Act, which are deemed to have made the representations set forth in “Transfer Restrictions,” in transactions meeting the requirements of Rule 144A (the “Rule 144A Notes”).

The Notes also may be offered and sold outside the United States to persons that are not U.S. persons or persons acting for the account or benefit of U.S. persons which are deemed to have made the representations set forth in “Transfer Restrictions,” in Offshore Transactions (within the meaning of Rule 902 of Regulation S) pursuant to Regulation S (the “Regulation S Notes”).

Each of the Notes will be issued on the Issue Date in fully registered form, without interest coupons, only in denominations of U.S.$200,000 and integral multiples of U.S.$1,000 in excess thereof. No Notes will be issued in bearer form.

Each of the Rule 144A Notes and the Regulation S Notes will be initially issued in the form of one or more registered notes in global form, without interest coupons (the “Global Notes”), registered in the name of a nominee of DTC or another designated clearing system. The terms of the Indenture will provide for the issuance of definitive registered Notes only in certain limited circumstances. Notes traded in Panama will clear through Latinclear as participant in Clearstream. For more information, see “Book-Entry, Delivery and Form.”

# Payments and Paying Agents

The Issuer will make all payments on the Notes exclusively in such coin or legal currency of the United States as at the time of payment will be legal tender for the payment of public and private debts.

The Issuer will make payments of principal and interest on the Notes to the Indenture Trustee, which will pass such funds to the registered Noteholders. Initially, the Indenture Trustee will act as registrar, transfer agent and paying agent for the Notes.

The Issuer will pay interest on the Notes to the Persons in whose name the Notes are registered on the Record Date. Payments of principal and interest in respect of each global note will be paid by wire transfer of immediately available funds to DTC. Payments of principal and interest in respect of any certificated Notes will be made by Dollar check drawn on a bank in the United States and mailed to the holder of such Note at its registered address. Upon application by the holder of at least U.S.$10.0 million in aggregate principal amount of Notes to the specified corporate trust office of the Indenture Trustee or any paying agent not less than 15 days before the due date for any payment in respect of a Note, such payment may be made by transfer to a Dollar account maintained by the payee with a bank in the United States.

All payments will be subject in all cases to any applicable tax or other laws and regulations, but without prejudice to the provisions of “— Additional Amounts.” For the purposes of the preceding sentence, the phrase “applicable tax or other laws and regulations” will include any obligation on the Issuer to withhold or deduct from a payment pursuant to FATCA (as defined below). No commissions or expenses will be charged to the holders in respect of such payments.

Subject to any applicable abandoned property law, the Indenture Trustee and the paying agents will pay to the Issuer upon its request any monies held by them for the payment of principal or interest that remains unclaimed for two years, and, thereafter, holders entitled to such monies must look to the Issuer for payment as its general creditors. After the return of such monies by the Indenture Trustee or the paying agents to the Issuer, neither the Indenture Trustee nor the paying agents will be liable to the holders in respect of such monies.

# Transfer and Exchange

A holder may transfer or exchange Notes in accordance with the provisions of the Indenture. The registrar and the Indenture Trustee may require a holder, among other things, to furnish appropriate endorsements and transfer documents in connection with a transfer of Notes, including as discussed in “Book-Entry, Delivery and Form” herein.

Noteholders will be required to pay all taxes due on transfer. Neither the Issuer nor the Indenture Trustee will be required to (a) transfer or exchange any Note selected for redemption or (b) exchange any Note for a period of 15 days before a selection of Notes to be redeemed.

The Notes will be subject to certain additional restrictions on transfer and certification requirements, as further described under "Transfer Restrictions."

## Further Issues

The Indenture is unlimited in aggregate principal amount, although the issuance of Notes in this offering will be limited to U.S.$ million in aggregate principal amount. Subject to the terms of the Indenture (including but not limited to those described under the heading "Description of the Notes—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Indebtedness" and "—Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness"), the Issuer may from time to time, without the consent of the Noteholders, create and issue an unlimited principal amount of additional notes having the same terms and conditions, and with the same CUSIP numbers, as the Notes other than the issue date, the issue price, the first Scheduled Payment Date and the first date from which interest will accrue (the "Additional Notes"), so that such issue will be consolidated and form a single series with the outstanding Notes; provided that if any Additional Notes are not fungible with the Notes for United States federal income tax purposes, such Additional Notes will have a separate CUSIP number and ISIN from the Notes. There is no limit on the aggregate principal amount of Notes that may be outstanding at any time. In connection with the issuance of Additional Notes, the Issuer will send the Indenture Trustee an Officer's Certificate setting forth the amended amortization schedule for the Notes (including such Additional Notes).

The Notes and any Additional Notes subsequently issued under the Indenture will be substantially identical other than the issue date, the issue price, the first Scheduled Payment Date and the first date from which interest will accrue, and will be secured by the Liens on the Collateral on a pari passu basis. Unless the context otherwise requires, for all purposes of the Indenture and this "Description of the Notes," references to the Notes include any Additional Notes actually issued. The Notes and any Additional Notes subsequently issued under the Indenture will be treated as a single class for all purposes under the Indenture, including without limitation, waivers, amendments, redemptions and offers to purchase.

## Security

### Overview

The Collateral will consist of a security interest in and to:

- All trust accounts and all funds deposited from time to time in these accounts, in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement, the Intercreditor Agreement, and other Financing Documents (including, without limitation, project revenues);
- Property rights relating to the A&amp;R Mortgage over Immovable Assets over certain real estate, constituted by the Issuer in favor of the Panamanian Trustee, and any subsequent additions, as well as any monies or other rights resulting from the enforcement of such rights;
- Property rights relating to the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets constituted by the Issuer in favor of the Panamanian Trustee, and any monies or other rights resulting from the enforcement of such rights;
- All assigned rights (in Spanish "Derechos Cedidos") unconditionally assigned under the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement, including: (i) all economic rights of the Issuer to receive amounts due under the Assigned PPAs, (ii) all receivables from the sale of energy and/or power through the spot market or the regional market and other auxiliary services (iii) all economic rights to receive insurance proceeds in connection with an Event of Loss, (iv) all economic rights to receive any payment associated with a Condemnation Event, (v) all receivables corresponding to Panama law governed agreements that the Issuer is entitled to receive pursuant to the Security and Depositary Agreement and that must be transferred to the Onshore Accounts, including, without limitation, the

139

proceeds of the Assigned Contracts; the proceeds of Dispositions in accordance with the provisions of the Indenture and the Security and Depositary Agreement; the proceeds of any Permitted Investment (except for investments in Equity Interests held by the Issuer in any Permitted Expansion Subsidiaries); as well as any other Project revenues or other revenues of the Issuer related to the Project (except for the ETESA Transfer Payment), provided that and subject to the requirement that under the Security and Depositary Agreement such amounts must be deposited into the Onshore Accounts and (vi) indemnities of insurance, bonds and guarantees that the Issuer is entitled to receive under the Assigned PPAs;

- The Assigned Contracts conditionally assigned under the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement and other Material Project Documents assigned pursuant to the Security and Deposit Agreement;
- Rights under the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, as well as any assets, rights, or monies resulting from the enforcement of such pledge, until such time as the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement is replaced by a New Share Pledge Agreement;
- After the Corporate Reorganization, rights under the New Share Pledge Agreement, as well as any assets, rights, or monies resulting from the enforcement of such pledge;
- Any other assets, securities, monies, and rights generated by the above-mentioned Collateral, as well as any assets that, from time to time, are or must be transferred to the Panamanian Trustee by the Issuer or third parties, in accordance with the Financing Documents, and accepted by the Panamanian Trustee to be subject to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Security and Depositary Agreement, and other Financing Documents.

Upon the repayment of the Existing Facilities, the obligations of the Issuer under the Indenture, the Notes and each other Financing Document (as applicable) will be secured by a Security Interest, on a first-priority basis, in substantially all of the assets of the Issuer and the Equity Interests in the Issuer (subject to Permitted Liens, the Security and Depositary Agreement, and the Intercreditor Agreement), whether owned on the date of the Indenture or thereafter acquired (including Project Improvements to the extent required by "Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Funding of Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements"), which Security Interest will be shared on a pari passu basis with the Senior Creditors (all such assets and Equity Interests, as described in "Description of the Financing Documents—Description of the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement—Collateral", collectively, the "Collateral"). The Collateral will pledged to the Panamanian Trustee or pledged to the Collateral Agent, as applicable, in each case upon the repayment of the Existing Facilities for the benefit of the Secured Parties.

Effective as of the Existing Facilities Repayment Date:

(i) Except for the rights, title and interests (including security interests) of the Panamanian Trustee that will remain valid and in full force and effect under the Panamanian Security Documents, all rights, title and interests (including security interests) of the secured parties under the Existing Facilities in and to all of the Existing Facilities Collateral, will be released, satisfied and discharged as provided in item (d) below.

(ii) The obligations of the Issuer under the Indenture, the Notes, and each other Financing Document (other than Subordination Agreements) will be secured by the Collateral under the Security Documents, which Collateral will be shared on a pari passu basis among the Senior Creditors.

(iii) The Original Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Original Mortgage over Immovable Assets, the Original Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets and the Original Collateral Assignment Agreement will be amended and restated to reflect the terms and conditions of the Financing Documents, and the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the A&amp;R Mortgage over Immovable Assets, the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets, and the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement will become effective by their corresponding Panamanian Collateral Outside Date.

140

(iv) The Issuer or the Holding Company, as applicable, will execute and deliver all documents necessary to release and terminate any and all liens on the Existing Facilities Collateral (except for (i) the liens, security interests, collateral assignments, mortgages, security trusts and pledges created by the Original Panamanian Security Documents in favor of the Panamanian Trustee, that will remain valid and in full force and effect on and after the Issue Date in accordance with the Panamanian Security Documents, and (ii) the release of a certain pledge over the participation quotas of the Holding Company constituted to secure the Existing Mezzanine Credit Agreement, which shall be protocolized into Public Deed and filed with the Public Registry not later than sixty (60) calendar days from the Existing Facilities Repayment Date, provided that, if the Panamanian Public Registry (Registro Público de Panama) delays its review (calificación) of any of such documents or finds a defect in such document that prevents its registration, the Issuer shall have an additional 30 days to correct such defect and obtain its registration).

(v) Amounts standing to the credit of the accounts and related rights of the secured parties under the Existing Facilities will be deemed released without further action and be freely transferable in accordance with the terms of the security documents related to the Existing Facilities.

Notwithstanding anything clause (v) above, for the avoidance of doubt, upon the Existing Facilities Repayment Date, amounts standing to the credit of any such accounts will be deposited into Project Accounts as directed by the Issuer pursuant to the Funds Flow Memorandum and the New Debt Sworn Statement.

Additionally, after the repayment of the Existing Facilities and while the Notes are outstanding, the Notes will be secured by the Equity Interests in the Issuer, on a first priority basis initially by the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement. Thereafter and immediately after the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization, the Shareholders, as pledgers, the Panamanian Trustee, as pledgee, and the Issuer will enter into a new share pledge agreement whereby such Shareholders will grant a first priority share pledge governed by Panamanian law over all of the shares of the Issuer in favor of the Panamanian Trustee for the benefit of the beneficiaries of the Guaranty Trust (the "New Share Pledge Agreement").

For the avoidance of doubt, (A) none of the Equity Interests, assets or proceeds therefrom from a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary will be considered to be part of the Collateral or subject to any security interest for the benefit of the Secured Parties and (B) no Distributions from a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary will be required to be deposited into any of the Project Accounts or otherwise be applied in compliance with the Accounts Waterfall.

No appraisals of the Collateral on behalf of the Issuer have been prepared in connection with this offering of the Notes. There can be no assurance that the proceeds of any sale of the Collateral would be sufficient to satisfy amounts due on the Notes and the other Senior Debt Instruments. By its nature, some or all of the Collateral will be illiquid and may have no readily ascertainable market value. Accordingly, there can be no assurance that the Collateral would be sold in a timely manner or at all. Furthermore, the Collateral may be reduced or diluted under certain circumstances, including the issuance of Additional Notes, the entering into of other Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness, and the Disposition of assets comprising the Collateral, subject to the terms of the Indenture and the Security Documents. See “—Release of security”, “Risk Factors—The Notes will be secured only to the extent of the value of the assets that have been granted as security for the Notes.”, “Risk Factors—The Collateral securing the Notes may be diluted under certain circumstances”.

Neither the Indenture Trustee nor the Noteholders may, individually or collectively, take any direct action to enforce any rights in their favor under the Security Documents but may only act through the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, in accordance with the Intercreditor Agreement. See “—Enforcement of Security Interests.” See “Risk Factors—The rights of the holders of Notes with respect to the Collateral are subject to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement and the other Security Documents, which may materially limit the rights of the holders of the Notes to take enforcement actions, including with respect to the Collateral securing the Notes” and “Risk Factors—Realizing on a portion of the Collateral held by the Collateral Agent in respect of the Notes may require consent from or otherwise involve third parties.”

Certain security interests in the Collateral will not be in place or perfected on the Issue Date. The Issuer, the Shareholders and each other party granting a security interest will, however, ensure that all security interests in the Collateral are duly created and enforceable and perfected, to the extent required by the Security Documents, not later

than the Panamanian Collateral Outside Date. As a result, under certain circumstances, the Noteholders may not have the ability to foreclose, or control decisions in respect of, a portion or all of the Collateral until such time as an enforceable and perfected first-priority security interest has been created in the Collateral. See “Risk Factors—Risks Relating to the Notes and the Collateral.”

## Release of Security

Subject to the Intercreditor Agreement, the Collateral will be automatically released (and thereupon, the Security Interests granted in connection therewith, terminated and be discharged and be of no further force and effect) and the Collateral Agent and/or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable (acting at the direction of the Intercreditor Agent) will take any action required to effectuate any release of the Collateral granted upon the occurrence of the Discharge Date.

Additionally, certain portions of the Collateral will be automatically released (and thereupon, the Security Interests granted in connection therewith, terminated and be discharged and be of no further force and effect) in the event of certain Dispositions by the Issuer of assets forming part of the Collateral in accordance with any of the covenants under the captions “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Asset Sales” and “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets”. Furthermore, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable (acting at the direction of the Intercreditor Agent) may take additional action to effectuate the release of portions the Collateral in the circumstances described under the caption “—Amendment, Supplement and Waiver.” Any such release will be effected by the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable (acting at the direction of the Intercreditor Agent) without the need for the consent of the Noteholders.

Upon request by the Issuer to effect any release of Collateral, the Issuer will cause to be delivered to the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable (upon which they may conclusively rely) an Officer’s Certificate in substantially the form attached to the Indenture from the Issuer stating that all conditions precedent under each Financing Document to any such release, discharge and termination or other release have been satisfied.

## Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness

The Issuer may incur Indebtedness (in addition to other Senior Debt) that is secured by Liens on the Collateral (such Indebtedness and any guarantees of such Indebtedness, “Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness”); provided that:

(a) the Issuer was permitted to incur such Indebtedness under the covenant described under the caption “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer —Limitation on Indebtedness”;

(b) the creation of any Lien on the Collateral securing such Indebtedness was permitted under the covenant described under the caption “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer —Limitation on Liens”;

(c) the holders of such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness (or their representative) accede to

142

the Intercreditor Agreement;

(d) an Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account under such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness will be funded to the level of its reserve requirement, or will be so funded with the first disbursement of such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness, calculated after giving effect to the entering into of such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness;

(e) all obligations with respect to the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness will be secured under the Security Documents to the same extent and on the same basis as the Notes outstanding on the date the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness is entered into and the Issuer and each other grantor of security under the Security Documents will, to the extent required, enter into any additional security documents or amend, supplement or otherwise modify the Security Documents to which such entity is a party to effect the entering into the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness, and make all necessary filings so that all Notes (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any Additional Notes) and Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness, as applicable, are secured by a first-priority security interest in the Collateral;

(f) solely in the case of any Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness that bears interest at a floating rate, on or prior to the closing date thereof (and, for the avoidance of doubt, as a condition precedent to any disbursement thereunder), the Issuer will have entered into (and undertaken to maintain through the maturity date of any Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness), one or more Derivative Transactions in an aggregate notional amount equal to 100% of the outstanding principal amount of any such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness to be incurred thereunder, except that no such Derivative Transaction will be required in connection with any such indebtedness incurred for working capital or letters of credit (other than Letters of Credit pursuant to the LC Documents, which will be subject to the terms and conditions of the LC Facility Agreement);

(g) the interest payment dates for such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness will not fall on dates other than a Scheduled Payment Date and the principal payments for such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness will not fall on dates other than a Scheduled Payment Date; and

(h) the Issuer delivers to the Indenture Trustee an Officer's Certificate with respect to compliance with the conditions stated immediately above.
