Subject to certain intercreditor arrangements set forth under the caption “—Modification Approval Levels” below, the Indenture Trustee and the Intercreditor Agent will be permitted and authorized, without the consent of any Noteholder, to enter into any amendments to the Security Documents or the Indenture and take any other action necessary to permit the creation and registration of Liens on the Collateral to secure Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness in accordance with this paragraph.

## Intercreditor Agreement

On the Issue Date, the Issuer, the Intercreditor Agent, the Indenture Trustee, the Collateral Agent, the Panamanian Trustee, the LC Facility Administrative Agent and each Senior Creditor Group Representative, for its own benefit and the benefit of each such representative's respective Senior Creditor Group, will enter into the Intercreditor Agreement which will provide for, among other things: (a) the appointment of the Intercreditor Agent, by the Senior Creditors and (b) intercreditor arrangements between the Secured Parties with respect to security, payments, recoveries and certain decisions.

## Security Documents

Upon the occurrence of the Existing Facilities Repayment Date and the execution and delivery of the New Debt Sworn Statement by the Issuer setting forth the new secured obligations to be secured under the Original Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Issuer's obligations under the Notes, the Indenture and the other Senior Debt Instruments will be secured, on a first-priority and pari passu basis, by a security interest in the Existing Facilities Collateral as provided under the Original Panamanian Security Documents. The security interest granted in the Existing Facilities Collateral in favor of the secured parties of the Existing Facilities will be released and discharged

143

as described under the "Security" caption above.

On the Existing Facilities Repayment Date:

(a) the Security and Depositary Agreement will become effective; and
(b) the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the A&amp;R Chattel Mortgage over Movable Assets, the A&amp;R Mortgage over Immovable Assets and the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement will be executed and will become effective by their corresponding Panamanian Collateral Outside Date.

Additionally, no later than the applicable Panamanian Collateral Outside Date following any step in the Corporate Reorganization which results in a change to the shareholding of the Issuer's Equity Interests, a New Share Pledge Agreement will be entered into and become effective;

The Intercreditor Agreement provides that (except as otherwise permitted thereunder) the release of all or substantially all of the Collateral and the Security Interests requires a direction of each Senior Creditor Group Representative representing the applicable Senior Creditors that benefit from such relevant Collateral or such Security Interest. For a description of the Collateral, see "Description of the Collateral."

## Third Party Consents

The Third Party Consents include the consents to assignment governed by the laws of the State of New York between the Collateral Agent with each of the following entities:

(a) the LNG Supplier, with respect to the LNG Sale and Purchase Agreement;
(b) the Operator, with respect to the TUA and the OCA;
(c) the Services Provider, with respect to the ASA;
(d) LTSA Contractor with respect to the LTSA;
(e) the O&amp;M Manager, with respect to the O&amp;M Management Agreement; and
(f) each other Replacement Counterparty or Material Project Party required under the Financing Documents to be delivered, in each case, in the form and substance attached to the Indenture.

The Third Party Consents listed in items (a) through (e) above will be entered into on or around the Issue Date, and any Third Party Consent listed in item (f) will be entered into as described under the caption "—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Material Project Documents, etc."

## Accounts

## Offshore Accounts

Pursuant to the Security and Depositary Agreement, the Offshore Depositary Bank will establish, as applicable, the following Dollar-denominated collateral accounts in New York (collectively, the "Offshore Accounts"):

(a) Notes Debt Service Reserve Account: The Notes Debt Service Reserve Account (the "Notes Debt Service Reserve Account") will have a required balance at least equal to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement. It will be funded from the amounts received from the Revenue Account pursuant to the Accounts Waterfall and, if applicable, from the Distribution Suspense Account; provided that (i) funds held in the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account may be withdrawn to make payments of any amounts due on the Notes if and to the extent that the amounts held in the Notes Debt Service Payment Account are insufficient to make such payments and (ii) the Notes Debt

144

Service Reserve Account may be funded with cash, Letters of Credit or a combination of the foregoing.

(b) Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account(s): Each Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account (an “Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account”), when opened, will have the applicable minimum required balance, if any. It will be funded from the amounts received from the Revenue Account pursuant to the Accounts Waterfall and, if applicable, from the Distribution Suspense Account, and it may be funded with the proceeds of the underlying Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness related to such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account; provided that (i) funds held in each Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account may be withdrawn to make payments of any amounts due under the underlying Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness related to such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account if and to the extent that the amounts held in the corresponding Additional Indebtedness Account are insufficient to make such payments and (ii) the Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account may be funded with cash, stand-by letters of credit or a combination of the foregoing.

(c) O&amp;M Reserve Account: The O&amp;M Reserve Account (the “O&amp;M Reserve Account”) will have a required balance at least equal to the O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement. It will be funded from the amounts received from the Revenue Account pursuant to the Accounts Waterfall and, if applicable, from the Distribution Suspense Account; provided that, (i) funds held in the O&amp;M Reserve Account may be withdrawn to make payments of Operating Expenses if and to the extent that the amounts held in the O&amp;M Account are insufficient to make such payments and (ii) the O&amp;M Reserve Account may be funded with cash, Letters of Credit or a combination of the foregoing.

## Onshore Accounts

Pursuant to the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, the Panamanian Trustee has established or will establish, as applicable, the following Dollar-denominated collateral accounts in Panama (collectively, the “Onshore Accounts”):

(a) Market Clearing Account: The Market Clearing Account (the “Market Clearing Account”) will be funded, (i) automatically through the monthly clearing process undertaken by Banco de Gestión y Cobranza under the Panamanian Wholesale Electricity Market Regulations, with any amount due to the Issuer in respect of spot market transactions consummated during such month, (ii) from the Revenue Account, at such times and in such amounts as provided in the Accounts Waterfall, and (iii) if applicable, from the Distribution Suspense Account.

(b) Revenue Account: The Revenue Account (the “Revenue Account”) will be funded with (i) all the Project related revenues and any other amount received by the Issuer from time to time (other than any ETESA Transfer Payment), including equity contributions from or on behalf of any Shareholder or any other Affiliate of the Issuer (other than equity contributions described under “Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Funding of Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements”) and revenues from Power Purchase Agreements, LNG Transactions (other than in connection with Derivative Transactions entered into in connection with LNG Transactions) and other Power Transactions, whether or not otherwise specified therein, except to the extent such amounts are expressly required to be funded into another Project Account pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement (ii) any proceeds remaining in the Loss Proceeds Account once the restoration or the repair of the Project or continue of operations during such restoration is complete in accordance with the Indenture, that are not required to be deposited in the Prepayment Account, (iii) proceeds from Dispositions, that are not required to be deposited in the Prepayment Account, (iv) proceeds from Material Project Document Claims and termination payments under Material Project Documents not required to be deposited in the Prepayment Account, (v) funds transferred from the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, (vi) funds transferred from the Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, (vii) funds transferred from the O&amp;M Reserve Account pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, (viii) proceeds of any Permitted Indebtedness or Permitted Investment that are not required to be

145

deposited in any other Project Account pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, and (ix) proceeds from trust accounts in the Guaranty Trust to be closed pursuant to the Indenture and in accordance with the A&amp;R Guaranty Trust Agreement, provided that amounts received by the Issuer in connection with (A) the Issuer's sales of energy in the Panamanian spot market will be deposited in the Market Clearing Account and then, if any funds remain in the Market Clearing Account after making payments in connection with spot market transactions as set forth in the Security and Depositary Agreement, such remaining amounts will be deposited in the Revenue Account and (B) any ETESA Transfer Payment will be deposited in the Distribution Account. For the avoidance of doubt, no Distributions from a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary shall be required to be deposited into the Revenue Account or otherwise be applied in compliance with the Accounts Waterfall.

(c) LNG Account. The LNG Account shall be funded from (i) the Revenue Account, at such times and in such amounts as provided in the Accounts Waterfall, (ii) proceeds received by the Issuer from Derivative Transactions entered into in connection with LNG Transactions and (iii) if applicable, the Distribution Suspense Account.

(d) O&amp;M Account: The Operation and Maintenance Account (the "O&amp;M Account") will be funded from the Revenue Account, at such times as provided in the Accounts Waterfall and if applicable, form the Distribution Suspense Account.

(e) Loss Proceeds Account: The Loss Proceeds Account (the "Loss Proceeds Account") will be funded with certain insurance proceeds and condemnation proceeds in amounts not exceeding the thresholds set forth in the Security and Depositary Agreement.

(f) Debt Service Payment Accounts: The LC Debt Service Payment Account (the "LC Debt Service Payment Account"), the Notes Debt Service Payment Account (the "Notes Debt Service Payment Account") and, when opened, the Additional Indebtedness Accounts (the "Additional Indebtedness Accounts"), and together with the LC Debt Service Payment Account and the Notes Debt Service Payment Account, the "Debt Service Payment Accounts") will be funded from any amounts received from the Revenue Account pursuant to the accounts' waterfall (the "Accounts Waterfall") established under the Security and Depositary Agreement and, if applicable, from the Distribution Suspense Account. The Notes Debt Service Payment Account will also be funded from the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account, and each Additional Indebtedness Account will also be funded from its respective Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account, in each case, in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement.

(g) Prepayment Account: The Prepayment Account (the "Prepayment Account") will be funded from:

(i) the Net Available Proceeds in connection with an Event of Loss or series of Events of Loss, including as a result of a Condemnation Event, that are required to be applied to redeem or prepay any Senior Debt Obligations in accordance with the Financing Documents;

(ii) the Net Available Proceeds from an Asset Sale that are required to be applied to redeem or prepay any Senior Debt Obligations in accordance with the Financing Documents;

(iii) the Net Available Proceeds in connection with any Termination Payment received pursuant to any Material Project Document; and

(iv) the Net Available Proceeds in connection with any Material Project Document Claims received pursuant to any Material Project Document that are required to be applied to redeem or prepay any Senior Debt Obligations in accordance with the Financing Documents..

(h) Distribution Suspense Account: The Distribution Suspense Account (the "Distribution Suspense Account") will be funded from any amounts received from the Revenue Account pursuant to the

146

Accounts Waterfall; provided that the Issuer may withdraw from the Distribution Suspense Account the amounts required for the capital reduction described in the definition of Corporate Reorganization without the requirements to comply with the Distribution Conditions provided further that any such amounts to be paid or otherwise disbursed for such purposes shall not exceed U.S.$150 million in the aggregate.

(i) LC Collateral Account: The Letters of Credit Collateral Account (the "LC Collateral Account") will be funded with Cash Collateral in accordance with the LC Facility Agreement and all amounts transferred from the Prepayment Account in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement.

## Additional Indebtedness Accounts and Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Accounts

As instructed by the Issuer in writing (each such instruction, an "Additional Senior Indebtedness Instruction"), and solely to the extent the Issuer has incurred Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness or entered into Additional Indebtedness Documents, in each case, in compliance with the terms of the Financing Documents, as certified in writing by the Issuer in such Additional Senior Indebtedness Instruction, the Panamanian Trustee will establish one or more Additional Indebtedness Accounts in the name of the Panamanian Trustee and the Offshore Depositary Bank will establish one or more Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Accounts in the name of the Issuer; provided that, the Panamanian Trustee and the Offshore Depositary Bank, as applicable, as promptly as practicable, will open the Additional Indebtedness Account and/or the Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account requested to be opened without the need of any action or further instruction or consent from any Person, other than the initial instructions given by the Issuer.

Each Additional Senior Indebtedness Instruction so delivered by the Issuer, will:

(a) specify whether the Issuer is requesting the opening of an Additional Indebtedness Account and/or an Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account;

(b) if the Issuer is requesting the opening of an Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account, specify the reserve requirement of such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account;

(c) specify the type of Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness incurred or to be incurred by the Issuer that requires the opening of each such account;

(d) specify the Additional Indebtedness Documents entered into in connection therewith; and

(e) identify the Secured Parties providing such Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness and the Senior Creditor Group Representative acting on behalf of each such Senior Creditor Group and provide the account number of such Senior Creditor Group Representative, and the corresponding wire details of such account.

Commencing on the date that an Additional Indebtedness Account is opened pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, such Additional Indebtedness Account will be an Onshore Account. Commencing on the date an Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account is opened pursuant to the terms of the Security and Depositary Agreement, such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account will be an Offshore Account.

## Summary of Unsecured Accounts

The Issuer has established or will establish, as applicable, the following Dollar-denominated accounts in Panama (collectively, the "Unsecured Accounts") which will not be regarded as Project Accounts nor be part of the Collateral:

(a) Distribution Account: The distribution account (the "Distribution Account") will be funded from the amounts received from the Distribution Suspense Account, the Revenue Account, the Notes

147

Debt Service Reserve Account, the Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Accounts and the O&amp;M Reserve Account at such times and in such amounts set forth in the Security and Depositary Agreement. The Distribution Account will also be funded with any ETESA Transfer Payment.

(b) Local Accounts: The local accounts (the "Local Accounts") will be funded from the amounts received from the O&amp;M Account at such times and in such amounts set forth in the Security and Depositary Agreement, provided that the aggregate balance on deposit in all Local Accounts taken as a whole at any one time will not exceed U.S.$20 million, provided further that the limitation set forth in the previous proviso will not apply to any Local Account that is a payroll account or, if not segregated into a separate payroll account, funds in respect of payroll on deposit in any such Local Account so long as the funds on deposit in such Local Account or separate payroll account are used to pay Operating Expenses consisting of payroll with respect to employees of the Issuer.

## Cash Waterfall

The following is a general summary of the Accounts Waterfall. Reference is made to the Security and Depositary Agreement for a more complete description of the Accounts Waterfall.

The Issuer or the Collateral Agent will deliver to the Panamanian Trustee on each of the dates specified below, a Transfer Certificate or a Distribution Transfer Certificate or a written instruction of a responsible officer of the Issuer, as applicable, instructing the Panamanian Trustee to make withdrawals and transfers of amounts on deposit in the Revenue Account for application in the following order of priority and to the extent of available funds:

(a) First, on each Transfer Date, as and when required, to the Market Clearing Account for the amount set forth in the Documento de Transacciones Economicas (DTE) issued by the regulator of the Panamanian electricity market payable by the Issuer in connection with spot market transactions in an amount that, together with other amounts on deposit in the Market Clearing Account, does not exceed the amount due by the Issuer in respect of spot market transactions consummated during such month, plus the minimum balance required by the Banco de Gestion y Cobranza or Applicable Law to be maintained in the Market Clearing Account;

(b) Second, on each Transfer Date, to the LNG Account an amount that, together with the amounts then on deposit on the LNG Account, equals to the sum of LNG Costs, then due and payable or reasonably expected to be due and payable by the Issuer prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date and Ordinary Course Settlement Payments under each Permitted Hedging Instrument entered into in connection with LNG Transactions that are due or are reasonably expected to be due prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date;

(c) Third, on each Transfer Date, on a pro rata basis: (i) to the O&amp;M Account an amount that, combined with the current balance in the O&amp;M Account and each Local Account, equals the total amount of Operating Expenses not in connection with LNG Costs that are then due and payable or expected to become due and payable by the Issuer within the next 60 days; and (ii) to the Loss Proceeds Account, to the extent any insurance or condemnation proceeds are received in the Revenue Account, to cover any restoration or repair costs and expenses in respect to the event giving rise to proceeds;

(d) Fourth,

(i) on each Transfer Date (other than the Transfer Date occurring immediately prior to a Scheduled Payment Date or an Interest Payment Date or a Maturity Date with respect to the Loans) on a pro rata basis:

(A) to the Notes Debt Service Payment Account: (1) all amounts required to pay all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than interest and principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the holders of the Notes under the Notes Documents prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date; and (2) an amount equal to at least one sixth of the interest payable to each of the

148

holders of the Notes on the next Scheduled Payment Date following such Transfer Date;

(B) to the LC Debt Service Payment Account (1) all amounts required to pay all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than interest and principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the Lender Parties under the LC Facility Agreement prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date; and (2) an amount equal to at least one sixth of the interest payable to the Lender Parties under the LC Facility Agreement on the next Interest Payment Date following such Transfer Date;

(C) to each Additional Indebtedness Account (1) all amounts required to pay all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than interest and principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the Secured Parties under the Additional Indebtedness Documents related to such Additional Indebtedness Account prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date; and (2) an amount equal to at least one sixth of the interest payable to the Secured Parties under the Additional Indebtedness Documents related to such Additional Indebtedness Account on the next Interest Payment Date following such Transfer Date;

(D) to pay for Ordinary Course Settlement Payments (other than those relating to Derivative Transactions entered into in connection with LNG Transactions) that are due or are reasonably expected to be due under each Permitted Hedging Instrument prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date; and

(E) to the O&amp;M Account the amount of all taxes payable by the Issuer in respect of the aforementioned amounts; and

(ii) on each Transfer Date occurring immediately prior to a Scheduled Payment Date or an Interest Payment Date on a pro rata basis:

(A) to the Notes Debt Service Payment Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of the Notes Debt Service Payment Account to be equal to the sum of (1) the interest payable to each of the holders of the Notes on the immediately following Scheduled Payment Date after such Transfer Date plus (2) all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the holders of the Notes under the Indenture prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date;

(B) to the LC Debt Service Payment Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of the LC Debt Service Payment Account to be equal to the sum of (1) the interest payable under the LC Loans on the immediately following Interest Payment Date after such Transfer Date plus (2) all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the Lender Parties under the LC Facility Agreement prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date;

(C) to each Additional Indebtedness Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of such Additional Indebtedness Account to be equal to the sum of (1) the interest payable under the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness related to such Additional Indebtedness Account on the immediately following Interest Payment Date after such Transfer Date plus (2) all fees, costs, charges, expenses, indemnities, and other amounts (other than principal) due or reasonably expected to be due to the Secured Parties under the Additional Indebtedness Documents related to such Additional Indebtedness Account prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date;

149

(D) to pay for Ordinary Course Settlement Payments (other than those relating to Derivative Transactions entered into in connection with LNG Transactions) that are due or are reasonably expected to be due under each Permitted Hedging Instrument prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date; and

(E) to the O&amp;M Account the amount of all taxes payable by the Issuer in respect of the aforementioned amounts;

(e) Fifth,

(i) on each Transfer Date (other than the Transfer Date occurring immediately prior to a Scheduled Payment Date or an LC Maturity Date) on a pro rata basis:

(A) to the Notes Debt Service Payment Account, an amount equal to at least one sixth of the outstanding principal under the Notes due and payable on the immediately following Scheduled Payment Date or Notes Maturity Date after such Transfer Date;

(B) (1) to the LC Debt Service Payment Account, an amount equal to at least one twelfth of the outstanding principal under the LC Loans due and payable on the immediately following LC Maturity Date after such Transfer Date; and (2) to the LC Collateral Account, any other amount then due and payable in connection with the Cash Collateralization of Letters of Credit;

(C) to each Additional Indebtedness Account, an amount equal to at least one sixth of the outstanding principal under the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness due and payable on the immediately following Scheduled Payment Date or LC Maturity Date after such Transfer Date; and

(D) to pay for Hedging Termination Amounts that are due or are reasonably expected to be due under each Permitted Hedging Instrument prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date or LC Maturity Date; and

(ii) on each Transfer Date occurring immediately prior to a Scheduled Payment Date or an LC Maturity Date, on a pro rata basis:

(A) to the Notes Debt Service Payment Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of the Notes Debt Service Payment Account to be equal to the outstanding principal under the Notes due and payable on the immediately following Scheduled Payment Date after such Transfer Date;

(B) (1) to the LC Debt Service Payment Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of the LC Debt Service Payment Account to be equal to the outstanding principal under the LC Loans due and payable on the immediately following LC Maturity Date after such Transfer Date; and (2) to the LC Collateral Account, any other amount then due and payable in connection with the Cash Collateralization of Letters of Credit;

(C) to each Additional Indebtedness Account, an amount sufficient to cause the balance of such Additional Indebtedness Account to be equal to the outstanding principal under the Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness due and payable on the immediately following Scheduled Payment Date after such Transfer Date; and

(D) to pay for Hedging Termination Amounts that are due or are reasonably expected to be due under each Permitted Hedging Instrument prior to the immediately succeeding Transfer Date;

150

(f) Sixth, on each Transfer Date to the LC Debt Service Payment Account, the sum of the outstanding principal amount of any LC Loans;

(g) Seventh, on each Transfer Date, on a pro rata basis, (i) to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account an amount required (if any and taking into account any available undrawn amount of any DSR LC or Acceptable LC posted to the credit of the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account on such date) to cause the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account to be funded in an amount equal to the then-applicable Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement and (ii) to each Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account (if any) an amount required (if any and taking into account any available undrawn amount of any Acceptable LC posted to the credit of the Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account on such date) to cause such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account to be funded in an amount equal to its then-applicable reserve requirement;

(h) Eighth, on each Transfer Date, to the O&amp;M Reserve Account an amount required (if any and taking into account any available undrawn amount of any OMR LC or Acceptable LC posted to the credit of the O&amp;M Reserve Account on such date) to cause the O&amp;M Reserve Account to be funded in an amount equal to the then-applicable O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement;

(i) Ninth, on each Transfer Date, to pay any fees, interest, principal and other amounts that are due and payable under on such Transfer Date under any Permitted Indebtedness (other than Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness) to the extent required pursuant to the terms thereof; and

(j) Tenth, at the election of the Issuer, on each Distribution Date, all remaining amounts in the Revenue Account will be transferred to (i) the Distribution Suspense Account, if the Distribution Conditions are not met by such Distribution Date, or (ii) the Distribution Account, if the Distribution Conditions are met by the Distribution Date; provided that the Issuer may withdraw from the Distribution Suspense Account the amounts required for the capital reduction described in the definition of Corporate Reorganization without the requirements to comply with the Distribution Conditions; provided further that any such amounts to be paid or otherwise disbursed for such purposes shall not exceed U.S.$150 million in the aggregate.

Notwithstanding the priority of payments set forth above, on or concurrently with the Issue Date, the Issuer may withdraw from the Revenue Account the amount of the Retained Earnings Distribution described under "Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Distributions."

## Notes Debt Service Payment Account

Pursuant to the Security and Depositary Agreement, the Panamanian Trustee will transfer available funds on deposit in, or credited to, the Notes Debt Service Payment Accounts as instructed by the Issuer or the Collateral Agent, as applicable, in accordance with the order of priority set forth therein, which, in general terms, can be summarized as follows:

(a) First, to the payment of interest, fees and Additional Amounts due under the Notes and the Indenture; and

(b) Second, to the payment of any scheduled principal under the Notes then due and payable under the Indenture.

## Summary of Invasion of Accounts Procedure

The following is a general summary of the Security and Depositary Agreement and is not intended to be complete. Reference is made to the Security and Depositary Agreement for a more complete description of the procedure of invasion of Project Accounts.

(a) If at any time the funds on deposit in the Market Clearing Account are insufficient to make the transfers then required under the Security and Depositary Agreement (a "Market Clearing Account

151

Insufficiency"), a responsible officer of the Issuer may (unless an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in which case the Issuer will) issue a Transfer Certificate specifying the amount and cause of such Market Clearing Account Insufficiency and instructing the Offshore Depositary Bank or Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the following order of priority, to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such Market Clearing Account Insufficiency: (i) first, apply any funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account, and (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account.

(b) If the funds on deposit in the LNG Account are insufficient to pay LNG Costs or Ordinary Course Settlement Payments, under Permitted Hedging Instruments entered into in connection with LNG Transactions in each case, due and payable as of any date (such insufficiency, an "LNG Insufficiency"), then a responsible officer of the Issuer may, in the Issuer's sole discretion (unless an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, in which case the Issuer shall) deliver a Transfer Certificate specifying the amount and cause of such LNG Insufficiency and instructing the Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the order of priority set forth below to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such LNG Insufficiency: (i) first, apply any funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account and (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account.

(c) If the funds on deposit in the O&amp;M Account and the Local Accounts are insufficient to cover Operating Expenses (other than Operating Expenses that constitute LNG Costs) due and payable as of any date (an "O&amp;M Insufficiency"), a responsible officer of the Issuer may (unless an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in which case the Issuer will) issue a Transfer Certificate specifying the amount and cause of such O&amp;M Insufficiency and instructing the Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the following order of priority, to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such O&amp;M Insufficiency: (i) first, apply funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account, (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account, and (iii) third, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account and the Distribution Suspense Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the O&amp;M Reserve Account.

(d) If the funds on deposit in any Debt Service Payment Account is insufficient to make the transfers then required to be made under the Security and Depositary Agreement to make the relevant payments under any Senior Debt that is due and payable that is required to be paid out from such Debt Service Payment Account (a "Senior Debt Payment Insufficiency"), a responsible officer of the Issuer will issue a Transfer Certificate specifying the relevant amount of the Senior Debt Payment Insufficiency and instructing the Offshore Depositary Bank to make transfers, in a pro rata and pari passu basis among the Debt Service Payment Accounts in such amount (if any) and in the following order of priority to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such Senior Debt Payment Insufficiency: (i) first, apply funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account, (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account, (iii) third, to the extent amounts in the Distribution Suspense Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Prepayment Account, (iv) fourth, to the extent amounts in the Prepayment Account are not adequate for such purpose, and solely for the benefit of the Noteholders, apply any funds then on deposit in the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account (including making a drawing under any DSR LC), as provided in the Security and Depositary Agreement, and (v) fifth, to the extent amounts in the Prepayment Account are not adequate for such purpose, and solely for the benefit of the providers of any Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness, apply any funds then on deposit in the corresponding Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account (including making a drawing under any stand-by letter of credit posted to such account), as provided in the Security and Depositary Agreement.

152

(e) If the funds on deposit in the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account (after giving effect to any DSR LCs or Acceptable LCs posted to the credit of the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account) are insufficient to satisfy the Notes Debt Serve Reserve Requirement (such insufficiency, the “Notes Debt Service Reserve Account Insufficiency”), a responsible officer of the Issuer will issue a Transfer Certificate setting forth the amount of, and the cause for, such Notes Debt Service Reserve Account Insufficiency and directing the Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make one or more of the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the order of priority as set forth below to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such Notes Debt Service Reserve Account Insufficiency: (i) first, apply funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account, (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account, and (iii) third, to the extent amounts in the Distribution Suspense Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Prepayment Account.

(f) If the funds on deposit in any Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account (after giving effect to any Acceptable LCs posted to the credit of such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Account) are insufficient to satisfy the corresponding level of its reserve requirement (such insufficiency, a “Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Insufficiency”), a responsible officer of the Issuer will issue a Transfer Certificate setting forth the amount of, and the cause for, such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Insufficiency and directing Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make any one or more of the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the order of priority as set forth below to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Insufficiency: (i) first, apply funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account; (ii) second, to the extent amount in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account; and (iii) third, to the extent amounts in the Distribution Suspense Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Prepayment Account.

(g) If the funds on deposit in the O&amp;M Reserve Account (after giving effect to any OMR LCs or Acceptable LCs posted to the credit of the O&amp;M Reserve Account) are insufficient to satisfy the O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement (such insufficiency, the “O&amp;M Reserve Account Insufficiency”), a responsible officer of the Issuer will issue a Transfer Certificate setting forth the amount of, and the cause for, such O&amp;M Reserve Account Insufficiency and directing the Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to make one or more of the following transfers in such amount (if any) and in the order of priority as set forth below to the extent of available funds and as needed to cure such O&amp;M Reserve Account Insufficiency: (i) first, apply funds then on deposit in the Revenue Account, and (ii) second, to the extent amounts in the Revenue Account are not adequate for such purpose, apply any funds then on deposit in the Distribution Suspense Account.

(h) If a Market Clearing Account Insufficiency, an O&amp;M Insufficiency, a Senior Debt Payment Insufficiency, a Notes Debt Service Reserve Account Insufficiency, an Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Insufficiency, and/or an O&amp;M Reserve Account Insufficiency exist concurrently, the Issuer will instruct the Offshore Depositary Bank or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to, first, cure any such Market Clearing Account Insufficiency, second, cure any such O&amp;M Insufficiency, third, cure any such Senior Debt Payment Insufficiency, fourth, cure any such Notes Debt Service Reserve Account Insufficiency and Additional Required Debt Service Reserve Insufficiency (on a pro rata basis), and fifth, cure any such O&amp;M Reserve Account Insufficiency.

## Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds

The proceeds of the Notes (after payment of transaction fees and expenses related to the issuance of the Notes and the LC Facility, including the Initial Purchasers’ fees and expenses related to the issuance of the Notes) will be applied in the following order of priority, in accordance with the Funds Flow Memorandum:

153

(a) first, on a pari passu basis, to pay any fees, interest, default interest, costs and expenses, breakage or premia and to repay any principal amount due and payable under the Existing Facilities;

(b) second, to the pro rata payment of all fees and moneys then due and payable to any of the Agents under the Financing Documents relating to services rendered in their respective capacities as agents, in each case in accordance with the Financing Documents;

(c) third, to fund (i) the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account in an amount equal to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement in the event one or more Letters of Credit in an aggregate stated amount equal to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement have not been posted to the credit of the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account on the Issue Date, and (ii) the O&amp;M Reserve Account in an amount equal to the O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement in the event one or more Letters of Credit in an aggregate stated amount equal to the O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement have not been posted to the credit of the O&amp;M Reserve Account on the Issue Date; and

(d) fourth to the extent of any remaining funds, on the Issue Date, (i) to make a capital reduction and an intercompany loan to the Holding Company and (ii) after making any such disbursement contemplated in (i) hereto, to deposit the remaining funds in the Distribution Suspense Account for use in connection with the Corporate Reorganization and subject to the limitation set forth under "Covenants—Limitation on Distributions."

## Voting and Decision-Making

Subject to the limitations set forth below under this section, each Senior Creditor Group may agree to a Modification under or to its own Senior Debt Instruments in accordance with the terms of such Senior Debt Instruments. Terms of the Senior Debt Obligations and the Financing Documents may be amended, modified, supplemented or extended from time to time, and the aggregate amount of the Senior Debt Obligations under the Financing Documents may be increased or refinanced, in each event, without notice to or consent (except to the extent consent is required under any Senior Debt Instrument) by any Secured Party that is not a party to such Financing Document and without affecting the provisions of the Intercreditor Agreement.

## By Noteholders

Under the Intercreditor Agreement the Noteholders will be represented by the Indenture Trustee, who will act as the Noteholders' Senior Creditor Group Representative.

The Indenture will address the manner in which Noteholders may instruct the Indenture Trustee to vote on their behalf, including in respect of the provision of instructions or votes to the Indenture Trustee in accordance with the applicable procedures of DTC to facilitate such vote (including causing any notice to be processed through the DTC's Automated Tender Offer Program ("ATOP") procedures or any successor thereto). The Indenture Trustee will have no responsibility or liability for the terms or requirements of any such systems or procedures offered by DTC, or any unavailability thereof. The Indenture will also address the manner in which the Indenture Trustee will vote (or otherwise provide directions to the Intercreditor Agent) without the consent, direction, instruction or any other notice from Noteholders. Except in circumstances expressly provided in the Indenture and the Intercreditor Agreement, the Indenture Trustee may refrain from voting (or otherwise providing directions to the Intercreditor Agent) and will have no liability for any such failure to provide such vote to the Intercreditor Agent (or otherwise providing directions to the Intercreditor Agent).

## By Hedging Banks

No Hedging Bank will be entitled to vote on or consent to decisions on any matter under the Intercreditor Agreement or any other Security Document or to instruct the Intercreditor Agent; provided that, no Modification may be made to certain Sections of the Intercreditor Agreement and certain defined terms under the Intercreditor Agreement, in each case, without the consent of each Hedging Bank materially adversely affected thereby.

Each Hedging Bank will have the right to declare an event of default or termination event under its respective Permitted Hedging Instrument, and at any time thereafter take such actions as are permitted under its Permitted

154

Hedging Instrument, in each case as, when and on the terms and conditions provided in its Permitted Hedging Instrument, subject to the Intercreditor Agreement, including the above paragraph. If any such actions are taken by any such Senior Creditor Group, the related Senior Creditor Group Representative will promptly notify the Intercreditor Agent (who in turn will promptly notify each other Senior Creditor Group Representative) of any such action.

## By the Issuer and its Affiliates

The Issuer and its Affiliates will have no right to consent (or not consent), otherwise act or direct or require the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent, the Panamanian Trustee or any Senior Creditor Group Representative to take (or refrain from taking) any action, and all Senior Debt held by the Issuer and its Affiliates will be deemed to be not outstanding for all purposes of calculating whether a required voting threshold has been met, but will be considered outstanding for all other purposes.

## Modification Approval Levels

Modifications to (i) any Security Document, any Subordination Agreement or Third Party Consents may only be made by the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, acting at the direction of the Intercreditor Agent (as instructed by Senior Creditor Group Representatives representing a Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors entitled to vote with respect thereto) and (ii) to the Intercreditor Agreement may only be made by the Intercreditor Agent (as instructed by Senior Creditor Group Representatives representing a Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors entitled to vote with respect thereto) and the Issuer; provided that, the following Modifications may not be made without the consent of each Senior Creditor Group Representative, subject to the rights of the Hedging Banks under “—By Hedging Banks” above, of any materially adverse affected Senior Creditor that is a party to the Intercreditor Agreement and is entitled to vote with respect to:

(a) Modifications relating to the ranking of the Senior Debt Obligations;

(b) Modifications relating to any pro rata payment under the Intercreditor Agreement or under any Security Document;

(c) Modifications to the order of payments in any cash waterfall set forth in any Security Document or the order of payments in “—Order of Application”, in each case in a manner that adversely affects the rights of any Senior Creditor;

(d) Modifications to the list of creditor actions set out in (a) through (h) hereof or Modifications of any other term of the Intercreditor Agreement that expressly requires the consent or agreement of all Senior Creditor Group Representatives or all Senior Creditors;

(e) Modifications to the definition of “Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors” as used in the Intercreditor Agreement, or any other term or provision under the Intercreditor Agreement relating to the way voting entitlements or rights are exercised thereunder;

(f) Modifications to any capitalized term defined in the Indenture that is incorporated by reference to any Security Document (solely for purposes of such amended term in such Security Document), in a manner that adversely affects the right of any Senior Creditor; and

(g) Modifications any other thresholds for voting among Senior Creditor Groups in the Intercreditor Agreement in any way adverse to any Senior Creditor Group.

Without the consent of any Noteholder or any other Person, the Intercreditor Agent may, and may instruct each other Agent to, at the direction of any Senior Creditor Group Representative, enter into one or more Modifications of the Security Documents, any Subordination Agreement or Third Party Consent, as applicable, solely to:

(a) cure any immaterial ambiguity, defect or inconsistency;

155

(b) provide for any other ministerial actions with respect to matters arising under such Financing Documents (including any such Modifications to incorporate appropriate ministerial provisions with respect to the Loans or the Notes);

(c) make any change that would provide any additional rights or benefits to the Secured Parties;

(d) make, complete or confirm any grant of Collateral permitted or required by the Security Documents or any release of any Collateral or guarantee that is otherwise expressly permitted under the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement and permitted (if addressed therein, or, otherwise, not prohibited) by the terms of the applicable Financing Documents;

(e) correct any typographical errors, drafting mistakes or other similar mistakes that do not modify the intended rights, benefits and obligations of the parties hereto, in each case, which do not involve any material change;

(f) enter into any Modification proposed by the Issuer to any Security Document, so long as (i) the Modification is permitted (if addressed therein, or, otherwise, not prohibited) by the terms of each then existing Financing Document to be made without such consent and (ii) the Intercreditor Agent will have received, at least five Business Days prior to the date of the proposed Modification, a certificate of the Issuer (copied to each Senior Creditor Group Representative) certifying as to clause (i) above and specifying the relevant provision(s) in each such Financing Document permitting such Modification, and attaching the proposed Modification; or

(g) enter into any Modification proposed by the Issuer to any Security Document, so long as (i) such Modification relates to a particular Series of Senior Debt Obligations, (ii) such Modification is permitted (if addressed therein, or, otherwise, not prohibited) to be made without such consent by the terms of each then existing Financing Documents, (iii) such Modification does not adversely affect the Secured Parties of any other Series of Senior Debt Obligations, and (iv) the Agents will have received, at least five Business Days prior to the date of the proposed Modification, a certificate of the Issuer (copied to each Senior Creditor Group Representative) certifying as to clauses (i), (ii) and (iii) above and specifying the relevant provision(s) of each Financing Document permitting such Modification, and attaching the proposed Modification; provided that, such actions will not adversely affect the interests of any Senior Creditor Group.

No Agent will (a) release or surrender (or instruct the release or surrender) of all or substantially all of the Collateral or the Security Interests, (b) agree to the termination of any Security Document, or (c) the Modification of any Security Document that has the effect of releasing or surrendering all or substantially all of the Collateral or the Security Interests, or modifying the priority of the Security Interests, except upon receipt of a direction to that effect from each Senior Creditor Group Representative representing all Senior Creditors that benefit from such relevant Collateral or such relevant Security Interest. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Security Interests will be released, and to the extent permitted under Applicable Law, will be automatically released, in the following events: (i) upon the termination of the Intercreditor Agreement after the occurrence of the Discharge Date, and (ii) in respect of Security Interests over any assets constituting Collateral that are sold, leased or otherwise disposed of or any other disposition of Collateral, to the extent such release is expressly permitted under the terms of the Financing Documents.

In connection with any Decision or vote under the Intercreditor Agreement:

(a) all actions by the Senior Creditors (acting through their respective Senior Creditor Group Representatives) under the Intercreditor Agreement and in respect of any other Security Document, Subordination Agreement or Third Party Consent will be taken on a "block voting" basis whereby each Senior Creditor Group Representative will, with respect to the matters on which it has the right to vote, act as a unanimous block in respect of all of the outstanding principal amount of the Senior Debt held by the Senior Creditors it represents. For the avoidance of doubt, subject to the terms of the Indenture, all Noteholders will act as one Senior Creditor Group and will be represented by the Indenture Trustee acting as the Senior Creditor Group Representative;

156

(b) except as otherwise provided in the Intercreditor Agreement with respect to Hedging Banks, each Senior Creditor Group Representative will have a number of votes in any Intercreditor Vote equal to the portion (in U.S. Dollars) of the aggregate outstanding principal amount of the Senior Debt Obligations owed to the Senior Creditors represented by (or, in the case of any Hedging Bank, the Hedging Bank Voting Amount) in relation to the aggregate outstanding principal amount of all Senior Debt Obligations (including any Hedging Bank Voting Amount). Without limitation of clause (a) above, in calculating the Voting Party Percentage consenting to, approving, waiving or otherwise providing direction with respect to any Decision, the total number of votes cast by all Senior Creditors (through their Senior Creditor Group Representative) in favor of the proposed Decision (the "Numerator") will be divided by the total number of votes entitled to be cast with respect to such matter (the "Denominator");

(c) if, within 45 Business Days or such longer period as will be prescribed by the Intercreditor Agent (but in no event to exceed 120 days) (the "Decision Date") at the direction of the Person requesting that an Intercreditor Vote be taken pursuant to the Intercreditor Agreement (the "Decision Period"), the Voting Party Percentage of the relevant Intercreditor Vote is equal to or greater than that required to consent to and affirm the proposed consent, approval, direction or other action, such proposed Decision will be considered approved and no Secured Party will have any right to object to any of the terms or provisions contained in the Intercreditor Vote, or the operation thereof, or in any manner to question the approval thereof, or to enjoin or restrain the Intercreditor Agent or any Agent from executing the same or from taking any action pursuant to the provisions thereof; and

(d) if, by the Decision Date, a Senior Creditor does not respond by indication of its approval or disapproval of any Intercreditor Vote, then the number of votes of such Senior Creditor (through its Senior Creditor Group Representative) in such Intercreditor Vote (as determined in accordance with clause (b) above) will be deemed to be cast against the proposed Decision for the purpose of calculating the Voting Party Percentage as set forth in clause (b) above; provided that, except in cases where DTC's ATOP procedures (or any successor procedure thereto) are utilized or in the case of any voting notice issued in connection with any Security Enforcement Action Initiation Direction, any Noteholder that does not vote affirmatively or negatively in connection with any decision within the prescribed period for such Intercreditor Vote will be excluded from both the Numerator and Denominator of the calculation described in clause (b) above; provided, further, that in all cases in which the Indenture Trustee is required to notify Noteholders of any Intercreditor Vote (including any solicitation to such Noteholders to provide their approval or disapproval of the relevant Intercreditor Vote) the Indenture Trustee may require the Issuer to prepare a notice to the Noteholders so that such notice or solicitation is eligible in accordance with the applicable procedures at DTC to facilitate such vote, including causing such notice to be processed through DTC's ATOP (or any successor thereto), which among other things may only allow the Noteholders to provide an affirmative vote.

## Enforcement of Security Interests

### Initiation of Security Enforcement Action

Upon the occurrence and continuance of an Event of Default under its Senior Debt Instrument, any Senior Creditor Group Representative that represents a Senior Creditor Group of a Senior Debt Instrument under which an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, may deliver to the Intercreditor Agent a written direction to initiate a Security Enforcement Action (such direction, a "Security Enforcement Action Initiation Direction"), which will comply with the content requirements set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement. For purposes of the Intercreditor Agreement descriptions included herein, an "Event of Default" will mean an event of default as defined in the Indenture, the LC Facility Agreement or any document governing the terms of any Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness.

Promptly following the receipt of a Security Enforcement Action Initiation Direction, the Intercreditor Agent will deliver a copy thereof to each Senior Creditor Group Representative together with a notice in connection therewith, and request each Senior Creditor Group Representative to ask the Senior Credit Group it represents to vote on the directed Security Enforcement Action, which vote will be conducted in accordance with terms of the

157

Intercreditor Agreement.

Promptly following the receipt of a Security Enforcement Action Initiation Direction that has been approved by the Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors, the Intercreditor Agent will deliver a notice (such notice, a “Notice of Security Enforcement Action”) to each Senior Creditor Group Representative, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee confirming that the Intercreditor Agent has received a Security Enforcement Action Initiation Direction that has been approved by the Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors and directing the relevant Agents to take the directed Security Enforcement Action, subject to the terms and conditions of the Intercreditor Agreement. Each of the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee will be entitled to receive indemnity or security from the Secured Parties to its reasonable satisfaction against all fees, expenses and any other amounts and liabilities in acting upon any directed Security Enforcement Action.

## Conduct of Security Enforcement Action

Subject to initiation of a Security Enforcement Action having been duly approved, the Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors will be entitled to provide subsequent instructions regarding the conduct of the specified Security Enforcement Action that has previously been initiated. Such instructions will include all necessary instructions (in form reasonably satisfactory to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable): (i) directing the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to enforce (A) the Collateral or the Security Interests, including by liquidating or selling the Collateral or any part thereof or otherwise or by the exercise of the power of entry and/or sale conferred pursuant to the Security Documents and/or (B) to enforce any Subordination Agreement or any Third Party Consent; and (ii) directing the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, to enforce (A) the Collateral or the Security Interests, including by liquidating or selling the Collateral or any part thereof or otherwise or by the exercise of the power of entry and/or sale conferred pursuant to the Security Documents and/or (B) to enforce any Subordination Agreement or any Third Party Consent.

## Order of Application

Upon the authorization to commence a Security Enforcement Action, the Intercreditor Agent will establish and thereafter maintain in its name a segregated bank account in the United States (such account, the “Enforcement Proceeds Account”) for the purpose of depositing therein the proceeds received from any Agent of any Security Enforcement Action related to the Collateral (net of costs and expenses of such action incurred by the Intercreditor Agent) and all proceeds otherwise received for satisfaction of the Senior Debt Obligations; provided that, notwithstanding anything in the Intercreditor Agreement to the contrary, (i) with respect to any proceeds attributable to the Notes Excluded Collateral, the Intercreditor Agent will transfer or direct the transfer of all such proceeds to the Indenture Trustee, for application as set forth under the caption “—Order of Application—Notes Excluded Collateral”, (ii) with respect to any proceeds attributable to the LC Excluded Collateral, the Intercreditor Agent will transfer or direct the transfer of all such proceeds to the LC Collateral Account, for application in accordance with the Intercreditor Agreement and (iii) with respect to any proceeds attributable to the Additional Indebtedness Excluded Collateral, the Intercreditor Agent will transfer or direct the transfer of all such proceeds to the Senior Creditor Group Representative, for application in accordance with the Intercreditor Agreement.

All monies held in the Enforcement Proceeds Account will be trust funds held by the Intercreditor Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties for the purpose of making payments in the following order of priority:

(a) first, to payment of that portion of the Secured Party Fees then due and payable to the Agents, in their respective capacities as such, or any of their respective agents and sub-agents, and, after the foregoing payments, to reimbursement of any such amounts paid by way of indemnity by any Secured Party;

(b) second, to the payment of that portion of any fees, costs, indemnities, charges, disbursements, liabilities and expenses (including legal fees and expenses”) due and payable to any other Secured Party not paid in clause (a) above;

(c) third, to the pro rata payment among the holders thereof, of that portion of the Senior Debt Obligations constituting unpaid interest (including default interest and any Ordinary Course Settlement Payments under any Permitted Hedging Instrument);

158

(d) fourth, to the pro rata payment among the holders thereof, of that portion of the Senior Debt Obligations constituting unpaid principal and Hedging Termination Amounts;
(e) fifth, to the pro rata payment among the holders thereof, of other Senior Debt Obligations; and
(f) sixth, upon the occurrence of the Discharge Date with respect to all (but not less than all) of the Senior Debt Obligations, to the Issuer or as otherwise required by Applicable Law.

## Order of Application – Notes Excluded Collateral

If an Indenture Event of Default will have occurred and be Continuing, the Indenture Trustee (acting on the instructions of the Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors), may instruct the Intercreditor Agent to instruct each applicable Agent to apply (or cause to be applied), and each Agent hereby undertakes to apply, all or a portion of amounts on deposit in, or credited to, the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account, as follows (in each case as such amounts are notified by the Indenture Trustee to the Intercreditor Agent):

(a) first, on a pro rata basis to payment of that portion of Additional Amounts, any fees, costs, indemnities, charges, disbursements, liabilities and expenses (including legal fees and expenses) and all other amounts due and payable to any Noteholder (other than interest and principal);
(b) second, on a pro rata basis to the payment of that portion of the Senior Debt Obligations owed to the Noteholders constituting unpaid interest;
(c) third, on a pro rata basis to the payment of that portion of the Senior Debt Obligations owed to the Noteholders constituting unpaid principal;
(d) fourth, on a pro rata basis to the payment of any other Senior Debt Obligations owed to the Noteholders not otherwise paid pursuant to paragraphs (a) through (c) above; and
(e) fifth, upon the occurrence of the Discharge Date with respect to the Senior Debt Obligations owed to the Noteholders, any remaining amounts to the Enforcement Proceeds Account for application as set forth under the caption “—Order of Application”.

None of the actions referred to under the caption “—Order of Application – Notes Excluded Collateral” will be deemed to constitute a Security Enforcement Action.

## Additional Amounts

The Issuer will make payments of, or in respect of, principal, premium (if any) and interest on the Notes free and clear of, and without withholding or deduction for or on account of any present or future tax, levy, impost, duty, assessment or other charge of whatever nature levied by any Governmental Authority, irrespective of the manner in which they are collected or assessed, including any interest, additions to tax or penalties applicable thereto (“Taxes”), unless such withholding or deduction is required by law.

If the Issuer or any paying agent is required to deduct or withhold any amount in respect of Taxes for the account of Panama (or any political subdivision thereof or any authority therein or thereof having the power to tax) or any other jurisdiction (or any political subdivision or any authority thereof or therein) in which the Issuer is organized or otherwise resident or carrying on a trade or business for tax purposes or from or through which payments on the Notes are made by or on behalf of the Issuer (including the jurisdiction of any paying agent) (each, a “Relevant Jurisdiction”), the Issuer will pay to a Noteholder such additional amounts (“Additional Amounts”) as may be necessary so that the net amount received by such Noteholder will not be less than the amount such Noteholder would have received if such Taxes had not been withheld or deducted, it being understood that for Panamanian tax purposes the payment of such Additional Amounts will be deemed and construed as additional interest.

159

The foregoing obligation to pay Additional Amounts to any Noteholder, however, will not apply to or in respect of:

(a) any Taxes that would not have been so imposed, assessed, levied or collected but for the fact that the holder or beneficial owner of the Note (or a fiduciary, settlor, beneficiary, member or shareholder of, or possessor of a power over, such holder, if such holder is an estate, trust, partnership or corporation) having some present or former connection with a Relevant Jurisdiction, including such holder of the Note (i) being or having been a domiciliary, national or resident of the Relevant Jurisdiction, (ii) engaging or having been engaged in a trade or business in the Relevant Jurisdiction, (iii) maintaining or having maintained an office, a permanent establishment or branch in the Relevant Jurisdiction or (iv) being or having been physically present in the Relevant Jurisdiction, except for a connection solely arising from mere ownership of the Note, receiving payments of any nature on the Note, or enforcing rights under the Note;

(b) any Taxes that would not have been so imposed, assessed, levied or collected but for the fact that, where presentation is required in order to receive payment, the Note was presented more than 30 days after the date on which such payment became due and payable or was provided for, whichever is later, except to the extent that the holder or beneficial owner thereof would have been entitled to Additional Amounts had the Note been presented for payment on the last day of such 30-day period;

(c) any estate, inheritance, gift, sales, use, stamp, transfer, excise, or personal property or similar Taxes;

(d) any Taxes that are not payable by way of deduction or withholding from payments on or in respect of the applicable Note;

(e) any Taxes that would not have been so imposed, assessed, levied or collected but for the failure by the holder or the beneficial owner of the Note to provide any certification, identification, information, documentation or other evidence or information concerning the nationality, residence or identity of the holder or the beneficial owner or its connection with a Relevant Jurisdiction, if (i) compliance is required by statute, rule, regulation or administrative practice of a Relevant Jurisdiction as a condition to relief, reduction or exemption from all or part of such Taxes and (ii) the Issuer has given the holders, or beneficial owners, as applicable at least 30 days' written notice prior to the first payment date with respect to which such certification, identification, information, documentation or other evidence is required to the effect that holders or beneficial owners will be required to provide such information and identification;

(f) any payment on the Note to a holder that is a fiduciary, a partnership or any person other than the sole beneficial owner of any such payment to the extent that a beneficiary or settlor with respect to such fiduciary, a partner of such partnership or the beneficial owner of the payment would not have been entitled to the Additional Amounts had the beneficiary, settlor, partner or beneficial owner been the holder of the Note; or

(g) any combination of the Taxes and/or withholdings or deductions described in (a) through (f) above.

The limitations on the Issuer's obligations to pay Additional Amounts set forth in clause (e) above will not apply if the provision of information, documentation or other evidence described in such clause (e) would be materially more onerous, in form, in procedure or in the substance of information disclosed, to a holder or beneficial owner of a Note, than comparable information or other reporting requirements imposed under U.S. tax law, regulations (including temporary or proposed regulations) and administrative practice.

In addition, clause (e) above does not require, and will not be construed to require, that any holder, including any non-Panamanian pension fund, retirement fund, tax-exempt organization or financial institution, register, to the extent applicable, with the Panamanian Ministry of Economy and Finance (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas) or the Dirección General de Ingresos to establish eligibility for an exemption from, or a reduction of, Panamanian withholding taxes.

160

As provided in “—Payments and Paying Agents,” all payments in respect of the Notes will be made subject to any withholding or deduction required pursuant to Section 1471(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), or otherwise imposed pursuant to Sections 1471 through 1474 of the Code, as amended, as of the Issue Date (or any amended or successor version that is substantively comparable and not materially more onerous to comply with), any current or future regulations interpretations thereof, any agreement entered into pursuant to Section 1471(b) of the Code, any intergovernmental agreement entered into in connection with the implementation of such Sections of the Code, as amended, and any fiscal or regulation legislation, rules or practices adopted pursuant to such intergovernmental agreement (collectively, “FATCA”), and the Issuer will not be required to pay any Additional Amounts on account of any such deduction or withholding required pursuant to FATCA.

Unless otherwise stated, references in any context to the payment of principal of, and premium, if any, or interest on, any Note, will be deemed to include payment of Additional Amounts to the extent that, in such context, Additional Amounts are, were or would be payable in respect thereof.

The Issuer will also pay any present or future stamp, court or documentary taxes or other excise or property taxes, charges or similar levies which arise in any jurisdiction from the execution, delivery or registration in respect of the Notes, and the Issuer agrees to indemnify and/or provide security to each Agent and the Noteholders for any such amounts paid or incurred by any such party.

If the Issuer will be obligated to pay Additional Amounts with respect to any payment under or with respect to the Notes, the Issuer will deliver to the Indenture Trustee, at least three Business Days prior to the relevant payment date, an Officer’s Certificate stating the fact that such Additional Amounts will be payable, the amounts so payable and will set forth such other information necessary to enable the paying agent to pay such Additional Amounts to the Noteholders on the payment date. Each such Officer’s Certificate will be relied upon by the Indenture Trustee without further enquiry until receipt of a further Officer’s Certificate addressing such matters.

## Redemption of the Notes

### Optional Redemption with Make-Whole Amount

At any time prior to , the Issuer may redeem the Notes at its option, in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, at a redemption price (expressed as a percentage of principal amount and rounded to three decimal places) equal to the greater of:

(a) (i) the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest thereon discounted to the redemption date (assuming the Notes matured on the Par Call Date (as defined below)) on a semi-annual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the Treasury Rate plus basis points less (ii) interest accrued to the date of redemption, and
(b)  $100\%$  of the principal amount of the Notes to be redeemed,

plus, in either case, accrued and unpaid interest thereon to the redemption date, and Additional Amounts, if any.

“Treasury Rate” means, with respect to any redemption date, the yield determined by the Issuer in accordance with the following two paragraphs.

The Treasury Rate will be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third business day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as “Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15” (or any successor designation or publication) (“H.15”) under the caption “U.S. government securities–Treasury constant maturities–Nominal” (or any successor caption or heading) (“H.15 TCM”). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer will select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period (the “Remaining Life”) from the redemption date to the date that reflects the remaining weighted average life of the Notes (assuming the last

161

amortization payment on the Notes is made on the Par Call Date) (the "WAL Date"); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields – one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life – and will interpolate to the WAL Date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 will be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.

If on the third business day preceding the redemption date H.15 TCM is no longer published, the Issuer will calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second business day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to, the WAL Date, as applicable. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the WAL Date but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the WAL Date, one with a maturity date preceding the WAL Date and one with a maturity date following the WAL Date, the Issuer will select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the WAL Date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the WAL Date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer will select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security will be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.

The Issuer's actions and determinations in determining the redemption price will be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error and the Indenture Trustee will have no obligation to confirm or verify any such calculation.

Unless the Issuer defaults in payment of the redemption price, on and after the redemption date interest will cease to accrue on the Notes or portions thereof called for redemption.

## Optional Redemption without Make-Whole Amount

At any time on and after , the Issuer may, at its option and on one or more occasions, on at least 10 days' but not more than 60 days' notice, redeem all or a part of the Notes at the redemption prices (expressed as percentages of principal amount of the Notes to be redeemed) set forth below, plus accrued and unpaid interest thereon, up to, but not including, the date of redemption, and Additional Amounts, if any.

|  Year | Percentage  |
| --- | --- |
|  ... | 102%  |
|  ... | 101%  |
|  (the “Par Call Date”) and thereafter... | 100%  |

## Redemption for Changes in Withholding Taxes
