The Issuer may at any time redeem the Notes at its option, in whole, but not in part, at a redemption price equal to 100% of the then-outstanding principal amount of the Notes to be redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest thereon to, but excluding, the date of redemption, and any Additional Amounts payable with respect thereto, if the Issuer certifies to the Indenture Trustee (in the manner prescribed below) that:

(a) the Issuer has or will become obligated to pay Additional Amounts in connection with payments of interest, or amounts deemed interest, on the Notes as a result of a change in or amendment to the laws or regulations of a Relevant Jurisdiction or any political subdivision or governmental authority

thereof or therein having power to tax, or any generally applicable change in the application or official interpretation of such laws or regulations, which change or amendment becomes effective (and not publicly announced prior to) or, in the case of a change in official position, is publicly announced, on or after the later of the date of issuance of the Notes and the date that such Relevant Jurisdiction becomes a Relevant Jurisdiction; and

(b) such obligation cannot be avoided by taking reasonable measures available to the Issuer; provided that reasonable measures will not include any change in the Issuer’s jurisdiction of tax residency;

provided, further, however, that (i) the notice of redemption, which will specify the date of redemption and redemption price, will not be given earlier than 60 days before the earliest date on which the Issuer would be obligated to pay such Additional Amounts if a payment in respect of the Notes were then due and (ii) at the time such notice of redemption is given such obligation to pay Additional Amounts remains in effect.

No later than 15 days (unless a shorter period is acceptable to the Indenture Trustee) before giving any notice of redemption as described in the preceding clauses, the Issuer will deliver an Officer’s Certificate to the Indenture Trustee stating that the Issuer is entitled to effect such redemption in accordance with the terms of the Indenture and setting forth in reasonable detail a statement of facts showing that the above listed conditions have occurred. The Officer’s Certificate will be accompanied by a written opinion of recognized independent counsel experienced in tax and other related matters in the Relevant Jurisdiction to the effect that the Issuer has or will become obligated to pay the Additional Amounts as a result of such change or amendment.

## Mandatory Redemption

The Notes will be subject to mandatory redemption prior to maturity, up to the maximum amount of the Notes that can be redeemed at a redemption price equal to 100% of the outstanding principal amount of the Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest to the redemption date, plus Additional Amounts, if any (but without payment of any Make-Whole Amount or any premium), in the following circumstances.

Notwithstanding anything in this section to the contrary, in the event that the terms of any other Financing Document require the prepayment (or cash collateralization) thereof with amounts or proceeds otherwise required pursuant to this section to be applied to the redemption of the Notes, such amounts or proceeds will be applied pro rata to so redeem the Notes and to prepay (or Cash Collateralize, as applicable) any such other Senior Debt, as applicable. All mandatory redemptions will be applied without penalty or premium (except for breakage costs, if any and as otherwise provided in the Intercreditor Agreement) and will be applied in inverse order of maturity.

(a) Events of Loss and Condemnation Events: If the Issuer or the Panamanian Trustee receives Net Available Proceeds in connection with an Event of Loss of series of Events of Loss, including as a result of a Condemnation Event, in excess of U.S.$15 million (or its equivalent in any other currency), in the aggregate, and not otherwise applied to (x) restore or repair the Project within 365 days after receipt thereof or (y) continue operations during such restoration, the Issuer will be required to apply 100% of such Net Available Proceeds to effect a mandatory redemption of the Notes;

(b) Redemption upon termination of a PPA: If the Issuer or the Panamanian Trustee receives Net Available Proceeds in connection with any termination of a Material Project Document that is a PPA, the Issuer will be required to apply 100% of such Net Available Proceeds to effect a mandatory redemption of the Notes;

(c) Redemption in Connection with Material Project Document Claims: If the Issuer or the Panamanian Trustee receives Net Available Proceeds in connection with any Material Project Document claims in excess of U.S.$5 million (or its equivalent in any other currency), received pursuant to any Material Project Document (the “Material Project Documents Claims”), the Issuer will be required to effect a mandatory redemption of the Notes in an amount equal to 100% of the Net Available Proceeds of such Material Project Document Claim, less:

163

(i) to the extent that the Issuer must make a corresponding payment to offset liquidated damages owed by the Issuer under another Material Project Document or otherwise in respect of the applicable performance shortfall under any Material Project Document to the counterparty thereunder or to enter into a Replacement Material Project Document (if and when permitted under the Financing Documents), the aggregate amount of such payment(s), or

(ii) such proceeds as the Issuer may apply to pay Operating Expenses to construct or repair the Project, including as may be required to be paid pursuant to the Material Project Documents provided that, such construction or repair (x) is reasonably related to the events or circumstances that gave rise to the payment of such Material Project Document Claims and (y) the Issuer will have submitted a plan for such construction or restoration no more than 30 days after receipt of such Material Project Document Claims; provided that, if all or any portion of such proceeds are determined by the Issuer not to be required for such construction or repair or are not applied toward such construction or repair within 120 days following the approval of the plan, the Issuer will be required to effect a mandatory redemption of the Notes in an amount equal to such unapplied proceeds;

For the avoidance of doubt, the Issuer will not be required to make a mandatory redemption or Offer to Purchase the Notes or any of the Senior Debt Obligations in connection with the receipt of the ETESA Transfer Payment.

## Selection and Notice

Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary, if less than all of the Notes are to be redeemed or prepaid at any time, the Indenture Trustee will select Notes and portions thereof for redemption by lot, on a pro rata basis or by any other method as the Indenture Trustee will deem fair and appropriate. In the case of Notes in global form, the depositary in respect thereof will select beneficial interests in such Global Note to be redeemed or prepaid in accordance with the applicable procedures of DTC. Notes may only be selected for redemption in amounts of U.S.$200,000 or integral multiples of U.S.$1,000 in excess thereof. Notice of any redemption of the Notes set forth above under the caption “—Redemption of the Notes” may, at the Issuer’s discretion, be subject to one or more conditions precedent, including, but not limited to, completion or occurrence of a refinancing or other debt or equity offering, as the case may be. In addition, if such redemption is subject to satisfaction of one or more conditions precedent, such notice will describe each such condition, and if applicable, will state that, in the Issuer’s discretion, the redemption date may be delayed until such time as any or all such conditions will be satisfied, or such redemption may not occur and such notice may be rescinded in the event that any or all such conditions will not have been satisfied by the redemption date, or by the redemption date as so delayed, or such notice may be rescinded at any time in the Issuer’s discretion if in the good-faith judgment of the Issuer any or all of such conditions will not be satisfied. In addition, the Issuer may provide in such notice that payment of the redemption price and performance of the Issuer’s obligations with respect to such redemption may be performed by another Person.

At least 10 days but not more than 60 days before a redemption date, the Issuer will mail or deliver by electronic transmission in accordance with the applicable procedures of DTC, or cause to be mailed (or delivered by electronic transmission in accordance with the applicable procedures of DTC) a notice of redemption to each Noteholder whose Notes are to be redeemed at its registered address (with a copy to the Indenture Trustee).

Within 30 days following the date of any partial redemption of the Notes, the Issuer will send the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate setting forth the amended amortization schedule for the Notes.

## Open Market Purchases

Except as otherwise provided above under the caption “—Mandatory Redemption,” the Issuer is not required to make any mandatory redemption or sinking fund payments with respect to the Notes. To the extent permitted under Applicable Law, the Issuer, or any of their respective Affiliates may at any time and from time to time purchase Notes by means other than a redemption, whether by tender or exchange offer, in the open market, negotiated transactions or otherwise at any price.

164

165

# Repurchase upon a Change of Control

Upon the occurrence of a Change of Control that results in a Ratings Decline, each Noteholder will have the right to require that the Issuer purchase all or a portion of the Noteholder’s Notes (in integral multiples of U.S.$1,000) at a purchase price equal to 101% of the principal amount thereof, plus accrued and unpaid interest thereon to, but excluding, the date of purchase (the “Change of Control Payment”); provided that the remaining principal amount of such Noteholder’s Note will not be less than U.S.$200,000.

Within 30 days following the date upon which a Change of Control that results in a Ratings Decline occurred, the Issuer must send, (a) if Global Notes, to the relevant depository in accordance with its applicable procedures, a notice and (b) if non-global certificated Notes, by first-class mail, a notice to each Noteholder, in each case, with a copy to the Indenture Trustee, offering to purchase the Notes as described above (a “Change of Control Offer”). The Change of Control Offer will state, among other things, the purchase date, which must be no earlier than 30 days nor later than 60 days from the date the notice is mailed, except as may be required by law (the “Change of Control Payment Date”).

If only a portion of a Note is purchased pursuant to a Change of Control Offer, a new Note in a principal amount equal to the portion thereof not purchased will be issued in the name of the Noteholder thereof upon cancellation of the original Note (or appropriate adjustments to the amount and beneficial interests in a global Note will be made, as appropriate); provided that the remaining principal amount of such Noteholder’s Note will not be less than U.S.$200,000 and will be in integral multiples of U.S.$1,000 in excess thereof.

The Issuer is only required to make a Change of Control Offer in the event that a Change of Control results in a Ratings Decline. Consequently, if a Change of Control were to occur which does not result in a Ratings Decline, the Issuer would not be required to offer to repurchase the Notes. In addition, the Issuer will not be required to make a Change of Control Offer if (a) a third party makes the Change of Control Offer in a manner, at the times and otherwise in compliance with the requirements set forth in the Indenture applicable to a Change of Control Offer made by the Issuer and purchases all Notes validly tendered and not withdrawn under such Change of Control Offer, or (b) notice of redemption for all outstanding Notes has been given pursuant to the Indenture as described above under the caption “—Optional Redemption,” unless and until there is a default in payment of the applicable redemption price.

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, a Change of Control Offer may be made in advance of a Change of Control, conditioned upon the consummation of such Change of Control and/or a Ratings Decline, if a definitive agreement is in place for the Change of Control at the time the Change of Control Offer is made.

In the event that Noteholders of not less than 90% of the aggregate principal amount of the outstanding Notes accept a Change of Control Offer and the Issuer (or a third party making the Change of Control Offer as provided above) purchases all of the Notes held by such Noteholders, the Issuer will have the right, upon not less than 10 nor more than 60 days’ notice, given not more than 30 days following the purchase pursuant to the Change of Control Offer described above, to redeem all of the Notes that remain outstanding following such purchase at a redemption price equal to the Change of Control Payment plus, to the extent not included in the Change of Control Payment, accrued and unpaid interest on the Notes that remain outstanding, to, but excluding, the date of redemption.

The Issuer will comply with the requirements of Rule 14e-1 under the Exchange Act and any other applicable securities laws and regulations in connection with the purchase of Notes in connection with a Change of Control Offer. To the extent that the provisions of any securities laws or regulations conflict with the “Change of Control” provisions of the Indenture, the Issuer will comply with the applicable securities laws and regulations and will not be deemed to have breached its obligations under the Indenture by doing so. If it would be unlawful in any jurisdiction to make a Change of Control Offer, the Issuer will not be obligated to make such offer in such jurisdiction and will not be deemed to have breached its obligations under the Indenture because of its failure to make such offer.

The obligation of the Issuer to make a Change of Control Offer may be waived or modified at any time prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control with the written consent of Noteholders of a majority in principal amount of the Notes.

Within 30 days following the date of any partial repurchase of the Notes, the Issuer will send the Indenture

Trustee an Officer’s Certificate setting forth the amended amortization schedule for the Notes.

## Priority of Payments upon Foreclosure on the Collateral

If the maturity of the Notes has been accelerated and if the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable (acting at the direction of the Intercreditor Agent) forecloses on or sells the Collateral at any time pursuant to the terms of the Security Documents (as amended on the Issue Date), all proceeds realized in connection therewith must, subject to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement, be applied to pay the Noteholders for the Notes and other required amounts in accordance with the priority set forth in the Indenture, irrespective of whether such proceeds are sufficient to pay all amounts then due under the Notes and other Senior Debt.

## Certain Covenants of the Issuer

For so long as any Notes are outstanding, the Issuer, through the terms of the Indenture and the Notes, will be subject to certain covenants as further described below in addition to a customary covenant regarding maintenance of office or agency.

## Limitation on Indebtedness

(a) The Issuer will not, directly or indirectly, create, incur, assume or guaranty, or otherwise become or remain directly or indirectly liable with respect to any Indebtedness, except if the following conditions are met:

(i) immediately after giving effect to the Incurrence of such Indebtedness, no Default or Indenture Event of Default has occurred and will be continuing or will result from such Incurrence;

(ii) after giving pro forma effect to the Incurrence thereof and the application of the proceeds therefrom, the Issuer delivers an Officer’s Certificate to the Indenture Trustee certifying that (a) the Debt Service Coverage Ratio for the Calculation Period is greater than 1.35:1.00 and (b) the Projected Debt Service Coverage Ratio for each Calculation Period ending as of the last day of each Fiscal Year during the remaining term of the Notes will be greater than 1.35:1.00; and

(iii) the Issuer obtains a Ratings Affirmation in connection with such Incurrence;

provided that, for purposes of calculating the Debt Service Coverage Ratio and the Projected Debt Service Coverage Ratio with respect to the Incurrence of Indebtedness:

(i) the interest rate applicable to any outstanding Indebtedness is equal to the interest rates applicable to such Indebtedness for each of the two (2) quarterly periods immediately preceding the date of determination;

(ii) the interest rate applicable to any Indebtedness to be Incurred is equal to the fixed interest rate of such Indebtedness under the relevant agreement in effect on the date of determination or under the relevant Permitted Hedging Instrument in effect on the date of determination; and

(iii) a hypothetical fixed interest rate equal to the Reference Rate will be applied to all Indebtedness to be Incurred that does not bear interest at a fixed interest rate under the relevant agreement in effect on the date of determination.

(b) Notwithstanding clause (a) above, the Issuer may Incur the following Indebtedness (collectively, with the Indebtedness incurred pursuant to section (a) above, the “Permitted Indebtedness”):

(i) Indebtedness in respect of the Existing Facilities on the Issue Date; provided that, all Indebtedness incurred under or in connection with the Existing Facilities will only be considered Permitted Indebtedness until the second Business Day after the Issue Date;

166

(ii) Indebtedness in respect of the Notes (excluding Additional Notes);

(iii) Subordinated Indebtedness and Intercompany Indebtedness;

(iv) trade liabilities incurred in the ordinary course of business and not overdue by more than 90 days or that are being contested in good faith;

(v) Indebtedness under the LC Facility Agreement in an aggregate principal amount at any time outstanding not to exceed U.S.$134 million;

(vi) unsecured Indebtedness in respect of letters of credit (other than pursuant to the LC Documents) or performance, bid or other bonds or reimbursement obligations in respect of such letters of credit or bonds, in each case, entered into in the ordinary course of business (which are not Incurred in connection with the borrowing of money) in order to comply with any requirements under Applicable Law or any Material Project Document; provided that, upon the drawing of such letters of credit or the Incurrence of such Indebtedness, such obligations are reimbursed within 30 days following such drawing or Incurrence;

(vii) Indebtedness with respect to capitalized leases incurred in the ordinary course of business to finance discrete items of equipment or machinery forming part of the Project; provided that such obligations, if secured, are secured only by Liens upon the equipment or machinery being financed or leased; provided, further, that the aggregate amount of such Indebtedness does not at any time exceed U.S.$10 million;

(viii) Refinancing Debt in respect of the Indebtedness described in clauses (iii), (v), (vi) and (vii) above and (xiii); provided that:

(A) the Average Life of such Refinancing Debt will not be shorter than the Average Life of the Indebtedness being refinanced; and

(B) the aggregate principal amount (or initial accreted value, if applicable) of such Refinancing Debt as of the date of such proposed refinancing does not exceed the aggregate principal amount (or accreted value as of such date, if applicable) of the Indebtedness being refinanced (plus the amount of any premium required to be paid under the terms of the instrument governing such Indebtedness and the amount of reasonable expenses incurred by the Issuer in connection with such refinancing).

(ix) Indebtedness arising from the honoring by a bank or other financial institution of a check, draft or similar instrument drawn against insufficient funds; provided such debt is extinguished within 5 Business Days of receipt of notice of insufficient funds;

(x) Indebtedness in respect of severance payments, workers' compensation, unemployment insurance and similar items, each case, Incurred in the ordinary course of business or in order to comply with any requirements of Applicable Law;

(xi) Indebtedness consisting of the financing of insurance premiums incurred in the ordinary course of business and not in connection with the borrowing of money;

(xii) unsecured Indebtedness incurred in the ordinary course of business; provided that such Indebtedness is (A) incurred either (w) to finance working capital needs of the Issuer, (x) for purposes of maintenance capital expenditures, (y) to fund capital expenditures required under applicable law or (z) as short-term credit facilities from commercial banks requiring repayment less than 365 days; and (B) in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding U.S.$50 million outstanding at any time;

(xiii) unsecured Indebtedness under any Permitted Hedging Instrument;

167

(xiv) Indebtedness under a Permitted Trade Finance Transaction; and
(xv) other unsecured Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount at any time outstanding not to exceed U.S.$20 million.

For purposes of determining compliance with, and the outstanding principal amount of any particular Indebtedness incurred pursuant to and in compliance with, this “—Limitation on Indebtedness” covenant:

(i) in the event that an item of proposed Indebtedness meets the criteria of more than one of the categories of Permitted Indebtedness above, whether at the time of Incurrence or issuance or upon the application of all or a portion of the proceeds thereof or subsequently, the Issuer will be permitted to classify such item of Indebtedness on the date of its incurrence, or later reclassify all or a portion of such item of Indebtedness, in any manner that complies with this covenant; and
(ii) Indebtedness permitted to be incurred by the Issuer need not be permitted solely by reference to one provision permitting such Indebtedness but may be permitted in part by one such provision and in part by one or more other provisions of this covenant permitting such Indebtedness.

Accrual of interest, accrual of dividends, the accretion of accreted value, the accretion or amortization of original issue discount, the payment of interest on any such Indebtedness in the form of additional Indebtedness with the same terms and the reclassification of preferred stock, commitments or obligations as Indebtedness due to a change in accounting principles will not be deemed to be an incurrence of Indebtedness for purposes of the covenant described under this “—Limitation on Indebtedness.” The amount of any Indebtedness outstanding as of any date will be (a) the accreted value thereof in the case of any Indebtedness issued with original issue discount and (b) the principal amount, or liquidation preference thereof, in the case of any other Indebtedness.

For purposes of determining compliance with any U.S. Dollar-denominated restriction on the incurrence of Indebtedness, the U.S. Dollar-equivalent principal amount of Indebtedness denominated in a foreign currency will be calculated based on the relevant currency exchange rate in effect on the date such Indebtedness was incurred.

Notwithstanding any other provision of this covenant, the maximum amount of Indebtedness that may be incurred pursuant to this covenant will not be deemed to be exceeded solely as a result of fluctuations in exchange rates, currency values or inflation rates.

## Limitation on Distributions

The Issuer will not make any Distribution unless such payment is made on a date (a “Distribution Date”) on which the following conditions have been satisfied (collectively, the “Distribution Conditions”):

(a) no Default or Indenture Event of Default is Continuing as of the applicable Distribution Date, or would occur as a result of the Distribution;
(b) after giving pro forma effect to such Distribution, the Debt Service Coverage Ratio for the Calculation Period ended on the applicable calculation date is at least 1.20:1.00; and the Projected Debt Service Coverage Ratio for the 12-month period following the date of determination beginning with the month that most recently ended (taken as one accounting period) will be at least 1.20:1.00;
(c) each of the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account and the O&amp;M Reserve Account are funded in an amount equal to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement and the O&amp;M Reserve Account Requirement, as applicable, on the Distribution Date;
(d) there will be no outstanding Loans, unreimbursed drawings or other unpaid amounts due under the LC Documents;
(e) all Existing Facilities have been repaid in full;
(f) all Liens on the Existing Facilities created under or pursuant to any documents in connection with the Existing Facilities required to be released have been released;

168

(g) all filings, registrations and other actions necessary for the creation and perfection of the Liens on the Collateral in favor of the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, for the benefit of the Secured Parties have been completed to the extent required by the Security Documents or with respect to the Panamanian Collateral, to the extent required as of such date;

(h) all endorsements of the Required Insurance Policies in favor of the applicable Secured Parties have been made to the extent required as of such date in accordance with the covenant described under caption “—Maintenance of Insurance;” and

(i) prior to the applicable Distribution Date, the Issuer will have delivered to the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate certifying compliance with the foregoing conditions,

provided that, any Distribution shall be made solely from funds transferred to and available in the Distribution Account in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Distribution Conditions contained in this provision shall not apply to (i) any ETESA Reimbursement, (ii) any capital reduction and/or Distribution to be made on or about the Issue Date as described under the caption “Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds”, and (iii) any capital reduction and/or Distribution (which may be in the form of Intercompany Indebtedness) in connection with the Corporate Reorganization, provided that any such amounts to be paid or otherwise disbursed under clause (iii) of this proviso (A) will not exceed U.S.$150 million in the aggregate to the extent they are funded from the Distribution Suspense Account and (B) may make from any or all amounts available in the Distribution Account at such time.

Further, the Distribution Conditions shall also not apply to the Distribution in the amount of U.S.$15.96 million to be declared by the Issuer on or about the Issue Date in respect of the Issuer's accumulated earnings for the year ended December 31, 2025 to be paid on or about the Issue Date (the “Retained Earnings Distribution”), which Distribution shall not be subject to any condition, limitation or restriction contained in this Description of Notes or the Indenture.

## Limitation on Liens

The Issuer, will not, directly or indirectly, create, assume, incur, permit or allow to exist any Lien securing Indebtedness on or with respect to any of its Properties or assets now owned or hereafter acquired by it or on any income or revenues or rights in respect of any thereof, except for the following types of Liens (each of the following items, “Permitted Liens”):

(a) Liens in favor of the Secured Parties created under or pursuant to any Security Document;

(b) solely until the Issue Date, Liens for the benefit of the secured parties under the Existing Facilities;

(c) Liens for taxes, assessments and governmental charges, the non-payment of which do not violate the covenant to pay taxes and Liens for customs duties arising in the ordinary course of business;

(d) deposits or pledges to secure obligations under worker’s compensation, social security, unemployment insurance or similar laws;

(e) deposits or pledges to secure bids, tenders, contracts (other than contracts for the repayment of money), leases, statutory obligations, surety and appeal bonds and other obligations of like nature, in each case arising in the ordinary course of business;

(f) Liens incurred in the ordinary course of business, including mechanics’, workmen’s, carriers’, materialmen’s or other like Liens arising in the ordinary course of business or incidental to the construction, restoration, repair, replacement, rebuilding or improvement of the Project with respect to obligations that are not overdue by more than 90 days or that are being contested in good faith;

(g) Liens created by or resulting from any litigation or legal proceeding (a) to the extent the corresponding judgment does not give rise to an Indenture Event of Default or (b) as to which the execution thereof has been effectively stayed while the underlying claims are being contested in

169

good faith by appropriate proceedings or means, in each case for which reserves have been established in accordance with IFRS or generally accepted accounting principles;

(h) (i) easements, rights-of-ways, restrictions encroachments, other minor defects, irregularities or imperfections of title on real estate, (ii) zoning, building, entitlement and other land use regulations by Governmental Authorities, or (ii) any zoning or similar law or right reserved to or vested in any Governmental Authority to control or regulate the use of any real property; provided that, in each case, they do not (A) materially interfere with the ordinary course of business of the Issuer as a whole, (B) materially impair the value or use of the property affected and (C) individually or in the aggregate impair the validity, perfection or priority of the Liens granted under the Security Documents;

(i) Liens consisting of an agreement to dispose of Property in a disposition permitted under the terms of the Indenture;

(j) Liens securing Indebtedness of the type described under clauses (b) (i), (ii), (v), (vii) and (viii) of the definition of Permitted Indebtedness; provided that (a) such Liens attach within 90 days after the acquisition, repair, replacement or improvement (as applicable) of the Property subject to such Liens, (b) such Liens do not at any time encumber any Property (except for replacements, additions and accessions to such Property) other than the Property financed by such Indebtedness and the proceeds and the products thereof and (c) with respect to capitalized leases, such Liens do not at any time extend to or cover any assets other than the assets subject to such capitalized leases and the proceeds and products thereof and customary security deposits; provided that individual financings of equipment provided by one lender may be cross-collateralized to other financings of equipment provided by such lender on customary terms;

(k) leases, licenses, subleases or sublicenses granted to others in the ordinary course of business and which do not (a) interfere in any material respect with the business of the Issuer or (b) secure any Indebtedness for borrowed money;

(l) Liens solely on any ordinary course cash earnest money deposits made by the Issuer in connection with any letter of intent or purchase agreement permitted hereunder;

(m) with respect to any Property acquired by the Issuer or otherwise incorporated into the Project, pre-existing Liens on such Property (and which do not extend to any other Property) which do not secure Indebtedness for borrowed money and are extinguished within 30 days after the date of acquisition of the relevant Property or incorporation of the same into the Project;

(n) Liens securing Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness;

(o) Liens incurred in connection with a Permitted Trade Finance Transaction;

(p) extension, renewal or replacement (or successive extensions, renewals or replacements) in whole or in part of any Liens referred to in clauses (a) through (m) above; provided, however, that (i) such new Lien will be limited to all or part of the same Property that secured the original Lien (plus improvements on such Property), and (ii) the Indebtedness secured by such Lien at such time is not increased to any amount greater than the sum of the outstanding principal amount or, if greater, committed amount of the Indebtedness described above at the time the original Lien became a Permitted Lien, plus an amount equal to an amount necessary to pay any accrued interest and additional amounts, if any, and any fees, original issue discount, costs, premiums (including tender premiums) and expenses in connection therewith;

(q) Liens over Property not included in the Collateral;

(r) Liens over the Equity Interests of a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary owned by the Issuer;

(s) statutory liens or contractual rights of set-off in favor of banks or other depositary institutions; and

170

(t) other Liens securing Indebtedness of the Issuer in an aggregate principal amount outstanding not to exceed at any time U.S.$15 million.

## Limitation on Investments

The Issuer will not, directly or indirectly, (a) make any Investments other than Permitted Investments or (b) form or acquire any Subsidiary other than a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary in connection with a Permitted Project Expansion.

## Limitation on Asset Sales

The Issuer will not, directly or indirectly, make any Asset Sales, except for Permitted Asset Sales. Within 365 days following the consummation of an Asset Sale, the Issuer will, at its option, apply an amount equal to the corresponding Net Available Proceeds to any of the following:

(a) repay, redeem or repurchase the Notes, the Loans, and any other Senior Debt and to Cash Collateralize the Letters of Credit;

(b) reinvest (or enter into a binding commitment to reinvest) in assets useful in the business of the Issuer; or

(c) do any combination of the foregoing.

For the purpose of clause (b) of the immediately preceding paragraph, a binding commitment will be treated as a permitted application of the Net Available Proceeds from the date of such commitment until the earlier of (x) the date on which such reinvestment is consummated and (y) the 180th day following the date of entry into such binding commitment.

Pending the final application of any Net Available Proceeds from an Asset Sale, the Issuer may temporarily reduce revolving credit borrowings or temporarily invest the Net Available Proceeds in any manner not prohibited by the Financing Documents.

Any Net Available Proceeds from Asset Sales consummated in accordance with this covenant that are not applied or invested within 365 days following the consummation of an Asset Sale as provided above (it being understood that any portion of such Net Available Proceeds used by the Issuer to make an Offer to Purchase Notes, as described below, will be deemed to have been invested whether or not such offer is accepted) will be deemed to constitute "Excess Asset Sale Proceeds."

If, as of the first day of any calendar month, the aggregate amount of Excess Asset Sale Proceeds totals at least U.S.$15 million, then within 15 Business Days after such date, the Issuer will make an offer (an "Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer") to all Noteholders to purchase the maximum principal amount of Notes that may be purchased in an amount equal to the Excess Asset Sale Proceeds; provided that, the Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer will be shared, on a pro rata and pari passu basis, and applied by the Issuer to prepay any other Senior Debt and to Cash Collateralize the LC Exposure (and, if any other Senior Debt contains provisions similar to those set forth in the Indenture with respect to offers to purchase or redeem with the Excess Asset Sale Proceeds, absent a waiver of such provisions, the Issuer will make an Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer to the holders of such other Senior Debt, in accordance with the Senior Debt Instruments governing such Senior Debt). The offer price for the Notes in any Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer will be equal to 100% of the aggregate principal amount outstanding of the Notes plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the date of purchase and will be payable in cash; provided that, that amount will be reduced by the amount required to be applied by the Issuer to prepay any other Senior Debt that, by its terms, requires such prepayment or redemption and to Cash Collateralize, as applicable, the Letters of Credit or such other Senior Debt, as applicable. If the aggregate principal amount of Notes and the other Senior Debt tendered into any Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer exceeds such amount, the Notes and such other Senior Debt will be accepted for repurchase on a pro rata basis on the basis of the aggregate accreted value or principal amount of tendered Notes and other Senior Debt (provided that the selection of such Senior Debt will be made pursuant to the terms of such Senior Debt).

171

If a portion of the Notes but not all the Notes are repurchased as described hereunder, the principal payment amounts listed in the table included under the caption “—Amortization” will be reduced in the inverse order of maturity. Within 30 days following the date of any partial repurchase of the Notes, the Issuer will send the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate setting forth the amended amortization schedule for the Notes.

The Issuer will comply with the requirements of Rule 14e-1 under the Exchange Act and any other securities laws and regulations thereunder to the extent those laws and regulations are applicable in connection with each repurchase of Notes pursuant to an Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer. To the extent that the provisions of any securities laws or regulations conflict with the Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer provisions of the Indenture, the Issuer will comply with the applicable securities laws and regulations and will not be deemed to have breached its obligations under the Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offer provisions of the Indenture by virtue of such compliance.

The sale, conveyance or other disposition of all or substantially all of the assets of the Issuer, taken as a whole, will be governed by the provisions of the Indenture described under the caption “—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets” below and not by the provisions of this “—Limitation on Asset Sales” covenant.

## Limitation on Transactions with Affiliates

The Issuer will not, directly or indirectly, enter into, renew or extend any transaction or arrangement including the purchase, sale, lease or exchange of Property or assets, or the rendering of any service with any Affiliate of the Issuer, except upon what are, in the judgment of the Issuer, fair and reasonable terms not materially less favorable to the Issuer than could be obtained in a comparable arm’s-length transaction with a Person that is not an Affiliate of the Issuer, but which Person is of adequate financial and technical capability to perform the transactions, provided that if any such transaction or series of related transactions involves an aggregate consideration in excess of U.S.$15 million Dollars, the Issuer must deliver to the Indenture Trustee a resolution of its board of directors together with an Officer’s Certificate of the Issuer and an opinion of counsel and stating that such Affiliate transaction complies with the Indenture and that such Affiliate transaction has been approved by not less than a majority of the members of the relevant board of directors.

The foregoing paragraph does not apply to:

(a) Permitted Investments;
(b) any Distribution made upon the satisfaction of each Distribution Condition;
(c) transactions pursuant to any PPAs;
(d) the payment and performance of any obligations under any of the Material Project Documents, the ASA and the O&amp;M Management Agreement, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented, modified or replaced from time to time in accordance with the terms of the Indenture; provided that fees payable to Affiliates thereunder will not be so excepted from the limitations contained in this covenant;
(e) entry into agreements, amendments, modifications or replacements of such contracts entered into with Affiliates regarding (i) the engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and/or testing of a Permitted Project Expansion for an aggregate amount not exceeding U.S.$10 million and (ii) a Project Improvement for an aggregate amount not exceeding U.S.$10 million; and provided that fees payable to Affiliates thereunder will not be so excepted from the limitations contained in this covenant;
(f) transactions pursuant to agreements in effect on the Issue Date and described in the Offering Memorandum;
(g) any LNG Transaction or Power Transaction entered into by the Issuer and an Affiliate of the Issuer;
(h) the payment of customary fees and reasonable out-of-pocket costs to, and indemnities provided on behalf of, directors, managers, officers, employees and consultants of the Issuer (or any direct or indirect parent thereof) in the ordinary course of business to the extent attributable to the ownership

172

or operation of such Persons;

(i) Subordinated Indebtedness;
(j) any capital reduction of the Issuer to be made on or about the Issue Date as described under the caption "Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds" or in connection with the Corporate Reorganization; and
(k) the Corporate Reorganization.

## Limitation on Business Activities

The Issuer will not engage or enter into any business other than the development, construction, ownership, financing, installation, operation, maintenance or administration of the Project, any Permitted Project Expansion, Project Improvement or any business reasonably related thereto, including any LNG Transaction and Power Transactions (the businesses described in this paragraph, collectively, the "Permitted Business"). For the avoidance of doubt, nothing contained in this "—Limitation on Business Activities" covenant will restrict the ability of the Issuer and any Shareholder to consummate the Corporate Reorganization or to engage in any other merger, consolidation or sale of assets, in each case, in compliance with the covenant described under the caption "—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets."

## Limitation on Funding of Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary under the caption "—Limitation on Distributions", the Issuer shall be permitted to fund Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements in accordance with the following provisions:

(a) any Permitted Project Expansion may be funded (i) with proceeds of Distributions or equity contributions made by the Sponsors or the Holding Company either to the Issuer or the Permitted Expansion Subsidiary, or (ii) with Indebtedness incurred by a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary formed for the purpose of undertaking such Permitted Project Expansion; provided that no Indebtedness shall be incurred or Guaranteed by the Issuer in connection with any Permitted Project Expansion; provided further that for the avoidance of doubt, (A) none of (1) the Equity Interests, assets or proceeds of a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary or (2) the Issuer's assets or proceeds derived from a Permitted Project Expansion, in either case, will be considered to be part of the Collateral or subject to any security interest or Lien for the benefit of the Secured Parties and (B) no Distributions from a Permitted Expansion Subsidiary will be required to be deposited into any of the Project Accounts or otherwise be applied in compliance with the Accounts Waterfall; and
(b) any Project Improvement may be funded (i) with proceeds of Distributions or equity contributions made by the Sponsors or the Holding Company to the Issuer, or (ii) with Subordinated Indebtedness or Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness incurred by the Issuer in compliance with the requirements set forth under, and as otherwise permitted by, “—Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness” and “—Limitation on Indebtedness;” provided that for the avoidance of doubt, assets or proceeds in connection with a Project Improvement will be considered to be part of, and contributed to, the Collateral for the benefit of the Secured Parties; provided further that that any Project Improvement, individually or in the aggregate, of less than U.S.$10 million in book value will not be required to be contributed to the Collateral for the benefit of the Secured Parties, so long as the aggregate amount of such Project Improvements not contributed to the Collateral will not, at any time, exceed U.S.$10 million in book value.

## Limitation on Entry into Material Project Documents, etc.

The Issuer will not enter into any other Additional Material Project Document, Additional Material PPA or any Replacement Material Project Documents if entering into such document would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, except that the foregoing will not apply if prior thereto, the Issuer has obtained a Ratings Affirmation.

173

In addition, the Issuer will provide a perfected first-priority security interest pursuant to the Security Documents with respect to any such Additional Material Project Document, Additional Material PPA or Replacement Material Project Document, in addition to the Third Party Consent, consent, notification and opinion of counsel, as described below.

Concurrently with, or promptly after entering into any Additional Material Project Document, Additional Material PPA or Replacement Material Project Document after the Issue Date in accordance with the requirement set forth above, the Issuer will be required to:

(a) promptly (and in any event within 10 days as of the entering into of any such agreement) notify the Indenture Trustee, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee in writing of the entering into any such agreement;

(b) cause such Additional Material Project Document, Replacement Material Project Document or Additional Material PPA to be subject to the Liens granted pursuant to the Security Documents as soon as reasonably practicable (and in any event within the notice periods specified in (c) and (d) below); and

(c) deliver or cause to be delivered as soon as reasonably practicable after the Issuer’s execution of (i) an Additional Material Project Document or a Replacement Material Project Document, in any event within 90 days or if entered into with a Governmental Authority, in any event within one year, (ii) an Additional Material PPA with a Distribution Company or other Governmental Authority in any event within one year; or (iii) an Additional Material PPA with any other Person other than a Distribution Company or other Governmental Authority, in any event within 90 days, (1) (x) a Third Party Consent if such agreement is governed by New York Law; or (y) a notice or consent if such agreement is governed by Panama law, from each counterparty thereto together with (2) an opinion of counsel in each case, in accordance with the terms of the Indenture; provided that notwithstanding the Issuer’s demonstrated commercially reasonable efforts, the assignment of such Replacement Material Project Document if entered into with a Governmental Authority or Additional Material PPA with a Distribution Company or other Governmental Authority has not been perfected within such one year period, then such period will be automatically extended for an additional 120 days. Upon expiration of such additional 120 day period, the Issuer will have no further obligation to secure consents not previously obtained and the inability to obtain such consents will not constitute an Event of Default under the Indenture and the other Security Documents; provided further however that, the Issuer will (A) cause all payments arising under such agreement to be deposited directly into the Revenue Account; (B) deliver to the counterparty of such agreement an irrevocable instruction to make all payments to the Issuer arising thereunder directly into the Revenue Account, signed by the Panamanian Trustee, which instruction may only be modified or revoked by the Panamanian Trustee); and (C) deliver an Officer's Certificate to the Indenture Trustee confirming that the Issuer has complied with all the foregoing conditions.

(d) deliver or cause to be delivered upon satisfaction of the conditions set forth in the A&amp;R Collateral Assignment Agreement, each of the ACP Lease Agreement and the AMP Concession (or any Replacement Material Project Document relating thereto) a notice or consent from each counterparty thereto within one year after the satisfaction of such conditions provided that notwithstanding the Issuer’s demonstrated commercially reasonable efforts, the assignment of the ACP Lease Agreement and the AMP Concession (or any Replacement Material Project Document relating thereto) has not been perfected within such one year period, then such period will be automatically extended for an additional 120 days. Upon expiration of such additional 120 day period, the Issuer will have no further obligation to secure consents not previously obtained and the inability to obtain such consents will not constitute an Event of Default under the Indenture and the other Security Documents provided further however that, the Issuer will (A) cause all payments arising under such agreements to be deposited directly into the Revenue Account; (B) deliver to the counterparty of such agreements an irrevocable instruction to make all payments to the Issuer arising thereunder directly into the Revenue Account, signed by the Panamanian Trustee, which instruction may only be modified or revoked by the Panamanian Trustee); and (C) deliver an Officer's

174

Certificate to the Indenture Trustee confirming that the Issuer has complied with all the foregoing conditions.

## Limitation on Entry into Additional Project Contracts, etc.

The Issuer will not enter in any LNG Transaction or Power Transaction, unless the Issuer obtains a Ratings Affirmation with respect to the entry into such contract. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Issuer may enter into the following on or after the Issue Date (without obtaining a Ratings Affirmation):

(a) agreements, contracts or other arrangements or commitments entered into by the Issuer with respect to any action permitted by the Indenture;

(b) replacement or extension of Project Documents, as otherwise permitted and contemplated by the Indenture; and

(c) agreements, contracts or other arrangements or commitments in connection with LNG Transactions or Power Transactions (each, an “Additional Project Contract”) entered into in the ordinary course of business and consistent with prudent industry practice, in each case so long as (i) the terms thereof would not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect; (ii) such Additional Project Contract would not restrict the ability of the Issuer to make payments under the Financing Documents or Material Project Documents; (iii) the entering into such Additional Project Contract would not result in a breach or violation of any Financing Document or Material Project Document; and (iv) if such Additional Project Contract would constitute an Additional Material PPA, the Issuer has delivered to the Trustee an Officer’s Certificate certifying as to compliance with the foregoing and the requirements set forth under “—Limitation on Entry into Material Project Documents, etc.” in respect of Additional Material Project Documents; and

(d) agreements, contracts or other arrangements or commitments entered into with respect to (i) Permitted Indebtedness, (ii) Permitted Asset Sales, and (iii) Permitted Investments;

provided that, for the avoidance of doubt, no Derivative Transaction pursuant to a Permitted Hedging Instrument or otherwise permitted under “—Limitation on Indebtedness” shall constitute an Additional Project Contract.

## Maintenance of Existence; Separateness

Subject to the rights of the Issuer to carry out the Corporate Reorganization, and otherwise described under the caption “—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets”, the Issuer will do all things necessary to maintain:

(a) its legal form of existence in its jurisdiction of organization, incorporation, registration and/or formation; and

(b) the power and authority (corporate, partnership and otherwise) necessary under applicable Requirements of Law to own its Properties (if any) and to carry on its Permitted Business.

Subject to the rights of the Issuer to carry out the Corporate Reorganization, and as otherwise described under the caption “—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets”, the Issuer will not (i) take any action that is reasonably likely to result in their respective separate existences being ignored or in their respective assets and liabilities being substantively consolidated with any other person in a bankruptcy, reorganization, or other insolvency proceeding or, (ii) except as reasonably required to consummate the Corporate Reorganization or to change its board of directors, officers or legal representatives, amend or modify in any material respect any of its organizational documents. Without limiting the foregoing and except as contemplated by the Financing Documents, the Issuer will (i) conduct in all material respects its businesses solely in its own name, (ii) maintain accounts separate from those of any Affiliates and (iii) not commingle its funds with those of any other Affiliates.

175

176

# Compliance with Laws

The Issuer will, comply with all Applicable Laws and all orders, writs, injunctions and decrees applicable to it or to its business or property (including any Environmental Law), and own, construct, maintain and operate the Project in compliance with all such Applicable Laws and all orders, writs, injunctions and decrees applicable to it or to its business or property (including any Environmental Law) of any Governmental Authority having jurisdiction over it or its business or the Project, except where any failure to so comply could not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

# Payment of Obligations

The Issuer will pay, discharge or otherwise satisfy in full at or before maturity all of its obligations and liabilities arising pursuant to the Notes and the other Senior Debt Instruments, including all payments of principal, interest, any Additional Amounts and any Make-Whole Amount.

The Issuer will comply with all Applicable Laws relating to taxes, duties, or other governmental charges imposed or levied by or on behalf of Panama or any political subdivision thereof in which it is organized or is a resident for tax purposes and which has power to tax such Person, except where (a) the validity of the required payment is being contested by the Issuer with respect to which adequate reserves have been established by the Issuer to the extent required by the applicable Accounting Standards or (b) the failure to so comply would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

# Further Assurances; Preservation and Protection of Collateral; Perfection and Maintenance of Security Interests

The Issuer will, no later than (x) the Issue Date, with respect to (A) the Security and Depositary Agreement and (B) each Third Party Consent listed in items (a) through (e) under the caption “—Security—Third Party Consents,” (y) on the applicable dates set forth in (c) under the caption “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Entry into Material Project Documents, etc.” with respect to any Third Party Consent listed in item (f) under the caption “—Security—Third Party Consents” required after the Issue Date and (y) the relevant Panamanian Collateral Outside Date, with respect to the Panamanian Security Documents, provide to the Panamanian Trustee, the Collateral Agent or the Indenture Trustee, as the case may be:

(a) evidence that the provisions of each Security Document are effective to create a legal, valid and enforceable first priority Lien, or right, as applicable, in favor of the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, for the benefit of the Secured Parties, on all of the Collateral covered thereby, subject to the conditions set forth therein, and all necessary recordings, filings and notarizations in respect thereof necessary to ensure the validity and enforceability or admissibility in evidence thereof, have been made in all appropriate public offices and all other necessary action has been taken and other authorizations from Governmental Authorities have been obtained, subject to the conditions set forth therein, so that each Security Document creates a Lien in the Collateral covered thereby, prior and superior in right to all other Liens except for Permitted Liens mandatorily preferred by Applicable Law, including under the Laws of Panama and New York;

(b) copies or other evidence that all necessary filing and notarization (where appropriate) and other fees and expenses related to such filings and notarizations, if any, have been paid in full;

(c) copies of all documents (signed, where applicable) required to be provided on the execution date of each Security Document under the terms thereof (including any share certificates, instruments of transfer, letters of instruction, resignation and authorization, powers of attorney and proxies); and

(d) evidence that all filing, recordation, subscription and inscription fees and all recording and other similar fees, and all recording, stamp and other Taxes and other expenses related to the filings, registrations and recordings necessary for and related to the transactions contemplated by this Indenture to be consummated on or prior to the dates set forth in (a) above, as applicable, have been paid in full by or on behalf of the Issuer or are to be paid in full on such date.

Subject to the applicable limitations set forth in the Security Documents, the Issuer will, at its own expense,

cooperate and take all necessary steps to, as applicable:

(a) correct any material defect or error that may be discovered in the Indenture and any Security Document or in the execution, acknowledgment, filing or recordation thereof;

(b) do, execute, acknowledge, deliver, record, re-record, file, re-file, register and re-register any and all such further acts, public deeds, conveyances, pledge agreements, mortgages, deeds of trust, trust deeds, assignments, financing statements and continuations thereof, termination statements, notices of assignment, transfers, certificates, assurances, powers of attorney and other instruments necessary (or as the Indenture Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, may reasonably request from time to time) in order to (i) enable the Issuer to lawfully perform and comply with its obligations under the Indenture and the Notes, (ii) to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, subject the Collateral (including for the avoidance of doubt any Project Improvements to the extent required by “Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Funding of Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements”) to the Security Interests, (iii) perfect and maintain the validity, effectiveness and priority of any of the Security Documents (including the powers of attorney granted thereunder) and the Security Interests created thereunder and (iv) assure, convey, grant, assign, transfer, preserve and protect and confirm more effectively to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, for the benefit of the Secured Parties the rights granted or purported to be granted in accordance with the terms of the Security Documents; provided that, in any case, the security interest on the Collateral will be fully perfected in the terms set forth herein by the corresponding Panamanian Collateral Outside Date.

(c) enable the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, on behalf of the Secured Parties, to exercise and enforce their respective rights, powers, remedies and privileges under the Security Documents, including the making or delivery of all filings and recordings, the payments of fees and other charges, the issuance of supplemental documentation, the discharge of all claims or other Liens (other than Permitted Liens) adversely affecting the rights of the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, on behalf of the Secured Parties, to and under the Collateral and the publication or other delivery of notice to third parties;

(d) execute and deliver to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, with a copy to the Intercreditor Agent promptly after receipt thereof, in accordance with the terms of the relevant Security Document, such other documents as necessary (or required by the Panamanian Trustee, the Collateral Agent or the Intercreditor Agent) to fulfil the Issuer's obligations under the Security Documents;

(e) take any action necessary (or desirable to be taken to perfect a Security Interest if the Intercreditor Agent agrees (acting as directed by a Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors)) except to the extent that the costs of taking such action are excessive in relation to the value afforded to the Secured Parties of perfecting such Security Interest;

(f) refrain from taking any action that could reasonably be expected, in the discretion of the Issuer, to result in material tax consequences to the Issuer; and

(g) take any action that would require obtaining the consent or acknowledgment of any third party (other than the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, and the Intercreditor Agent) in respect of a Security Interest, in accordance with the terms of the relevant Security Document.

## Maintenance of Rating

The Issuer will at all times use commercially reasonably efforts to maintain a rating of the Notes by at least two Rating Agencies, provided, however, that, in the event that one or more Rating Agencies (a) ceases to exist, (b) ceases to issue ratings of the type issued in respect of the Notes as of the Issue Date or (c) refuses or otherwise declines to provide a rating for the Notes (other than due to the Issuer's failure to (i) provide such Rating Agency with such reports and other information or documents, as such Rating Agency will reasonably request to monitor and continue to assign ratings to the Notes, (ii) pay customary fees to such Rating Agency in connection therewith or (iii) take any

177

other action reasonably requested by such Rating Agency in connection therewith) (and, in each of cases (a) through (c) above, the Issuer is unable to substitute another Rating Agency in place of such Rating Agency), the failure by the Issuer to obtain or maintain such rating will not constitute a Default or Indenture Event of Default. For the avoidance of doubt, the Issuer will not have any obligation to maintain any particular minimum rating or level of rating in respect of itself or the Notes or maintain a rating with any particular Rating Agency.

## Maintenance of Insurance

The Issuer will obtain and maintain, or procure its contractors to obtain and maintain, insurance coverage in such amounts and covering such risks as set forth in the Financing Documents. To the extent not already assigned to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, the Issuer will assign the Required Insurance Policies within 180 days from the Issue Date or the applicable effective date of any renewal or replacement of such Required Insurance Policies, and will, therefore cause that all casualty insurance proceeds received under such Required Insurance Policies not applied to restore the Collateral or to continue operations during such restoration of the Collateral, to be delivered to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, under the Security Documents. The Issuer will, not later than 180 days from the Issue Date, amend the Required Insurance Policies to replace any agent of the secured parties under the Existing Project Loan Credit Agreement with the Collateral Agent as insured party or loss payee, as applicable, provided that during such 180-day period, the Issuer will use commercially reasonable best efforts to work with the relevant insurers and insurance brokers to procure the required endorsements and effect such assignments as promptly as reasonably practicable.

## Maintenance of Permits

The Issuer will obtain and maintain in full force and effect all material Governmental Approvals required under Applicable Law to be obtained or maintained by it in connection with the operation of the Project and the performance of its obligations under the Material Project Documents and under the Notes, the Indenture and the other Financing Documents except, in each case, to the extent failure to so maintain would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

## Maintenance of Properties

The Issuer will cause all material Property used or useful in the conduct of its business to be maintained and kept in good condition, repair and working order as in the judgment of the Issuer, as applicable, may be necessary so that the Project may be maintained and operated in conformity with the Material Project Documents and consistent with Prudent Industry Practices, except to the extent failure to so comply would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect; provided that nothing will prevent the Issuer from discontinuing the use, operation or maintenance of any of such Properties or disposing of any of them, if such discontinuance or disposal is, in the judgment of the Issuer, desirable in the conduct of the business of the Issuer, taken as a whole.

## Maintenance of Title

The Issuer will obtain and maintain in force good and valid title and/or rights to the Properties as are necessary for the maintenance and operation of the Project, except to the extent failure to so comply would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

## Books and Records

The Issuer will, with respect to itself and the Project, as applicable, (i) maintain books of record and accounts in conformity with applicable Accounting Standards consistently applied and in conformity with applicable requirements of any Governmental Authority having regulatory jurisdiction over the Issuer and which books of records and accounts may be reviewed by the Indenture Trustee upon reasonable notice during normal business hours and (ii) maintain internal accounting, management information and cost control systems adequate to ensure compliance with Applicable Laws in Panama.

## Reporting and Information

The Indenture will provide that, for so long as any Notes remain outstanding, the Issuer will give, or procure

178

to be given, to the Indenture Trustee (and upon request, to the Noteholders) with respect to any outstanding Notes:

(a) Operating Budget:

(i) Within 30 days prior to the end of each Fiscal Year, the Issuer will deliver to the Intercreditor Agent (with a copy to the Independent Engineer), an Operating Budget for the upcoming Fiscal Year, accompanied by a certificate of an Authorized Officer of the Issuer certifying that such Operating Budget has been prepared in good faith on the basis of reasonable assumptions for the period covered that the Issuer believes to be reasonable as to all factual and legal matters then known to the Issuer that are material to such estimates; provided that each Operating Budget will (A) contain estimates of the consolidated revenues and Operating Expenses based on the Issuer's fair and reasonable projections at such time based on facts and circumstances then existing and known to the Issuer and (B) reflect the Issuer's commercially reasonable estimate of future results.

(ii) To the extent the aggregate amount of Operating Expenses projected to be payable by the Issuer under such Operating Budget for the applicable Fiscal Year would exceed one hundred and fifteen percent (115%) of the Operating Expenses set forth in the then-current Operating Budget for such Fiscal Year, (A) the Issuer has provided to the Independent Engineer (with a copy to the Indenture Trustee) an amendment to the then-current Operating Budget, together with an Officer's Certificate of the Issuer stating that the Operating Expenses set forth in such amendment are, in the good faith opinion of the Issuer, reasonably necessary or advisable for the execution and/or operation and maintenance of the Project and the Independent Engineer shall have certified in writing to the Indenture Trustee that such amendment is, in its professional opinion and based on the information it has been provided (which information shall include all such documents and information the Independent Engineer shall deem to be reasonably necessary for the purpose of issuing such certificate), reasonably necessary or advisable for the execution and/or operation and maintenance of the Project or (B) such Operating Expenses are necessary to pay expenses associated with an operating emergency or major maintenance, as confirmed by the Independent Engineer.

(iii) For purposes of determining whether the Operating Budget for any Fiscal Year would exceed the limitation in paragraph (ii) above, documented costs, expenses and payments in connection with LNG Transactions incurred under the LNG Sale and Purchase Agreement, any other LNG sale and purchase agreements or spot market purchases entered into by the Company from time to time in accordance with “—Limitation on Entry into Additional Project Contracts, etc.” (other than in connection with Derivative Transactions entered into in connection with LNG Transactions) (“LNG Costs”) will be excluded from the definition of Operating Expenses.

(b) Issuer and Holding Company Financial Statements:

(i) as soon as available, and in any event within 120 days after the end of each Fiscal Year, an audited consolidated balance sheet of (A) prior to the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company and (B) following the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization, the Issuer, in each case, as at the end of such Fiscal Year, and the related statements of income or operations and cash flows for such Fiscal Year, in accordance with applicable Accounting Standards, audited and accompanied by an opinion of the Independent Accountants, which opinion will state that such financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, our financial position at the end of, and for, such fiscal year, prepared in accordance with applicable Accounting Standards. The annual financial statements will be accompanied by a “management discussion and analysis of results of operations and financial condition” providing an overview in reasonable detail of the consolidated results of operations and financial condition of (x) prior to the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company and (y) following the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization, the Issuer, and, in each case, will include the related notes in respect thereof.

179

(ii) In addition, within 60 days of the end of the first three Fiscal Quarters of each Fiscal Year of each of (A) prior to the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company and (B) following the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization, the Issuer, in each case, unaudited consolidated quarterly financial statements (including a balance sheet, statement of comprehensive income and cash flow statement). The quarterly financial statements will be accompanied by a brief narrative overview of the results of operations and financial condition of each of (x) prior to the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company and (y) following the consummation of the Corporate Reorganization, the Issuer. English translations will be provided of any of the foregoing documents prepared in another language.

(c) SGX-ST Reports and Notices: Without duplication, upon request, English language versions or summaries in electronic format of such other reports or notices as may be filed or submitted by (and within 10 days after filing or submission by) the Issuer with the SGX-ST, or any other stock exchange on which the Notes may be listed, in each case, to the extent that any such report or notice is generally available to the Issuer's debt holders; provided, however, that the Issuer will not be required to furnish such information to the extent such information is available on the Issuer's website or to the extent that the information contained therein is substantially similar to (a) above;

(d) Latinex and SMV Reports and Notices: Without duplication, upon request, the English language version or summaries in electronic format or such other reports or notices as may be filed or submitted by the Issuer with Latinex and/or with the SMV pursuant to Panamanian Securities laws, in each case, to the extent that any such report or notice is generally available to the Issuer's debt holders; provided, however, that the Issuer will not be required to furnish such information to the extent such information is available on the Issuer's website or to the extent that the information contained therein are substantially similar to (b) and/or (c) above;

(e) Debt Service Coverage Ratio: No later than 30 days following each Scheduled Payment Date, a Debt Service Coverage Statement for such Scheduled Payment Date, stating the Debt Service Coverage Ratio as of such Scheduled Payment Date for the Calculation Period ending on such Scheduled Payment Date (or, if less than twelve months, the period commencing on the Issue Date and ending on such Scheduled Payment Date); and

(f) Notices: the notices required in accordance with the provisions under the second paragraph of the caption “—Compliance Certificate.”

In addition, the Indenture will provide that, for so long as any Notes remain outstanding, the Issuer will furnish to the Noteholders and beneficial owners of the Notes and to securities analysts and bona fide prospective investors in the Notes, upon their request (which in the case of bona fide investors in the Notes may be subject to customary confirmation of such status), the information required to be delivered pursuant to Rule 144A(d)(4) under the Securities Act (or any successor provision thereto) if, at the time of such request, the Issuer is neither a reporting company under Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act, nor exempt from reporting pursuant to Rule 12g3-2(b) thereunder.

The Indenture Trustee will have no duty to review or analyze reports delivered to it. Delivery of such reports, information and documents to the Indenture Trustee is for informational purposes only, and the Trustee's receipt thereof will not constitute actual or constructive notice of any information contained therein or determinable from information contained therein, including the Issuer's compliance with any of its covenants under the Indenture (as to which the Indenture Trustee is entitled to certificates). The Indenture Trustee will not be obligated to monitor or confirm, on a continuing basis or otherwise, the Issuer's compliance with the covenants or with respect to any reports or other documents filed on any website.

Simultaneously with the delivery of each set of financial statements referred to in clauses (a) above, the Issuer will provide the Indenture Trustee with an Officer's Certificate stating (1) that such financial statements fairly and accurately present the consolidated financial condition and results of operations of the Issuer on the dates and for the periods indicated in accordance with the applicable Accounting Standards, subject to the absence of footnotes and normally recurring period adjustments, (2) whether a Default or Indenture Event of Default exists on the date of such

180

Officer’s Certificate and, if a Default or Indenture Event of Default exists, setting forth the details thereof and the action which the Issuer is taking or propose to take with respect thereto, and (3) that there has been no notice, demand or other communication given or received by the Issuer (x) pursuant to or relating to any Governmental Approval or (y) to or from any Governmental Authority relating in any way to the Project, in each case identifying matters which would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, or except as detailed in such certificate. Except where otherwise indicated, all reports, notices, certificates and other documents delivered pursuant to this “Reporting Requirements” covenant will be in the English language.

## Use of Proceeds

The Issuer will use the net proceeds from the offering of the Notes in the manner set forth under “Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds” and “Use of Proceeds.”

## Ranking

The Issuer will ensure that the Notes and all amounts due under the Indenture will constitute its direct, unconditional and general senior secured obligations and will at all times rank, equal in right of payment, with the Senior Debt and all its other existing and future unsecured and unsubordinated obligations, in each case, to the extent permitted under the Indenture, and following the repayment in full of the Existing Facilities and the execution and delivery of the New Debt Sworn Statement by the Issuer, will benefit, on a pari passu basis with the Senior Debt from a first-priority Lien on the Collateral.

## Material Project Documents, etc.

The Issuer will, (a) perform and observe all terms and provisions of the Material Project Documents to be performed or observed by it, (b) maintain the Material Project Documents to which it is a party in full force and effect, and (c) exercise all its rights, discretion and remedies, if any, under the Material Project Documents to which it is a party in accordance with their terms and in a manner consistent with (and subject to) the Issuer’s obligations under the Indenture and the Security Documents, in each case of clauses (a) through (c) above, except to the extent that failure to do any of the foregoing would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

The Issuer will not, directly or indirectly:

(a) permit, issue notice or take any other steps which would lead to the cancellation, suspension or termination of any Material Project Document;

(b) give any termination notice under a Material Project Document;

(c) amend, modify or change in any manner any term or condition of any Material Project Document or give any consent, waiver or approval under any Material Project Document;

(d) sell, assign (other than pursuant to the Security Documents) or otherwise dispose of (by operation of law or otherwise) any part of its interest in any Material Project Document (other than as required by the Security Documents); or
