(e) permit or consent to the assignment of a Material Project Document (other than pursuant to the Security Documents) by the counterparty thereto,

in each case, other than (d), unless any such action would not reasonably be expected to cause a Material Adverse Effect; provided further that, for the avoidance of doubt, none of the limitations in (a) through (e) will apply to Additional Material Project Documents or Additional Material PPAs.

## Compliance Certificate

The Issuer will deliver to the Indenture Trustee, at the time the Issuer is required to deliver annual audited Financial Statements under the covenant described under the caption “—Reporting and Information,” an Officer’s Certificate stating that a review of the activities of the Issuer during the preceding fiscal year has been made under the

181

supervision of the signing Authorized Officer with a view to determining whether the Issuer has kept, observed, performed and fulfilled its respective obligations under the Indenture, and further stating, as to each such Authorized Officer signing such certificate, that to the best of his or her knowledge the Issuer has kept, observed, performed and fulfilled each covenant contained in the Indenture and is not in default in the performance or observance of any of the terms, provisions and conditions of the Indenture (or, if a Default or Indenture Event of Default has occurred, describing all such Defaults or Indenture Events of Default of which he or she may have knowledge and what action the Issuer is taking or proposes to take with respect thereto).

So long as any of the Notes are outstanding, the Issuer will deliver to the Indenture Trustee, an Officer's Certificate promptly (but in any event within ten Business Days, or such other applicable period) upon any Authorized Officer becoming aware of (a) the occurrence of any Default or Indenture Event of Default, specifying such Default or Indenture Event of Default and what action the Issuer is taking or proposes to take with respect thereto, (b) the occurrence of any material default under, or any amendment, waiver, modification, supplement, cancellation, suspension or termination of, under or in respect of any Material Project Document (except for any amendments, modifications, waivers or supplements of a clerical, technical or administrative matter or that would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect) and any request therefor and specifying what action the Issuer is taking or proposes to take with respect thereto, (c) a Change of Control and (d) the entering into of any Additional Material PPA or any other Additional Material Project Documents, together with copies of any such agreements.

## Inspection

The Issuer will permit representatives of the Noteholders, the Indenture Trustee, and the Collateral Agent under guidance of officers of the Issuer, to visit and inspect any of the properties of the Issuer and to examine the Issuer's corporate, financial, operating and other records, no more than once per year at the expense of Noteholders and at such reasonable times during normal business hours, upon reasonable advance written notice to the Issuer and with the Issuer consent (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld); provided that when an Indenture Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, or upon the occurrence of an Event of Loss, representatives of the holders of the Notes, the Indenture Trustee and the Collateral Agent may do any of the foregoing as often as may be reasonably desired at the expense of the Issuer at any time during normal business hours and without advance notice.

## Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets

Other than the Corporate Reorganization, the Issuer will not consolidate with or merge with or into, or assign, convey, transfer or lease, in one transaction or a series of transactions, directly or indirectly, all or substantially all its assets to, any Person, unless:

(a) either (i) the Issuer is the surviving or continuing person; or (ii) the resulting, surviving or transferee person, if not the Issuer (the "Successor Obligor"), (A) will be organized or existing under the laws of (1) the United States (or any State thereof or the District of Columbia) or Panama or (2) any country that is a member of the European Union or any political subdivision thereof or that belongs to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, provided that such jurisdictional choice will not have a Material Adverse Effect, and in each case of (1) and (2) whose debt securities are rated investment grade; (B) will expressly assume all of the Issuer's obligations under the Notes, Indenture, the Security Documents and the other Financing Documents, and (C) will appoint a process agent in the Borough of Manhattan, the City of New York, to receive service of process on its behalf in relation to any legal action or proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Notes and the Indenture, as applicable;

(b) immediately after giving pro forma effect to such transaction and the repayment of any related Indebtedness (and treating any Indebtedness which becomes an obligation of the Successor Obligor as a result of such transaction as having been incurred by such Successor Obligor at the time of such transaction), no Default will have occurred and be Continuing;

(c) immediately after giving pro forma effect to such transaction, the Issuer or the Person formed by or surviving any such consolidation or merger (if other than the Issuer), or to which such sale, assignment, conveyance, transfer, lease or other disposition will have been made, will be permitted

182

to Incur at least $1.00 of additional Indebtedness pursuant to the Debt Service Coverage Ratio tests set forth in the covenant described above under the caption “— Limitation on Indebtedness”;

(d) such transaction will be made expressly subject to the granting of (or continuation of, as applicable) a Lien in favor of the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, on the Equity Interests of the Successor Obligor and all subsidiaries thereof (if any), and the guaranty of the obligations under the Indenture by each such subsidiary (if any), and any Person that becomes the direct owner of any Equity Interest in the Issuer as a result of such transaction will, simultaneously with such transaction, grant to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, a Lien on such direct Equity Interests pursuant to a pledge agreement substantially similar to the applicable Security Documents;

(e) within 30 Business Days of such transaction, the Successor Obligor will execute and deliver to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, with a copy to the Intercreditor Agent such other documents and instruments as necessary or as the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, may reasonably request in order to evidence, secure, and perfect the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, security interest in and Lien on such Equity Interests and the other Collateral;

(f) such Successor Obligor will not have any existing Indebtedness or Liens (other than Permitted Indebtedness or Permitted Liens) or any environmental liabilities or other legal liabilities (other than de minimis liabilities to Governmental Authorities relating to the maintenance of its existence); and

(g) the Issuer will have delivered to the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate and a New York law opinion of counsel in New York certifying that such transaction complies with the foregoing requirements.

The Successor Obligor will be the successor to the Issuer and will succeed to, and be substituted for, and may exercise every right and power of, the Issuer under the Financing Documents, and the Issuer as transferor or non-surviving Person will be released from its obligation under the Indenture, as the case may be.

## Sale Lease-Back Transactions

The Issuer will not enter into any Sale and Leaseback Transaction.

## Accounts

The Issuer will open and maintain each Project Account. The Issuer will cause the Notes Debt Service Reserve Account to be funded at all times, with cash, Acceptable LCs, or any combination of the foregoing equal to the Notes Debt Service Reserve Requirement and in accordance with the Security and Depositary Agreement.

The Issuer will not establish or maintain any accounts, other than the Project Accounts, the Distribution Account, the Local Accounts, and such other accounts as otherwise permitted pursuant to the Security Documents, in each case, in accordance with the Security Documents.

For the avoidance of doubt, upon the Existing Facilities Repayment Date, amounts standing to the credit of any accounts established in connection with the Existing Facilities will be deposited into Project Accounts as directed by the Issuer pursuant to the Funds Flow Memorandum and the New Debt Sworn Statement.

## Share Purchase Agreement

The Issuer will not undertake the Corporate Reorganization until such time as the Holding Company has no outstanding obligations under the Share Purchase Agreement.

## Certain Covenants of the Holding Company

For so long as any Notes are outstanding, and until such time as it has merged or combined into the Issuer pursuant to the Corporate Reorganization, through the terms of the Indenture and the Notes, the Holding Company

183

will be subject to certain covenants as further described below.

(a) **Limitation on Indebtedness.** The Holding Company will not, directly or indirectly, create, incur, assume or guaranty, or otherwise become or remain directly or indirectly liable with respect to any Indebtedness, except that the Holding Company may Incur the following Indebtedness (the “HoldCo Permitted Indebtedness”):

(i) Indebtedness in respect of the Existing Mezzanine Credit Agreement on the Issue Date; **provided that**, all Indebtedness incurred under or in connection with the Existing Mezzanine Credit Agreement will only be considered permitted Indebtedness until the second Business Day after the Issue Date; and

(ii) Indebtedness under the Share Purchase Agreement.

(b) **Limitation on Distributions.** Except in the case of any amounts distributed to the Holding Company as described under the caption “Disposition of Issue Date Proceeds” and in accordance with “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Distributions”, the Holding Company will not make any Distribution.

(c) **Limitation on Liens.** The Holding Company will not directly or indirectly, create, assume, incur, permit or allow to exist any Lien securing Indebtedness on or with respect to any of its Properties or assets now owned or hereafter acquired by it or on any income or revenues or rights in respect of any thereof, except for the following types of Liens

(i) Liens in favor of the Secured Parties created under or pursuant to any Security Document;

(ii) solely until the Issue Date, Liens for the benefit of the secured parties under the Existing Facilities;

(iii) Liens for taxes, assessments and governmental charges, the non-payment of which do not violate the covenant to pay taxes and Liens for customs duties arising in the ordinary course of business; and

(iv) statutory liens or contractual rights of set-off in favor of banks or other depositary institutions

(d) **Limitation on Investments.** The Holding Company will not (i) form, have or acquire any Subsidiary other than the Issuer or a Permitted Project Subsidiary or (ii) make any Investment other than (x) any capital contribution to the Issuer or the acquisition of Equity Interests in the Issuer, and in each case, except as required to consummate the Corporate Reorganization and (y) any capital contribution to the Issuer or a Permitted Project Subsidiary or the acquisition of Equity Interests in the Issuer or a Permitted Project Subsidiary.

(e) **Limitation on Asset Sales.** The Holding Company will not make any Asset Sales, except as required to consummate the Corporate Reorganization.

(f) **Limitation on Business Activities.** The Holding Company will not (i) conduct, transact or otherwise engage in any business or operations other than those reasonably incidental to its ownership of the Equity Interests of the Issuer or a Permitted Project Subsidiary, and any reasonably similar, related, incidental, ancillary or complimentary businesses, (ii) change its type of organization, jurisdiction or other legal structure, (iii) own or occupy any real property, (iv) have any employees, (v) amend or modify any of its organizational documents (except as may be required by law or in connection with the Corporate Reorganization) or change its fiscal year, unless, in each case, such action could not reasonably be expected to adversely affect its capitalization or its capital structure; (vi) become a party to any agreement, contract or commitment other than the Financing Documents, agreements, contracts or commitments contemplated or permitted by the Financing Documents or other contracts entered into by it in the ordinary course of business. Nothing contained herein will restrict the ability

184

of the Holding Company to consummate the Corporate Reorganization.

(g) **Maintenance of Existence; Separateness.** Subject to the rights of the Holding Company to carry out the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company will do all things necessary to maintain: (i) its legal form of existence in its jurisdiction of organization, incorporation, registration and/or formation; and (ii) the power and authority (corporate, partnership and otherwise) necessary under applicable Requirements of Law to own its Properties (if any) and to carry on its business. Subject to the rights of the Holding Company to carry out the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company will not (i) take any action that is reasonably likely to result in its separate existence being ignored or in its assets and liabilities being substantively consolidated with any other person in a bankruptcy, reorganization, or other insolvency proceeding or, (ii) except as reasonably required to consummate the Corporate Reorganization or to change its board of directors, officers or legal representatives, amend or modify in any material respect any of its organizational documents. Without limiting the foregoing and except as contemplated by the Financing Documents, the Holding Company will (i) conduct in all material respects its business solely in its own name, (ii) maintain accounts separate from those of any Affiliates and (iii) not commingle its funds with those of any other Affiliates.

(h) **Compliance with Laws; Contractual Obligations.**

(i) The Holding Company will comply with all Applicable Laws and all orders, writs, injunctions and decrees applicable to it or to its business or property (including any Environmental Law), and all orders, writs, injunctions and decrees applicable to it or to its business or property (including any Environmental Law) of any Governmental Authority having jurisdiction over it or its business, except where any failure to so comply could not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

(ii) The Holding Company will not direct, consent to or enter into any transfer of rights, termination, suspension, assignment, amendment or waiver under or to any Financing Document to which it is a party unless it is permitted by the terms of such Financing Document.

(iii) The Holding Company will cooperate in the enforcement of, its respective rights under the Financing Document to which it is a party.

(i) **Payment Obligations.** The Holding Company will comply with all Applicable Laws relating to taxes, duties, or other governmental charges imposed or levied by or on behalf of Panama or any political subdivision thereof in which it is organized or is a resident for tax purposes and which has power to tax such Person, except where (i) the validity of the required payment is being contested by it with respect to which adequate reserves have been established to the extent required by the applicable Accounting Standards or (ii) the failure to so comply would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

(j) **Further Assurances; Preservation and Protection of New Share Pledge Agreement; Perfection and Maintenance of New Share Pledge Agreement.**

(i) Solely with respect to the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, the Holding Company will not later than on the relevant Panamanian Collateral Outside Date, provide to the Panamanian Trustee:

(A) evidence that the provisions of the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement is effective to create a legal, valid and enforceable first priority Lien, or right, as applicable, in favor of the Panamanian Trustee for the benefit of the Secured Parties, on all of the Collateral covered thereby, subject to the conditions set forth therein, and all necessary recordings and notarizations in respect thereof necessary to ensure the validity and enforceability or admissibility in evidence thereof, have been made in all appropriate public offices and all other necessary action has been

185

taken, subject to the conditions set forth therein, so that the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement creates a Lien in the Collateral covered thereby, prior and superior in right to all other Liens except for Permitted Liens mandatorily preferred by Applicable Law, including under the Laws of Panama and New York;

(B) copies or other evidence that all notarization (where appropriate) and other fees and expenses related to such notarizations, if any, have been paid in full; and

(C) copies of all documents (signed, where applicable) required to be provided on the execution date of the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement under the terms thereof (including any share certificates, instruments of transfer, letters of instruction, resignation and authorization, powers of attorney and proxies).

(ii) Subject to the applicable limitations set forth in the Security Documents, the Holding Company will, at its own expense, cooperate and take all necessary steps to, as applicable, and solely with respect to the Financing Documents it is a party to:

(A) correct any material defect or error that may be discovered in the Indenture and any Security Document or in the execution, acknowledgment, filing or recordation thereof;

(B) do, execute, acknowledge, deliver, record, re-record, file, re-file, register and re-register any and all such further acts, public deeds, conveyances, pledge agreements, mortgages, deeds of trust, trust deeds, assignments, financing statements and continuations thereof, termination statements, notices of assignment, transfers, certificates, assurances, powers of attorney and other instruments necessary (or as the Indenture Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, may reasonably request from time to time) in order to (A) enable the Holding Company to lawfully perform and comply with its obligations under the Indenture, (B) to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, subject the Collateral under the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement to the Security Interests, (C) perfect and maintain the validity, effectiveness and priority of the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement (including the powers of attorney granted thereunder) and the Security Interests created thereunder and (D) assure, convey, grant, assign, transfer, preserve and protect and confirm more effectively to the Panamanian Trustee for the benefit of the Secured Parties the rights granted or purported to be granted in accordance with the terms of the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement;

(C) enable the Panamanian Trustee, on behalf of the Secured Parties, to exercise and enforce their respective rights, powers, remedies and privileges under the A&amp;R Issuer Share Pledge Agreement, including the making or delivery of all filings and recordings, the payments of fees and other charges, the issuance of supplemental documentation, the discharge of all claims or other Liens (other than Permitted Liens) adversely affecting the rights of the Panamanian Trustee on behalf of the Secured Parties, to and under the Collateral and the publication or other delivery of notice to third parties;

(D) take any action necessary or desirable to be taken to perfect a Security Interest if the Intercreditor Agent agrees (acting as directed by a Majority in Interest of the Senior Creditors) except to the extent that the costs of taking such action are excessive in relation to the value afforded to the Secured Parties of perfecting such Security Interest;

(E) refrain from taking any action that could reasonably be expected, in the discretion of the Issuer, to result in material tax consequences to the Issuer; and

186

(F) take any action that would require obtaining the consent or acknowledgment of any third party (other than the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, and the Intercreditor Agent) in respect of a Security Interest.

(k) **Books and Records.** The Holding Company will (i) maintain books of record and accounts in conformity with applicable Accounting Standards consistently applied and in conformity with applicable requirements of any Governmental Authority having regulatory jurisdiction over the Holding Company, and which books of records and accounts may be reviewed by the Indenture Trustee upon reasonable notice during normal business hours and (ii) maintain internal accounting, management information and cost control systems adequate to ensure compliance with Applicable Laws in Panama.

(l) **Compliance Certificate.**

So long as any of the Notes are outstanding, prior to the Corporate Reorganization, the Holding Company will deliver to the Indenture Trustee, an Officer’s Certificate promptly (but in any event within ten Business Days, or such other applicable period) upon any Authorized Officer becoming aware of the occurrence of any Default or Indenture Event of Default applicable to it, specifying such Default or Indenture Event of Default and what action the it is taking or proposes to take with respect thereto.

(m) **Capital expenditures.** The Holding Company will not make any capital expenditures, other than as permitted under the caption “Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Funding of Permitted Project Expansions and Project Improvements” or as otherwise permitted under the Indenture.

(n) **Inspection.** The Holding Company will permit representatives of the Noteholders, the Indenture Trustee, and the Collateral Agent under guidance of officers of the Holding Company to visit and inspect any of the properties of the Holding Company, as applicable and to examine the corporate, financial, operating and other records of the Holding Company no more than once per year at the expense of Noteholders and at such reasonable times during normal business hours, upon reasonable advance written notice and with the Holding Company’s consent (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld); provided that when an Indenture Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, or upon the occurrence of an Event of Loss, representatives of the holders of the Notes, the Indenture Trustee and the Collateral Agent may do any of the foregoing as often as may be reasonably desired at the expense of the Issuer at any time during normal business hours and without advance notice or consent.

(o) **Maintenance of Permits.** The Holding Company will obtain and maintain, or cause to be obtained and maintained, in full force and effect and in a timely manner all Governmental Approvals, rights, franchises and licenses necessary for (i) its incorporation or formation and (ii) the enforceability or performance of its obligations under any Financing Document (including the creation, perfection or enforceability of any Lien contemplated to be granted by it thereby), except, in each case, to the extent failure to so maintain would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect;

(p) **Accounts.** Following the repayment of the Existing Mezzanine Credit Agreement, the Holding Company will not establish or maintain any accounts, other than any operating accounts existing on the Issue Date.

(q) **Share Purchase Agreement.** The Holding Company shall not undertake the Corporate Reorganization until such time as the Holding Company has no outstanding obligations under the Share Purchase Agreement.

# Events of Default and Remedies

Each of the following is an “Indenture Event of Default”:

(a) the Issuer will fail to pay (i) any amount of principal of the Notes when the same becomes due and payable, provided that solely with respect to any such failure to pay which resulted from a cause or causes that are technical or administrative in nature and not from a failure by the Issuer to make a good-faith effort to make such payment, such failure will not constitute an Indenture Event of Default unless such failure continues for a period of three Business Days following the date on which such payment was due and payable, (ii) any interest, Additional Amount or Make-Whole Amount, if any, on the Notes within 30 days after the same becomes due and payable or (iii) any other fee or payment, due and payable under any Financing Document, within five Business Days following the date on which such payment was due and payable;

(b) failure by the Issuer or the Holding Company, as applicable, to comply with (i) the covenants described under “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Limitation on Indebtedness”, “—Limitation on Distributions,” “—Limitation on Investments,” “—Limitation on Liens,” “—Limitation on Asset Sales,” “—Limitation on Transactions with Affiliates,” “—Limitation on Business Activities,” “—Merger, Consolidation or Sale of Substantially All Assets,” “—Sale Lease-Back Transactions,” “—Share Purchase Agreement,” “—Certain Covenants of the Holding Company—Limitation on Indebtedness,” “—Share Purchase Agreement,” “—Limitation on Distributions,” “—Limitation on Liens,” “—Limitation on Investments,” “—Limitation on Asset Sales” and “—Limitation on Business Activities” hereof for a 60-day period following the earlier of the Issuer becoming aware of such Default or receipt by the Issuer of written notice from the Indenture Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent or any Collateral Agent, or (ii) any other covenant under any Financing Document to which it is a party, and such failure continues for 60 days after the Indenture Trustee or Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding have notified an Authorized Officer of the Issuer of the existence of such Default; provided that if the Issuer or such Shareholder, as applicable, is taking diligent action to cure such failure to perform, an Indenture Event of Default will occur only if such Person, as applicable, fails to cure within 90 days after such notice;

(c) any representation or warranty made by the Issuer or any Shareholder under the Indenture or any other Financing Document or Material Project Document to which it is a party or any certificate, document or financial or other written statement furnished to the Indenture Trustee, the Intercreditor Agent or the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, pursuant to the provisions thereof, proves to be incorrect in any material respect when made or deemed made and such has had a Material Adverse Effect which the Issuer or such Shareholder, as applicable, is not able to eliminate within 30 days after the earlier to occur of the Issuer or such Shareholder obtaining knowledge thereof and the Indenture Trustee or the Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding notifying an Authorized Officer of the Issuer of the existence of such Default; provided that, if the Issuer or such Shareholder, as applicable, is taking diligent action to address the underlying facts or circumstances causing such inaccuracies, an Indenture Event of Default will occur only if such Person fails to cure within 60 days after the earlier to occur of such knowledge or receipt of such notice;

(d) any Security Document (once executed and delivered and, where appropriate, noticed to counterparties, registered or where other action has been taken in accordance with all Applicable Law and the Indenture) fails to provide the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable, the Security Interests or relative priority intended to be created thereby on any material portion of the Collateral purported to be covered thereby, except when due to clerical error; provided that, the Issuer and the pledgors thereunder will be diligently pursuing the perfection of such lien and such clerical error will be corrected no later than 30 Business Days after the earlier of (i) an Authorized Officer of the Issuer having knowledge of such clerical error and (ii) written notice thereof has been given to the Issuer by the Indenture Trustee, Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding, the Intercreditor Agent or the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee, as applicable;

(e) an event of Bankruptcy has occurred (i) with respect to the Issuer or (ii) to the extent it has ongoing outstanding obligations under (A) any Assigned PPA, with respect to EDEMET, EDECHI or ENSA and (B) the TUA or the OCA, with respect to the Operator provided that the Bankruptcy of EDEMET, EDECHI or ENSA will not constitute an Event of Default to the extent that the relevant counterparty continues to make payments in full (other than termination payments) in accordance with its Assigned PPAs and provided further that the Bankruptcy of the Operator will not constitute an Event of Default to the extent that (1) the Operator continues to perform, in all material respects, the services stipulated under the TUA and the OCA, (2) the Issuer delivers to the Indenture Trustee within 30 days of the Operator's declaration of Bankruptcy, a certificate certifying that such Bankruptcy does not have, and is reasonably expected not to have, a Material Adverse Effect, and (3) an Acceptable Technical Consultant delivers to the Indenture Trustee a written confirmation that the operations of the Project are not, and are reasonably expected not to be, materially adversely affected;

(f) any Material Project Document is terminated, rescinded, cancelled, suspended or repudiated by the Issuer or any other party thereto or any Material Project Document is determined in a final proceeding to be invalid and not binding and not in full force and effect prior to termination in accordance with its terms unless, in each such case, (i) the Indenture Trustee will have received a certificate from the Issuer that such event would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect and (ii) such Material Project Document is replaced with a Replacement Material Project Document within 180 days of the termination thereof;

(g) (i) Except as could not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect, any provision of any Material Project Document, at any time after its execution and delivery and for any reason other than as expressly permitted hereunder or thereunder, ceases to be in full force and effect unless the same is being contested by the Issuer; (ii) the Issuer or any other Person contests in any manner the validity or enforceability of any provision of any Material Project Document; or (iii) the Issuer denies that it has any or further liability or obligation under any Material Project Document, or purports to revoke, terminate, suspend or rescind any Material Project Document;

(h) there is entered against the Issuer (a) final, non-appealable judgments or orders for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding U.S.$20 million that the Issuer fails to make payment thereof within the period of time mandated by such judgment or order or (b) any one or more non-monetary judgments that have, or would reasonably be expected to have, individually or in the aggregate, a Material Adverse Effect and, in either case, (i) enforcement proceedings are commenced by any creditor upon such judgment or order, or (ii) there is a period of 60 consecutive days during which a stay of enforcement of such judgment, by reason of a pending appeal or otherwise, is not in effect;

(i) (i) the Issuer defaults in the payment of any principal of or interest on any of its Indebtedness for borrowed money other than as set forth under the Financing Documents (whether at Stated Maturity or otherwise) in an amount in excess of U.S.$20 million and such default continues beyond any applicable grace period set forth in the agreements or instruments evidencing or relating to such Indebtedness, or (ii) the Issuer's debt under the Letter of Credit Facility or other Indebtedness for borrowed money other than the Notes, in each case in an outstanding principal amount in excess of U.S.$20 million becomes due (or required to be prepaid, repurchased, redeemed, cash collateralized or defeased) and payable prior to the scheduled maturity thereof;

(j) the Indenture or any other Notes Document will cease to be in full force and effect (other than in accordance with its terms) or is declared in any judgment or order unenforceable by a Governmental Authority having jurisdiction over any party thereto or the subject matter thereof or the AES Sponsor or the InterEnergy Sponsor, the Issuer will deny, contest or repudiate in writing the enforceability or validity of its obligations thereunder, or any Governmental Authority asserting *de jure* or *de facto* governmental or police powers in Panama or any other applicable jurisdiction will, by moratorium laws or otherwise, cancel, suspend or defer the obligation of the Issuer to pay any amount required

189

to be paid under the Indenture when the same becomes due and payable thereunder and such cancellation, suspension or deferral will continue for 10 or more consecutive Business Days;

(k) the occurrence of an Event of Abandonment that continues for more than 15 consecutive days; or

(l) all or substantially all of the Project or substantially all of the assets of the Project are subject to an Event of Loss.

If any Indenture Event of Default under clause (e) above will occur with respect to the Issuer then the principal of, premium, if any, any Additional Amounts and accrued and unpaid interest on all of the outstanding Notes will become immediately due and payable without further notice or action.

Upon the occurrence of any other Indenture Event of Default, and subject to the terms and conditions of the Intercreditor Agreement, the Indenture Trustee may (and, upon the written direction of the Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding, will) declare the principal of, premium, if any, any Additional Amounts and accrued and unpaid interest on all of the outstanding Notes immediately due and payable, and upon any such declaration all such amounts payable in respect of the Notes will become immediately due and payable. Upon any such declaration, the Notes will become due and payable immediately.

Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, any Default or Indenture Event of Default that occurs and is Continuing solely as a result of a good-faith failure of the Issuer to provide to the Indenture Trustee a notice, a report, a budget, a certificate, financial statements or any other written deliverable (collectively a "Reporting Deliverable") prior to the date set forth in the Indenture with respect thereto or the expiration of the time period specified for the delivery of such Reporting Deliverable will be cured upon delivery of such Reporting Deliverable to the Indenture Trustee, notwithstanding that the time period for delivery of such Reporting Deliverable will have expired or passed.

In the event of a declaration of acceleration of the Notes because an Indenture Event of Default described in clause (i)(ii) above has occurred and is Continuing, the declaration of acceleration of the Notes will be automatically annulled if: (i) the default triggering such Indenture Event of Default pursuant to clause (i) (ii) above will be remedied or cured by the Issuer or waived within 30 days after the declaration of acceleration with respect thereto; and (ii)(A) the annulment of the acceleration of the Notes would not conflict with any judgment or decree of a court of competent jurisdiction and (B) all existing Indenture Events of Default, except nonpayment of principal, premium, if any, or interest on the Notes that became due solely because of the acceleration of the Notes, have been cured or waived.

Remedies available to Noteholders upon the occurrence of an Indenture Event of Default are limited in certain respects by the Intercreditor Agreement. See “—Enforcement of Security Interests.”

Subject to certain limitations, the Majority Noteholders may direct the Indenture Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power conferred on the Indenture Trustee by the Indenture. The Indenture Trustee may withhold from Noteholders notice of any Continuing Default or Indenture Event of Default if it determines that withholding notice is in their interest, except a Default or Indenture Event of Default relating to the payment of principal, interest, Additional Amounts or premium, if any.

In case an Indenture Event of Default occurs and is Continuing, the Indenture Trustee will be under no obligation to exercise any of the rights or powers under the Indenture at the request or direction of any Noteholders unless such Noteholders have offered to the Indenture Trustee indemnity or security satisfactory to it against any claim, loss, liability or expense. Except to enforce the right to receive payment of principal, interest, Additional Amounts or premium, if any, on a Note on or after the respective due dates expressed for such payments in such Note and the Indenture, no Noteholder has any right to institute any proceedings with respect to the Indenture or pursue any remedy thereunder or in respect of the Notes unless:

(a) such Noteholder has previously given the Indenture Trustee notice that an Indenture Event of Default is Continuing;

(b) the Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding have requested the Indenture Trustee in writing to pursue the remedy;

190

(c) such Noteholders have offered the Indenture Trustee security or indemnity satisfactory to it against any claim, loss, liability or expense;

(d) the Indenture Trustee has not complied with such request within 60 days after the receipt of the request and the offer of security or indemnity; and

(e) the Noteholders of at least 25% in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then outstanding have not given the Indenture Trustee a direction inconsistent with such request within such 60-day period.

A vote of the Majority Noteholders, by written notice to the Indenture Trustee, is necessary in order to (i) waive any past Defaults under the Indenture, except (x) as provided in clause (j) described under the caption “—Amendment, Supplement and Waiver—With the Consent of the Noteholders,” and (y) as to a Default in respect of a covenant or provision which under the Indenture or the other Notes Documents cannot be modified or amended without the consent of all Noteholders of the outstanding Notes affected thereby (with respect to any Notes held by a non-consenting Noteholder), in which case, the consent of all such Noteholders will be required, and (ii) at any time after a declaration of acceleration with respect to the Notes as described in the third paragraph of this section “—Events of Default and Remedies,” cancel and rescind any such acceleration and its consequences if (x) such rescission would not conflict with any judgment or decree of a court of competent jurisdiction and (y) all existing Events of Default, other than the nonpayment of the principal of, premium, if any, interest and Additional Amounts, if any, on the Notes that have become due solely by such declaration of acceleration, have been cured or waived. Upon any such waiver, such Default will cease to exist, and any Indenture Event of Default arising therefrom will be deemed to have been cured for every purpose of the Indenture; provided that no such rescission of a declaration of acceleration will affect any subsequent Default or impair any right consequent thereto.

In accordance with the covenant described under the caption “—Certain Covenants of the Issuer—Reporting and Information” herein, the Issuer is required to deliver to the Indenture Trustee annually an Officer’s Certificate regarding compliance with the Indenture. Within five Business Days of becoming aware of any Default or Indenture Event of Default, the Issuer is required to deliver to the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate specifying such Default or Indenture Event of Default.

## Legal Defeasance and Covenant Defeasance

The Indenture will provide that the Issuer may at any time, at the option of its Board of Directors evidenced by a resolution set forth in an Officer’s Certificate, elect to have all of its obligations discharged with respect to the outstanding Notes (“Legal Defeasance”). Legal Defeasance means that the Issuer will be deemed to have paid and discharged the entire Indebtedness represented by the outstanding Notes except as to:

(a) the rights of Noteholders of outstanding Notes to receive payments in respect of the principal of, or interest, Additional Amounts or premium, if any, on, such Notes when such payments are due solely out of the trust created pursuant to the Indenture;

(b) the Issuer’s obligations with respect to the Notes to issue temporary Notes, register, transfer or exchange any Notes, replace mutilated, destroyed, lost or stolen Notes, maintain an office or agency for payments in respect of the Notes and money for security payments held in trust;

(c) the rights, powers, trusts, indemnities, duties and immunities of the Indenture Trustee, and the Issuer’s obligations in connection therewith; and

(d) the Legal Defeasance provisions of the Indenture.

In addition, the Issuer may, at its option and at any time, elect to have the obligations of the Issuer released with respect to certain covenants (including the Issuer’s obligation to make Excess Asset Sale Proceeds Offers) that are described in the Indenture (“Covenant Defeasance”) and thereafter any omission to comply with those covenants will not constitute a Default or an Indenture Event of Default. In the event Covenant Defeasance occurs, certain events (not including non-payment or Bankruptcy events with respect to the Issuer) described under the caption “—Events of Default and Remedies” above will no longer constitute an Indenture Event of Default with respect to the Notes. If the Issuer exercises its Legal Defeasance option or Covenant Defeasance option, the Liens on the Collateral, as they

191

pertain to the Notes, will be released (but without prejudice to the rights of Noteholders in the trust referred to in clause (a) of the following paragraph). The Issuer may exercise its Legal Defeasance option regardless of whether it has previously exercised any Covenant Defeasance.

In order to exercise either Legal Defeasance or Covenant Defeasance under the Indenture:

(a) the Issuer must irrevocably deposit, or cause to be deposited on trust with the Indenture Trustee (or such other entity designated by the Indenture Trustee for this purpose) for the benefit of the Noteholders, cash in U.S. Dollars, U.S. Government Securities, or a combination thereof, in such amounts as will be sufficient, in the opinion of an internationally recognized independent investment bank, appraisal firm or firm of public accountants, to pay and discharge the principal of, and interest, premium and Additional Amounts, if any, on, the outstanding Notes on the stated date for payment thereof or on the applicable redemption date, as the case may be, and the Issuer must specify whether the Notes are being defeased to such stated date for payment or to a particular redemption date;

(b) (in the case of Legal Defeasance only) the Issuer must deliver to the Indenture Trustee an opinion of counsel reasonably acceptable to the Indenture Trustee confirming that, subject to customary assumptions and exclusions, (a) the Issuer has received from, or there has been published by, the United States Internal Revenue Service a ruling that the Issuer can rely upon or (b) since the Issue Date, there has been a change in the applicable United States federal income tax law, in either case, to the effect (and based thereon such opinion of counsel will confirm) that the Noteholders and beneficial owners of the outstanding Notes will not recognize income, gain or loss for United States federal income tax purposes as a result of such Legal Defeasance and will be subject to United States federal income tax on the same amounts, in the same manner and at the same times as would have been the case if such Legal Defeasance had not occurred;

(c) (in the case of Covenant Defeasance only) the Issuer must deliver to the Indenture Trustee an opinion of counsel reasonably acceptable to the Indenture Trustee confirming that, subject to customary assumptions and exclusions, the Noteholders and beneficial owners of the outstanding Notes will not recognize income, gain or loss for United States federal income tax purposes as a result of such Covenant Defeasance and will be subject to United States federal income tax on the same amounts, in the same manner and at the same times as would have been the case if such Covenant Defeasance had not occurred;

(d) no Default or Indenture Event of Default has occurred and is Continuing on the date of such deposit or will occur as a result of such deposit (other than a Default or an Indenture Event of Default resulting from the borrowing of funds to be applied to make such deposit and any similar and simultaneous deposit relating to other Indebtedness and, in each case, the granting of any Lien to secure such borrowings);

(e) such Legal Defeasance or Covenant Defeasance, as the case may be, will not result in a breach or violation of, or constitute a Default under (other than a Default or Indenture Event of Default resulting from the borrowing of funds to be applied to make such deposit and any similar and simultaneous deposit relating to other Indebtedness and, in each case, the granting of any Lien to secure such borrowings), any material agreement or material instrument (other than the Indenture) to which the Issuer is a party or by which the Issuer is bound;

(f) the Issuer must deliver to the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate stating that the deposit was not made by the Issuer with the intent of preferring the Noteholders over the other creditors of the Issuer with the intent of defeating, hindering, delaying or defrauding any creditors of the Issuer or other creditors, or removing assets beyond the reach of the relevant creditors; and

(g) the Issuer must deliver to the Indenture Trustee an Officer’s Certificate and an opinion of counsel, subject to customary assumptions and exclusions, each stating that all conditions precedent in the case of the Officer’s Certificate, clauses (a) through (f) above and, in the case of the opinion of counsel, clause (b) or (c), as applicable, and (d) and (e), relating to the Legal Defeasance or the Covenant Defeasance, as the case may be, have been complied with.

# Satisfaction and Discharge

The Indenture will be discharged and will cease to be of further effect as to all Notes issued thereunder, when:

(a) either:

(i) all Notes that have been authenticated, except lost, stolen or destroyed Notes that have been replaced or paid and Notes for whose payment money has been deposited in trust and thereafter repaid to the Issuer, have been delivered to the Indenture Trustee for cancellation; or

(ii) all Notes that have not been delivered to the Indenture Trustee for cancellation have become due and payable by reason of the mailing of a notice of redemption or otherwise or will become due and payable within one year and the Issuer has irrevocably deposited or caused to be deposited with the Indenture Trustee as trust funds in trust solely for the benefit of the Noteholders, cash in U.S. Dollars, U.S. Government Securities, or a combination thereof, in amounts as will be sufficient, without consideration of any reinvestment of interest, to pay and discharge the entire Indebtedness on the Notes not delivered to the Indenture Trustee for cancellation for principal and premium, if any, and accrued interest to the date of maturity or redemption (provided that if such redemption is made as provided above under the captions “—Redemption of the Notes—Optional Redemption with Make-Whole Amount” or “— Redemption of the Notes—Mandatory Redemption,” (x) the amount of cash in U.S. Dollars, U.S. Government Securities or a combination thereof that must be irrevocably deposited will be determined using an assumed Make-Whole Amount calculated as of the date of such deposit and (y) the depositor must irrevocably deposit or cause to be deposited additional money in trust on the redemption date as necessary to pay the Make-Whole Amount as determined by such date);

(b) the Issuer has paid or caused to be paid all sums payable by it under the Indenture; and

(c) the Issuer has delivered to the Indenture Trustee (a) irrevocable instructions to apply the deposited money toward the payment of the Notes at maturity or on the redemption date, as the case may be, and (b) an Officer’s Certificate and an opinion of counsel, which opinion of counsel may be subject to customary assumptions and exclusions, each stating that all conditions precedent provided in the Indenture relating to the satisfaction and discharge of the Indenture have been satisfied; provided that any such counsel may rely on any Officer’s Certificate as to matters of fact.

# Amendment, Supplement and Waiver

## With the Consent of the Noteholders

Subject to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement set forth under the caption “— Modification Approval Levels,” with the consent of the Majority Noteholders (including any consents obtained in connection with the purchase of, or tender offer or exchange offer for, the Notes), the Issuer and the Indenture Trustee are permitted to agree to an amendment or supplement to, or agree to any waiver or consent in respect thereof, the Intercreditor Agreement or any other Security Document (including providing any vote or direction to the Intercreditor Agent as necessary under the Intercreditor Agreement), as the case may be.

With the consent of the Majority Noteholders (including any consents obtained in connection with the purchase of, or tender offer or exchange offer for, the Notes), the Issuer and the Indenture Trustee may amend or supplement the Indenture; provided that no such modification, amendment or waiver set forth in this “—With the Consent of the Noteholders” may, without the consent of all Noteholders of the outstanding Notes directly and adversely affected thereby (with respect to any Notes held by a non-consenting Noteholder):

(a) change the Stated Maturity of the principal of, or any amortization or installment of or Additional Amounts or interest on, any such Note;

(b) reduce the principal amount of any such Notes (or Additional Amounts or premium, if any) or the rate of, or change the time for, any principal installment payment or payment of interest on any such Note;

(c) change the coin or currency in which the principal of any such Note or any premium or any Additional Amounts or the interest thereon is payable;

(d) reduce the premium payable upon the redemption of any Note, change the time at which any Note may be redeemed, or, once notice of redemption has been given, the time at which it must thereupon be redeemed;

(e) make any change in the provisions of the Indenture relating to waivers of past Defaults or the rights of Noteholders to receive payments of principal of, or interest on (or Additional Amounts or premium, if any), the Notes;

(f) impair the right to institute suit for the enforcement of any payment on or after the Stated Maturity thereof (or, in the case of redemption, on or after the redemption date);

(g) reduce the principal amount of Notes whose Noteholders must consent to any amendment, supplement or waiver of provisions of the Indenture;

(h) make any change to the Intercreditor Agreement (or any amendments thereto or any document entered into in replacement thereof) or any provisions of the Indenture affecting the ranking of such Notes, in each case in a manner that directly and adversely affects the rights of Noteholders;

(i) release any Lien over the Collateral granted for the benefit of the Noteholders, in each case, other than in accordance with the terms of the Indenture, the Intercreditor Agreement and the other Security Documents;

(j) waive an Indenture Event of Default with respect to the nonpayment of principal, premium or interest or Additional Amounts, if any, on the Notes (except pursuant to a rescission of acceleration of Notes by the Majority Noteholders of such Notes and a waiver of the Default that resulted from such acceleration);

(k) materially increase the discretionary authority of the Indenture Trustee;

(l) amend, change or modify the obligation of the Issuer to make and consummate a Change of Control Offer in the event of a Change of Control that results in a Ratings Decline in accordance with the covenant described under the caption “—Change of Control” after such Change of Control that results in a Ratings Decline has occurred, including, in each case, amending, changing or modifying any definition relating thereto; or

(m) make any change in the amendment or waiver provisions which require each Noteholder’s consent

Subject to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement, the Required Debtholders may, on behalf of the Noteholders of all such Notes, waive any past Defaults under the Indenture, except:

(i) as restricted in clause (j) of the immediately preceding paragraph of this provision; or

(ii) as to a Default in respect of a covenant or provision which under the Indenture or the other Notes Documents cannot be modified or amended without the consent of all Noteholders of the outstanding Notes affected thereby (with respect to any Notes held by a non-consenting Noteholder).

After an amendment, supplement or waiver which requires the consent of the Noteholders becomes effective, the Issuer will mail to the Noteholders affected thereby a notice briefly describing the amendment, supplement or waiver. The Issuer will also provide a copy of any such notice to the Rating Agencies then providing ratings on the Notes. Any failure of the Issuer to mail such notice, or any defect therein, will not, however, in any way impair or

194

affect the validity of any such amended or supplemental indenture or waiver.

## Without the Consent of the Noteholders

Notwithstanding the terms under the caption “—With the Consent of the Noteholders” above, but subject to the terms of the Indenture, the Issuer and the Indenture Trustee are permitted to amend or supplement the Indenture or agree to an amendment or supplement to the Intercreditor Agreement or any other Security Document (including providing any vote or direction to the Intercreditor Agent as necessary under the Intercreditor Agreement), as the case may be, without the consent of any Noteholder, in order to:

(a) cure any ambiguity, omission, defect or inconsistency;

(b) provide for or facilitate the issuance of uncertificated notes in addition to or in place of certificated notes; provided that the uncertificated notes are issued in registered form for purposes of Section 163(f) of the Code;

(c) provide for the assumption of the Issuer’s obligations to Noteholders in the case of a merger or consolidation or sale of all or substantially all of the Issuer’s assets in accordance with the terms of the Indenture and to make all other modifications to the Indenture, the Notes and the Security Documents to the extent reasonably required to effectuate such permitted merger, including, without limitation, the Corporate Reorganization;

(d) make any change that would provide any additional rights or benefits to Noteholders, to surrender any power conferred upon the Issuer or the Holding Company, or that does not directly and adversely affect the legal rights under the Indenture of any such Noteholder;

(e) to provide for any guarantee of the Notes, to secure the Notes or to confirm and evidence the release, termination or discharge of any guarantee of or Lien securing the Notes when such release, termination or discharge is permitted by the Indenture;

(f) to add to the covenants of the Issuer or the Holding Company for the benefit of the Noteholders;

(g) to surrender any right conferred upon the Issuer;

(h) provide for a successor Indenture Trustee in accordance with the provisions of the Indenture or other successor agent under any Financing Document pursuant to the requirements thereof;

(i) to add any additional parties to the Intercreditor Agreement or the other Security Documents with respect to the incurrence of any Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness permitted to be incurred under the Indenture or to make any other amendments to the Security Documents or the Indenture necessary to permit the creation and registration of Liens on the Collateral to secure Permitted Pari Passu Secured Indebtedness permitted to be incurred under the Indenture;

(j) to comply with the rules of any applicable depository or of any securities exchange on which the Notes may be listed;

(k) to make any other change that does not materially adversely affect the rights of any Noteholder;

(l) conform the text of the Indenture, the Notes or the Security Documents to any provision of this “Description of the Notes” to the extent that such provision in this “Description of the Notes” was intended to be a verbatim recitation of a provision of the Indenture, the Notes or the Security Documents and the Indenture Trustee has received an Officer’s Certificate from the Issuer to this effect;

(m) make any amendment to the provisions of the Indenture relating to the transfer and legending of Notes as permitted by the Indenture, including, without limitation, to facilitate the issuance and administration of the Notes or, if incurred in compliance with the Indenture, Additional Notes; provided, however, that (a) compliance with the Indenture as so amended would not result in Notes

195

being transferred in violation of the Securities Act or any applicable securities law and (b) such amendment does not materially directly and adversely affect the rights of Noteholders to transfer Notes;

(n) to provide for the issuance of Additional Notes;

(o) to release any Collateral from Liens securing the Notes when permitted or required under the Indenture or the Security Documents or to convey, transfer, assign, mortgage or pledge to the Collateral Agent or the Panamanian Trustee as security for the Notes any property; or

(p) evidence and provide for the acceptance and appointment under the Indenture or any other Financing Document of a successor Indenture Trustee, successor Collateral Agent or other successor Agent thereunder pursuant to the requirements thereof.

In executing any amendment, waiver or supplemental indenture to the Indenture or agreeing to an amendment or supplement to the Intercreditor Agreement or any other Security Document (including providing any vote or direction to the Intercreditor Agent as necessary under the Intercreditor Agreement), the Indenture Trustee will be entitled to receive (and, if applicable, the Intercreditor Agent, the Collateral Agent and the Panamanian Trustee will also be entitled to rely upon) an Officer's Certificate and an opinion of counsel, each stating that such amendment, waiver or supplemental indenture or amendment or supplement to the Intercreditor Agreement or any other Security Document is authorized or permitted by the Indenture, the Intercreditor Agreement and/or the Security Documents, as the case may be, and that all covenants and conditions precedent to such amendment, supplement or waiver under the Indenture, the Intercreditor Agreement and the Security Documents have been complied with.

## Form of Consent

The consent of the Noteholders will not be necessary under the Indenture to approve the particular form of any proposed amendment. It will be sufficient if such consent approves the substance of the proposed amendment.

None of the Issuer or any of its Affiliates may, directly or indirectly, pay or cause to be paid any consideration, whether by way of interest, fee or otherwise, to any holder for or as an inducement to any consent, waiver or amendment of any of the terms or provisions of the Indenture or the Notes unless such consideration is offered to be paid or agreed to be paid to all holders of the Notes that consent, waive or agree to amend such term or provision within the time period set forth in the solicitation documents relating to the consent, waiver or amendment.

## No Personal Liability of Directors, Officers, Employees and Stockholders

No past, present or future director, officer, manager, employee, incorporator, member, partner, controlling person or stockholder of the Issuer, in such role, will have any liability for any obligations of the Issuer under the Indenture or any other Notes Document or for any claim based on, in respect of, or by reason of, such obligations or their creation.

Each Noteholder by accepting a Note waives and releases all such liability. The waiver and release are part of the consideration for issuance of the Notes. The waiver may not be effective to waive liabilities under the federal securities laws.

## Judgment Currency

The Notes Documents will provide that the transactions contemplated thereby are part of an international transaction in which the specification of U.S. Dollars and payment in the United States is of the essence, and the obligations of the Issuer under the Indenture and the other Notes Documents to make payment to (or for the account of) the Indenture Trustee and each Noteholder (each, an "Entitled Person") in U.S. Dollars will not be discharged or satisfied by any tender or recovery pursuant to any judgment expressed in or converted into any other currency or in another place except to the extent that such tender or recovery results in the effective receipt by the Entitled Persons in the United States of the full amount of U.S. Dollars payable to the Entitled Persons under the Notes Documents. If for the purpose of obtaining or enforcing judgment in any court it is necessary to convert a sum due under any Notes Document in U.S. Dollars into another currency (for the purposes of this "Judgment Currency" provision, hereinafter

196

the "judgment currency"), the rate of exchange which will be applied will be that at which, in accordance with normal banking procedures, the Entitled Persons could purchase such U.S. Dollars in the United States with the judgment currency on the Business Day prior to the day on which such judgment is rendered. The obligation of the Issuer in respect of any such sum due from it to the Entitled Persons under the Notes Documents will, notwithstanding the rate of exchange actually applied in rendering such judgment, be discharged only to the extent that on the Business Day following the receipt by such Entitled Person of any sum adjudged to be due under the Notes Documents in the judgment currency such Entitled Person may in accordance with normal banking procedures purchase and transfer U.S. Dollars to the United States with the amount of the judgment currency so adjudged to be due; and the Issuer will, as a separate obligation and notwithstanding any such judgment, agree to indemnify such Entitled Person on demand, in U.S. Dollars, for the amount (if any) by which the sum originally due to such Entitled Person in U.S. Dollars under the Notes Documents exceeds the amount of the U.S. Dollars so purchased and transferred.

## Governing Law; Agent for Service of Process

The Notes, the Indenture, and the Security Documents will be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York, except that the Panamanian Security Documents will be governed by Panamanian law.

Each of the parties to the Indenture will (and holders by their acceptance of the Notes will be deemed to) irrevocably submit to the jurisdiction of the U.S. federal and New York State courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York in respect of actions brought against it as a defendant for purposes of all legal actions and proceedings instituted in connection with the Notes, the Indenture, and any Security Document stated to be governed by the laws of the State of New York. Each of the parties to the Indenture will (and holders by their acceptance of the Notes will be deemed to) irrevocably waive (and each Noteholder (by acquiring a Note or a beneficial interest therein or otherwise accepting the benefits of the Indenture and the other applicable Financing Documents) will be deemed to irrevocably waive), to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, any objection that it may now or thereafter have to the laying of the venue of any such proceeding brought in such a court, any claim that any such proceeding brought in such a court has been brought in an inconvenient forum and any objection based on place of residence or domicile.

The Issuer and the Holding Company will appoint on or prior to the Issue Date, as applicable, Cogency Global Inc., with an office on the date hereof at 122 East 42nd Street, 18th Floor, New York, NY 10168, United States of America, as its authorized agent upon which process may be served in any such action in relation to the New York law documents of the transaction.

## Waiver of Immunity

To the extent that the Issuer, any Shareholder or any of their respective properties, assets or revenues may have or may hereafter become entitled to any right of immunity, on the grounds of sovereignty or otherwise, from any legal action, suit or proceeding, from the giving of any relief in any such legal action, suit or proceeding, from setoff or from counterclaim from the jurisdiction of any Panamanian, New York State or U.S. federal or other applicable court, from service of process, from attachment upon or prior to judgment, from attachment in aid of execution of judgment, or from execution of judgment, or other legal process or proceeding for the giving of any relief or for the enforcement of any judgment, in any such court in which proceedings may at any time be commenced, with respect to the obligations and liabilities of the Issuer or such Shareholder, or any other matter under or arising out of or in connection with, the Notes or the Indenture, the Issuer and such Shareholder irrevocably and unconditionally waives or will waive, such right, and agrees not to plead or claim any such immunity and consents to such relief and enforcement. To the extent that the Issuer or any of its properties, assets or revenues may hereafter become entitled to any such right of immunity, such waiver may not be effective if it affects the interests of any third parties as they relate to the Issuer or if such waiver is expressly forbidden under Panamanian law.

## Concerning the Indenture Trustee

The Majority Noteholders will have the right to direct the time, method and place of conducting any proceeding for exercising any remedy available to the Indenture Trustee or the exercise of any trust or power conferred upon the Indenture Trustee, subject to certain exceptions and conditions as stated in the Indenture or the Intercreditor Agent. The Indenture provides that in case an Indenture Event of Default occurs and is Continuing, the Indenture

197

Trustee will be required, in the exercise of its power, to use the degree of care of a prudent person in the conduct of his own affairs. The Indenture Trustee will be under no obligation to exercise any of its rights or powers under the Indenture at the request of any Noteholder, unless such Noteholder has offered to the Indenture Trustee security and indemnity satisfactory to it against any claim, loss, liability or expense.

In executing or agreeing to any amendment to the Indenture (including a supplemental indenture), the Notes or the Security Documents, the Indenture Trustee will be entitled to receive, and will be fully protected in relying upon, an Officer’s Certificate and a New York law opinion of New York counsel stating that the execution of such amendment or supplemental indenture is authorized and permitted by the Indenture and the Intercreditor Agreement and that all conditions precedent with respect to such amendment or supplemental indenture have been complied with.

In determining whether the holders of the required principal amount of Notes have concurred in any direction, waiver or consent, Notes owned by the Issuer or any of its Affiliates will be disregarded, except that, for the purposes of determining whether the Indenture Trustee will be protected in conclusively relying on any such direction, waiver or consent, Notes that an Authorized Officer of the Indenture Trustee actually knows are so owned will be disregarded.

## Listing

The Notes have been registered with the SMV and listed on Latinex. Upon registration of the Notes with the SMV and the listing of the Notes on Latinex, the Issuer will comply with the reporting and other requirements set forth in the Panamanian securities law applicable to companies who have registered their securities with the SMV, as well as any corresponding requirements of Latinex.

The Issuer will apply for the listing and quotation of the Notes on the Official List of the SGX-ST. Each of the Issuer, the Indenture Trustee, and the Collateral Agent are (without the need for any approvals, consents or instructions from any holders of the Notes, but in accordance with all other provisions applicable thereto) authorized to join in the execution of any amendment (including amendment and restatement) of any Financing Document(s) to the extent required to provide such a listing. Promptly after such a listing, the Issuer will so notify the Indenture Trustee, which will provide notice thereof to each Noteholder.

In the event that the Notes are admitted to listing on the SGX-ST, the Issuer will use its commercially reasonable efforts to maintain such listing, provided that if, as a result of any legislation the Issuer could be required to publish financial information either more regularly than it otherwise would be required to or according to accounting principles that are materially different from the applicable Accounting Standards that it would otherwise use to prepare its published financial information, or if the Issuer determines that it is unduly burdensome, in its good faith determination, to maintain a listing on the SGX-ST, the Issuer may delist the Notes from the SGX-ST and, in the event of such delisting, the Issuer will use its commercially reasonable efforts to seek an alternative admission to listing, trading and/or quotation for the Notes by another listing authority, stock exchange and/or quotation system as they may decide; provided that such listing authority, stock exchange or quotation system is used for listing and trading in the international debt capital markets. Although the Issuer cannot assure you as to the liquidity that may result from a listing on the SGX-ST, delisting the Notes from the SGX-ST may have a material effect on the ability of holders of the Notes to resell the Notes in the secondary market.

The SGX-ST assumes no responsibility for the correctness of any of the statements made or opinions expressed or reports contained in this “Description of the Notes”. Listing and quotation of the Notes on the SGX-ST is not to be taken as an indication of the merits of the Issuer or the Notes. For the purposes of the listing and quotation of the Notes on the SGX-ST, the Notes will be traded on the SGX-ST in a minimum board lot size of U.S.$200,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies) and a paying agent in Singapore will be appointed upon the issue of the Notes in definitive form. In addition, for so long as the Notes are listed on the SGX-ST and the rules of the SGX-ST so require, in the event that the Notes which are issued in global certificated form are exchanged for Notes in definitive registered form or definitive registered Notes, the Issuer will appoint and maintain a paying agent in Singapore, where the certificates in definitive form in respect of Notes may be presented or surrendered for payment or redemption. In the event that the Notes which are issued in global certificated form are exchanged for Notes in definitive registered form or definitive registered Notes, an announcement of such exchange will be made by or on behalf of the Issuer through the SGX-ST and such announcement will include all material information with respect to the delivery of the certificates in definitive form, including details of the paying agent in Singapore.

# Unclaimed Moneys

Subject to any applicable abandoned property law, the Indenture Trustee and paying agent will pay to the Issuer upon its request any monies held by them for the payment of principal or interest that remains unclaimed for two (2) years, and, thereafter, registered holders entitled to such monies must look to the Issuer for payment as its general creditors. After the return of such monies by the paying agent and the transfer agent to the Issuer, neither the Indenture Trustee or the paying agent will be liable to the holders in respect of such monies.

## Notices

Notices to be given to Noteholders will be given to the depositary, in accordance with its applicable policies as in effect from time to time, with respect to any such Notes held in global form. If Notes are issued in individual definitive form, notices to be given to holders of such Notes issued in individual definitive form will be deemed to have been given upon the mailing by first class mail, postage prepaid or the use of overnight courier, of such notices to holders of the Notes at their registered addresses as they appear in the registrar's records. Neither the failure to give any notice to a particular holder of the Notes, nor any defect in a notice given to a particular holder of the Notes, will affect the sufficiency of any notice given to another holder of the Notes.

For so long as the Notes are listed on the SGX-ST and to the extent required by the rules and regulations of such exchange, the Issuer will publish notices in a newspaper with general circulation in Singapore, which is expected to be the Business Times, Singapore Edition. Notices will be deemed to have been given on the date of publication as aforesaid or, if published on different dates, on the date of the first such publication.

Copies of the Notes Documents, as well as copies of the Issuer's organizational documents will be made available for inspection upon request to the Issuer at its address listed on the inside back cover page of this Offering Memorandum, subject an acknowledgment of confidentiality.

The amount of Indebtedness of any Person will be deemed to be:

(i) with respect to contingent obligations, the maximum liability upon the occurrence of the contingency giving rise to the obligation;

(ii) with respect to Indebtedness secured by a Lien on an asset of such Person but not otherwise the obligation, contingent or otherwise, of such Person, the lesser of (x) the Fair Market Value of such asset on the date the Lien attached and (y) the amount of such Indebtedness;

(iii) with respect to any Indebtedness issued with original issue discount, the face amount of such Indebtedness minus the remaining unamortized portion of the original issue discount of such Indebtedness;

(iv) with respect to any hedging obligation, the net amount payable if such hedging obligation terminated at that time due to default by such Person; and
